verses.textZh: 犹大王乌西雅、约坦、亚哈斯、希西家在位的时候，也是约阿施的儿子以色列王耶罗波安执政的时候，耶和华的话临到备利的儿子何西阿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王乌西雅、约坦、亚哈斯、希西家在位的时候，也是约阿施的儿子以色列王耶罗波安执政的时候，耶和华的话临到备利的儿子何西阿。
verses.textZhCuv: 当乌西雅、约坦、亚哈斯、希西家作犹大王，约阿施的儿子耶罗波安作以色列王的时候，耶和华的话临到备利的儿子何西阿。
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord that came to Hosea son of Beeri during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and during the reign of Jeroboam son of Jehoash king of Israel:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord that came to Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave this message to Hosea son of Beeri during the years when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah, and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: The word of the Lord which came to Hosea the son of Beeri, during the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and during the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord that came to Hosea son of Beeri during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and during the reign of Jeroboam son of Jehoash king of Israel:

verses.textZh: 耶和华初次借着何西阿说话。耶和华对何西阿说："你去娶一个像娼妓一样的女人，生养像娼妓一样的儿女，因为这地盛行淫乱，离开了耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华初次借着何西阿说话。耶和华对何西阿说："你去娶一个像娼妓一样的女人，生养像娼妓一样的儿女，因为这地盛行淫乱，离开了耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华初次与何西阿说话，对他说：「你去娶淫妇为妻，也收那从淫乱所生的儿女；因为这地大行淫乱，离弃耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord began to speak through Hosea, the Lord said to him, "Go, marry a promiscuous woman and have children with her, for like an adulterous wife this land is guilty of unfaithfulness to the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: When the Lord first spoke through Hosea, the Lord said to Hosea, "Go, take to yourself a wife of whoredom and have children of whoredom, for the land commits great whoredom by forsaking the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: When the Lord began to speak by Hosea, the Lord said to Hosea: "Go, take yourself a wife of harlotry And children of harlotry, For the land has committed great harlotry Bydeparting from the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord first began speaking to Israel through Hosea, he said to him, "Go and marry a prostitute, so that some of her children will be conceived in prostitution. This will illustrate how Israel has acted like a prostitute by turning against the Lord and worshiping other gods."
verses.textEnNasb: When the Lord first spoke through Hosea, the Lord said to Hosea, "Go, take for yourself a wife inclined to infidelity, and children of infidelity; for the land commits flagrant infidelity, abandoning the Lord."
verses.textEn: When the Lord began to speak through Hosea, the Lord said to him, "Go, marry a promiscuous woman and have children with her, for like an adulterous wife this land is guilty of unfaithfulness to the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 于是他就去娶了滴拉音的女儿歌玛。后来，她怀了孕，给他生了一个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他就去娶了滴拉音的女儿歌玛。后来，她怀了孕，给他生了一个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，何西阿去娶了滴拉音的女儿歌篾。这妇人怀孕，给他生了一个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: So he married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.
verses.textEnEsv: So he went and took Gomer, the daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.
verses.textEnNlt: So Hosea married Gomer, the daughter of Diblaim, and she became pregnant and gave Hosea a son.
verses.textEnNasb: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.
verses.textEn: So he married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.

verses.textZh: 耶和华就对何西阿说："给他起名叫耶斯列；因为不久我就要惩罚耶户家在耶斯列流人血的罪，我要灭绝以色列家的国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华就对何西阿说："给他起名叫耶斯列；因为不久我就要惩罚耶户家在耶斯列流人血的罪，我要灭绝以色列家的国。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对何西阿说：「给他起名叫耶斯列；因为再过片时，我必讨耶户家在耶斯列杀人流血的罪，也必使以色列家的国灭绝。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Hosea, "Call him Jezreel, because I will soon punish the house of Jehu for the massacre at Jezreel, and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to him, "Call his name Jezreel, for in just a little while I will punish the house of Jehu for the blood of Jezreel, and I will put an end to the kingdom of the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to him: "Call his name Jezreel, For in a little while I will avenge the bloodshed of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, And bring an end to the kingdom of the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said, "Name the child Jezreel, for I am about to punish King Jehu’s dynasty to avenge the murders he committed at Jezreel. In fact, I will bring an end to Israel’s independence.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to him, "Name him Jezreel; for in just a little while I will punish the house of Jehu for the bloodshed of Jezreel, and I will put an end to the kingdom of the house of Israel.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Hosea, "Call him Jezreel, because I will soon punish the house of Jehu for the massacre at Jezreel, and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel.

verses.textZh: "到那日，我要在耶斯列平原折断以色列的弓。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "到那日，我要在耶斯列平原折断以色列的弓。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，我必在耶斯列平原折断以色列的弓。」
verses.textEnNiv: In that day I will break Israel’s bow in the Valley of Jezreel."
verses.textEnEsv: And on that day I will break the bow of Israel in the Valley of Jezreel."
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall come to pass in that day That I will break the bow of Israel in the Valley of Jezreel."
verses.textEnNlt: I will break its military power in the Jezreel Valley."
verses.textEnNasb: On that day I will break the bow of Israel in the Valley of Jezreel."
verses.textEn: In that day I will break Israel’s bow in the Valley of Jezreel."

verses.textZh: 后来，歌玛又怀孕，生了一个女儿。耶和华对何西阿说："给她起名叫罗．路哈玛 ；因为我必不再怜恤以色列家，我决不赦免他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，歌玛又怀孕，生了一个女儿。耶和华对何西阿说："给她起名叫罗．路哈玛 ；因为我必不再怜恤以色列家，我决不赦免他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 歌篾又怀孕生了一个女儿，耶和华对何西阿说：「给她起名叫罗‧路哈玛 ；因为我必不再怜悯以色列家，决不赦免他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Gomer conceived again and gave birth to a daughter. Then the Lord said to Hosea, "Call her Lo-Ruhamah (which means "not loved"), for I will no longer show love to Israel, that I should at all forgive them.
verses.textEnEsv: She conceived again and bore a daughter. And the Lord said to him, "Call her name No Mercy, for I will no more have mercy on the house of Israel, to forgive them at all.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she conceived again and bore a daughter. Then God said to him: "Call her name Lo-Ruhamah, For I will no longer have mercy on the house of Israel, But I will utterly take them away.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon Gomer became pregnant again and gave birth to a daughter. And the Lord said to Hosea, "Name your daughter Lo-ruhamah—‘Not loved’—for I will no longer show love to the people of Israel or forgive them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then she conceived again and gave birth to a daughter. And the Lord said to him, "Name her Lo-ruhamah, for I will no longer take pity on the house of Israel, that I would ever forgive them.
verses.textEn: Gomer conceived again and gave birth to a daughter. Then the Lord said to Hosea, "Call her Lo-Ruhamah (which means "not loved"), for I will no longer show love to Israel, that I should at all forgive them.

verses.textZh: "但我要怜恤犹大家，使他们靠耶和华他们的神得救。我要拯救他们，并不是靠弓、靠刀、靠战争，也不是靠战马、靠骑兵。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "但我要怜恤犹大家，使他们靠耶和华他们的神得救。我要拯救他们，并不是靠弓、靠刀、靠战争，也不是靠战马、靠骑兵。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我却要怜悯犹大家，使他们靠耶和华－他们的神得救，不使他们靠弓、刀、争战、马匹，与马兵得救。」
verses.textEnNiv: Yet I will show love to Judah; and I will save them—not by bow, sword or battle, or by horses and horsemen, but I, the Lord their God, will save them."
verses.textEnEsv: But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and I will save them by the Lord their God. I will not save them by bow or by sword or by war or by horses or by horsemen."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet I will have mercy on the house of Judah, Will save them by the Lord their God, And will not save them by bow, Nor by sword or battle, By horses or horsemen."
verses.textEnNlt: But I will show love to the people of Judah. I will free them from their enemies—not with weapons and armies or horses and charioteers, but by my power as the Lord their God."
verses.textEnNasb: But I will take pity on the house of Judah and save them by the Lord their God, and will not save them by bow, sword, battle, horses, or horsemen."
verses.textEn: Yet I will show love to Judah; and I will save them—not by bow, sword or battle, or by horses and horsemen, but I, the Lord their God, will save them."

verses.textZh: 罗．路哈玛断奶之后，歌玛又怀孕生了一个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗．路哈玛断奶之后，歌玛又怀孕生了一个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 歌篾给罗‧路哈玛断奶以后，又怀孕生了一个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: After she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, Gomer had another son.
verses.textEnEsv: When she had weaned No Mercy, she conceived and bore a son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived and bore a son.
verses.textEnNlt: After Gomer had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she again became pregnant and gave birth to a second son.
verses.textEnNasb: When she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived and gave birth to a son.
verses.textEn: After she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, Gomer had another son.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："给他起名叫罗．阿米 ；因为你们不是我的子民，我也不是你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："给他起名叫罗．阿米 ；因为你们不是我的子民，我也不是你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「给他起名叫罗‧阿米 ；因为你们不作我的子民，我也不作你们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said, "Call him Lo-Ammi (which means "not my people"), for you are not my people, and I am not your God.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said, "Call his name Not My People, for you are not my people, and I am not your God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said: "Call his name Lo-Ammi, For you are not My people, And I will not be your God.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said, "Name him Lo-ammi—‘Not my people’—for Israel is not my people, and I am not their God.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said, "Name him Lo-ammi, because you are not My people, and I am not your God."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said, "Call him Lo-Ammi (which means "not my people"), for you are not my people, and I am not your God.

verses.textZh: "然而，以色列人的数目， 必多如海边的沙， 量不尽，数不完。 从前在甚么地方对他们说： ‘你们不是我的子民’， 将来要在那里对他们说： ‘你们是永活的神的儿子。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "然而，以色列人的数目， 必多如海边的沙， 量不尽，数不完。 从前在甚么地方对他们说： ‘你们不是我的子民’， 将来要在那里对他们说： ‘你们是永活的神的儿子。’
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，以色列的人数必如海沙，不可量，不可数。从前在什么地方对他们说「你们不是我的子民」，将来在那里必对他们说「你们是永生神的儿子」。
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet the Israelites will be like the sand on the seashore, which cannot be measured or counted. In the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘children of the living God.’
verses.textEnEsv: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or numbered. And in the place where it was said to them, "You are not my people," it shall be said to them, "Children of the living God."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Yet the number of the children of Israel Shall be as the sand of the sea, Which cannot be measured or numbered. And it shall come to pass In the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ There it shall be said to them, ‘Youare sons of the living God.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Yet the time will come when Israel’s people will be like the sands of the seashore—too many to count! Then, at the place where they were told, ‘You are not my people,’ it will be said, ‘You are children of the living God.’
verses.textEnNasb: Yet the number of the sons of Israel Will be like the sand of the sea, Which cannot be measured or counted; And in the place Where it is said to them, "You are not My people," It will be said to them, "You are the sons of the living God."
verses.textEn: "Yet the Israelites will be like the sand on the seashore, which cannot be measured or counted. In the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘children of the living God.’

verses.textZh: 犹大人和以色列人要聚集在一起， 为自己立一位首领， 并离开那地上去， 因为耶斯列的日子必为大日。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人和以色列人要聚集在一起， 为自己立一位首领， 并离开那地上去， 因为耶斯列的日子必为大日。"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人和以色列人必一同聚集，为自己立一个首领，从这地上去 ，因为耶斯列的日子必为大日。
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Judah and the people of Israel will come together; they will appoint one leader and will come up out of the land, for great will be the day of Jezreel.
verses.textEnEsv: And the children of Judah and the children of Israel shall be gathered together, and they shall appoint for themselves one head. And they shall go up from the land, for great shall be the day of Jezreel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Judah and the children of Israel Shall be gathered together, And appoint for themselves one head; And they shall come up out of the land, For great willbe the day of Jezreel!
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people of Judah and Israel will unite together. They will choose one leader for themselves, and they will return from exile together. What a day that will be—the day of Jezreel —when God will again plant his people in his land.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Judah and the sons of Israel will be gathered together, And they will appoint for themselves one leader, And they will go up from the land, For the day of Jezreel will be great.
verses.textEn: The people of Judah and the people of Israel will come together; they will appoint one leader and will come up out of the land, for great will be the day of Jezreel.

verses.textZh: "你们要对你们的兄弟说：‘我的子民’；要对你们的姊妹说：‘蒙怜悯的’。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要对你们的兄弟说：‘我的子民’；要对你们的姊妹说：‘蒙怜悯的’。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要称你们的弟兄为阿米 ，称你们的姊妹为路哈玛 。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say of your brothers, ‘My people,’ and of your sisters, ‘My loved one.’
verses.textEnEsv: Say to your brothers, "You are my people," and to your sisters, "You have received mercy."
verses.textEnNkjv: Say to your brethren, ‘My people,’ And to your sisters, ‘Mercy isshown.’
verses.textEnNlt: "In that day you will call your brothers Ammi—‘My people.’ And you will call your sisters Ruhamah—‘The ones I love.’
verses.textEnNasb: Say to your brothers, " Ammi," and to your sisters, " Ruhamah."
verses.textEn: "Say of your brothers, ‘My people,’ and of your sisters, ‘My loved one.’

verses.textZh: 要与你们的母亲争论，你们要争论， 因为她不是我的妻子，我也不是她的丈夫； 好让她除掉脸上的淫相， 和乳间的淫态，
verses.textZhCnvs: 要与你们的母亲争论，你们要争论， 因为她不是我的妻子，我也不是她的丈夫； 好让她除掉脸上的淫相， 和乳间的淫态，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要与你们的母亲大大争辩； 因为她不是我的妻子， 我也不是她的丈夫。 叫她除掉脸上的淫像 和胸间的淫态，
verses.textEnNiv: "Rebuke your mother, rebuke her, for she is not my wife, and I am not her husband. Let her remove the adulterous look from her face and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts.
verses.textEnEsv: "Plead with your mother, plead— for she is not my wife, and I am not her husband— that she put away her whoring from her face, and her adultery from between her breasts;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Bring charges against your mother, bring charges; For she is not My wife, nor am I her Husband! Let her put away her harlotries from her sight, And her adulteries from between her breasts;
verses.textEnNlt: "But now bring charges against Israel—your mother— for she is no longer my wife, and I am no longer her husband. Tell her to remove the prostitute’s makeup from her face and the clothing that exposes her breasts.
verses.textEnNasb: "Dispute with your mother, dispute, Because she is not my wife, and I am not her husband; But she must remove her infidelity from her face And her adultery from between her breasts,
verses.textEn: "Rebuke your mother, rebuke her, for she is not my wife, and I am not her husband. Let her remove the adulterous look from her face and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts.

verses.textZh: 免得我把她剥光， 赤身露体，使她像刚生下来的那天一样； 又使她像旷野， 像无水的旱地一般， 叫她因干渴而死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得我把她剥光， 赤身露体，使她像刚生下来的那天一样； 又使她像旷野， 像无水的旱地一般， 叫她因干渴而死。
verses.textZhCuv: 免得我剥她的衣服， 使她赤体，与才生的时候一样， 使她如旷野，如干旱之地， 因渴而死。
verses.textEnNiv: Otherwise I will strip her naked and make her as bare as on the day she was born; I will make her like a desert, turn her into a parched land, and slay her with thirst.
verses.textEnEsv: lest I strip her naked and make her as in the day she was born, and make her like a wilderness, and make her like a parched land, and kill her with thirst.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lest I strip her naked And expose her, as in the day she was born, And make her like a wilderness, And set her like a dry land, And slay her with thirst.
verses.textEnNlt: Otherwise, I will strip her as naked as she was on the day she was born. I will leave her to die of thirst, as in a dry and barren wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: Otherwise, I will strip her naked And expose her as on the day she was born. I will also make her like a wilderness, Make her like desert land, And put her to death with thirst.
verses.textEn: Otherwise I will strip her naked and make her as bare as on the day she was born; I will make her like a desert, turn her into a parched land, and slay her with thirst.

verses.textZh: 我必不怜恤她的儿子， 因为他们是像娼妓的儿女；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必不怜恤她的儿子， 因为他们是像娼妓的儿女；
verses.textZhCuv: 我必不怜悯她的儿女， 因为他们是从淫乱而生的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will not show my love to her children, because they are the children of adultery.
verses.textEnEsv: Upon her children also I will have no mercy, because they are children of whoredom.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will not have mercy on her children, For they are the children of harlotry.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will not love her children, for they were conceived in prostitution.
verses.textEnNasb: "Also, I will take no pity on her children, Because they are children of infidelity.
verses.textEn: I will not show my love to her children, because they are the children of adultery.

verses.textZh: 因为他们的母亲卖了淫， 怀他们的作了羞耻的事； 因为她曾说：‘我要跟随我那些爱人。 我的饼和水， 羊毛和麻布，油和我所喝的，都是他们给的。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们的母亲卖了淫， 怀他们的作了羞耻的事； 因为她曾说：‘我要跟随我那些爱人。 我的饼和水， 羊毛和麻布，油和我所喝的，都是他们给的。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的母亲行了淫乱， 怀他们的母做了可羞耻的事， 因为她说：我要随从所爱的； 我的饼、水、羊毛、麻、油、酒 都是他们给的。
verses.textEnNiv: Their mother has been unfaithful and has conceived them in disgrace. She said, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my food and my water, my wool and my linen, my olive oil and my drink.’
verses.textEnEsv: For their mother has played the whore; she who conceived them has acted shamefully. For she said, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For their mother has played the harlot; She who conceived them has behaved shamefully. For she said, ‘I will go after my lovers, Who give me my bread and my water, My wool and my linen, My oil and my drink.’
verses.textEnNlt: Their mother is a shameless prostitute and became pregnant in a shameful way. She said, ‘I’ll run after other lovers and sell myself to them for food and water, for clothing of wool and linen, and for olive oil and drinks.’
verses.textEnNasb: "For their mother has committed prostitution; She who conceived them has acted shamefully. For she said, ‘I will go after my lovers, Who give me my bread and my water, My wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.’
verses.textEn: Their mother has been unfaithful and has conceived them in disgrace. She said, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my food and my water, my wool and my linen, my olive oil and my drink.’

verses.textZh: 因此，我要用荆棘堵塞她的通道， 我要筑墙围住她，使她找不着出路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我要用荆棘堵塞她的通道， 我要筑墙围住她，使她找不着出路。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我必用荆棘堵塞她的道， 筑墙挡住她， 使她找不着路。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I will block her path with thornbushes; I will wall her in so that she cannot find her way.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I will hedge up her way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, so that she cannot find her paths.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore, behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, And wall her in, So that she cannot find her paths.
verses.textEnNlt: "For this reason I will fence her in with thornbushes. I will block her path with a wall to make her lose her way.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, behold, I will obstruct her way with thorns, And I will build a stone wall against her so that she cannot find her paths.
verses.textEn: Therefore I will block her path with thornbushes; I will wall her in so that she cannot find her way.

verses.textZh: 她要追赶她那些爱人，却追不上； 要寻找他们，却找不着。 她就说：‘我要回去，回到前夫那里， 因为从前比现在好得多了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 她要追赶她那些爱人，却追不上； 要寻找他们，却找不着。 她就说：‘我要回去，回到前夫那里， 因为从前比现在好得多了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 她必追随所爱的，却追不上； 她必寻找他们，却寻不见， 便说：我要归回前夫， 因我那时的光景比如今还好。
verses.textEnNiv: She will chase after her lovers but not catch them; she will look for them but not find them. Then she will say, ‘I will go back to my husband as at first, for then I was better off than now.’
verses.textEnEsv: She shall pursue her lovers but not overtake them, and she shall seek them but shall not find them. Then she shall say, ‘I will go and return to my first husband, for it was better for me then than now.’
verses.textEnNkjv: She will chase her lovers, But not overtake them; Yes, she will seek them, but not find them. Then she will say, ‘I will go and return to my first husband, For then itwas better for me than now.’
verses.textEnNlt: When she runs after her lovers, she won’t be able to catch them. She will search for them but not find them. Then she will think, ‘I might as well return to my husband, for I was better off with him than I am now.’
verses.textEnNasb: "And she will pursue her lovers, but she will not reach them; And she will seek them, but will not find them. Then she will say, ‘I will go back to my first husband, Because it was better for me then than now!’
verses.textEn: She will chase after her lovers but not catch them; she will look for them but not find them. Then she will say, ‘I will go back to my husband as at first, for then I was better off than now.’

verses.textZh: 其实她不知道，是我把五谷、新酒、橄榄油赐给了她； 甚至他们用来制造巴力的金银， 也是我大量给她的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实她不知道，是我把五谷、新酒、橄榄油赐给了她； 甚至他们用来制造巴力的金银， 也是我大量给她的；
verses.textZhCuv: 她不知道是我给她五谷、新酒，和油， 又加增她的金银； 她却以此供奉 巴力。
verses.textEnNiv: She has not acknowledged that I was the one who gave her the grain, the new wine and oil, who lavished on her the silver and gold— which they used for Baal.
verses.textEnEsv: And she did not know that it was I who gave her the grain, the wine, and the oil, and who lavished on her silver and gold, which they used for Baal.
verses.textEnNkjv: For she did not know That I gave her grain, new wine, and oil, And multiplied her silver and gold— Which they prepared for Baal.
verses.textEnNlt: She doesn’t realize it was I who gave her everything she has— the grain, the new wine, the olive oil; I even gave her silver and gold. But she gave all my gifts to Baal.
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet she does not know that it was I myself who gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, And lavished on her silver and gold, Which they used for Baal.
verses.textEn: She has not acknowledged that I was the one who gave her the grain, the new wine and oil, who lavished on her the silver and gold— which they used for Baal.

verses.textZh: 因此，到了收割的时候， 到了出酒的季节， 我必收回五谷和新酒； 用来给她遮蔽裸体的羊毛和麻布， 我也必夺回。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，到了收割的时候， 到了出酒的季节， 我必收回五谷和新酒； 用来给她遮蔽裸体的羊毛和麻布， 我也必夺回。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此到了收割的日子， 出酒的时候， 我必将我的五谷、新酒收回， 也必将她应当遮体的羊毛和麻夺回来。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore I will take away my grain when it ripens, and my new wine when it is ready. I will take back my wool and my linen, intended to cover her naked body.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I will take back my grain in its time, and my wine in its season, and I will take away my wool and my flax, which were to cover her nakedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore I will return and take away My grain in its time And My new wine in its season, And will take back My wool and My linen, Given to cover her nakedness.
verses.textEnNlt: "But now I will take back the ripened grain and new wine I generously provided each harvest season. I will take away the wool and linen clothing I gave her to cover her nakedness.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, I will take back My grain at harvest time And My new wine in its season. I will also take away My wool and My flax That I gave to cover her nakedness.
verses.textEn: "Therefore I will take away my grain when it ripens, and my new wine when it is ready. I will take back my wool and my linen, intended to cover her naked body.

verses.textZh: 那时，我要在她那些爱人眼前， 暴露她的下体； 也没有人能救她脱离我的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我要在她那些爱人眼前， 暴露她的下体； 也没有人能救她脱离我的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今我必在她所爱的眼前显露她的丑态； 必无人能救她脱离我的手。
verses.textEnNiv: So now I will expose her lewdness before the eyes of her lovers; no one will take her out of my hands.
verses.textEnEsv: Now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one shall rescue her out of my hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, And no one shall deliver her from My hand.
verses.textEnNlt: I will strip her naked in public, while all her lovers look on. No one will be able to rescue her from my hands.
verses.textEnNasb: "So now I will uncover her lewdness Before the eyes of her lovers, And no one will rescue her from My hand.
verses.textEn: So now I will expose her lewdness before the eyes of her lovers; no one will take her out of my hands.

verses.textZh: 我必使她的一切欢乐、 节期、新月、安息日， 或任何盛会都终止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使她的一切欢乐、 节期、新月、安息日， 或任何盛会都终止。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也必使她的宴乐、节期、月朔、安息日， 并她的一切大会都止息了。
verses.textEnNiv: I will stop all her celebrations: her yearly festivals, her New Moons, her Sabbath days—all her appointed festivals.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will put an end to all her mirth, her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her appointed feasts.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, Her feast days, Her New Moons, Her Sabbaths— All her appointed feasts.
verses.textEnNlt: I will put an end to her annual festivals, her new moon celebrations, and her Sabbath days— all her appointed festivals.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also put an end to all her joy, Her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, And all her festivals.
verses.textEn: I will stop all her celebrations: her yearly festivals, her New Moons, her Sabbath days—all her appointed festivals.

verses.textZh: 我必毁坏她的葡萄树和无花果树， 就是她曾说：‘这是我作妓女所赚的， 是我那些爱人给我的。’ 我必使这些果树成为荒林， 任由田野的走兽吃掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必毁坏她的葡萄树和无花果树， 就是她曾说：‘这是我作妓女所赚的， 是我那些爱人给我的。’ 我必使这些果树成为荒林， 任由田野的走兽吃掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也必毁坏她的葡萄树和无花果树， 就是她说「这是我所爱的给我为赏赐」的。 我必使这些树变为荒林， 为田野的走兽所吃。
verses.textEnNiv: I will ruin her vines and her fig trees, which she said were her pay from her lovers; I will make them a thicket, and wild animals will devour them.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees, of which she said, ‘These are my wages, which my lovers have given me.’ I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall devour them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, Of which she has said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers have given me.’ So I will make them a forest, And the beasts of the field shall eat them.
verses.textEnNlt: I will destroy her grapevines and fig trees, things she claims her lovers gave her. I will let them grow into tangled thickets, where only wild animals will eat the fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: "And I will destroy her vines and fig trees, Of which she said, ‘They are my wages for prostitution Which my lovers have given me.’ And I will turn them into a forest, And the animals of the field will devour them.
verses.textEn: I will ruin her vines and her fig trees, which she said were her pay from her lovers; I will make them a thicket, and wild animals will devour them.

verses.textZh: 她在拜众巴力的日子， 向他们烧香， 佩戴耳环首饰，打扮自己， 跟随她那些爱人，却把我遗忘，所以我必惩罚她。"这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她在拜众巴力的日子， 向他们烧香， 佩戴耳环首饰，打扮自己， 跟随她那些爱人，却把我遗忘，所以我必惩罚她。"这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必追讨她素日给诸巴力烧香的罪； 那时她佩带耳环和别样妆饰， 随从她所爱的，却忘记我。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will punish her for the days she burned incense to the Baals; she decked herself with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers, but me she forgot," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And I will punish her for the feast days of the Baals when she burned offerings to them and adorned herself with her ring and jewelry, and went after her lovers and forgot me, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will punish her For the days of the Baals to which she burned incense. She decked herself with her earrings and jewelry, And went after her lovers; But Me she forgot," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will punish her for all those times when she burned incense to her images of Baal, when she put on her earrings and jewels and went out to look for her lovers but forgot all about me," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "I will punish her for the days of the Baals When she used to offer sacrifices to them And adorn herself with her nose ring and jewelry, And follow her lovers, so that she forgot Me," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will punish her for the days she burned incense to the Baals; she decked herself with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers, but me she forgot," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "因此，我要诱导她， 领她到旷野， 对她说安慰的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，我要诱导她， 领她到旷野， 对她说安慰的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来我必劝导她，领她到旷野， 对她说安慰的话。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore I am now going to allure her; I will lead her into the wilderness and speak tenderly to her.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore, behold, I will allure her, Will bring her into the wilderness, And speak comfort to her.
verses.textEnNlt: "But then I will win her back once again. I will lead her into the desert and speak tenderly to her there.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, behold, I am going to persuade her, Bring her into the wilderness, And speak kindly to her.
verses.textEn: "Therefore I am now going to allure her; I will lead her into the wilderness and speak tenderly to her.

verses.textZh: 在那里我要把葡萄园归还给她， 使亚割谷变成‘希望之门’。 她必在那里回应，像她少年的时候一样， 也像她从埃及地上来的那天一般。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里我要把葡萄园归还给她， 使亚割谷变成‘希望之门’。 她必在那里回应，像她少年的时候一样， 也像她从埃及地上来的那天一般。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她从那里出来，我必赐她葡萄园， 又赐她亚割谷作为指望的门。 她必在那里应声 ， 与幼年的日子一样， 与从埃及地上来的时候相同。
verses.textEnNiv: There I will give her back her vineyards, and will make the Valley of Achor a door of hope. There she will respond as in the days of her youth, as in the day she came up out of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And there I will give her her vineyards and make the Valley of Achor a door of hope. And there she shall answer as in the days of her youth, as at the time when she came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will give her her vineyards from there, And the Valley of Achor as a door of hope; She shall sing there, As in the days of her youth, As in the day when she came up from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: I will return her vineyards to her and transform the Valley of Trouble into a gateway of hope. She will give herself to me there, as she did long ago when she was young, when I freed her from her captivity in Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I will give her her vineyards from there, And the Valley of Achor as a door of hope. And she will respond there as in the days of her youth, As in the day when she went up from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: There I will give her back her vineyards, and will make the Valley of Achor a door of hope. There she will respond as in the days of her youth, as in the day she came up out of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："到那日， 你必称呼我‘伊施’ ， 不再称呼我‘巴力’ 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："到那日， 你必称呼我‘伊施’ ， 不再称呼我‘巴力’ 。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「那日你必称呼我伊施 ，不再称呼我巴力 ；
verses.textEnNiv: "In that day," declares the Lord , "you will call me ‘my husband’; you will no longer call me ‘my master. ’
verses.textEnEsv: "And in that day, declares the Lord , you will call me ‘My Husband,’ and no longer will you call me ‘My Baal.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it shall be, in that day," Says the Lord, "That you will call Me ‘My Husband,’ And no longer call Me ‘My Master,’
verses.textEnNlt: When that day comes," says the Lord , "you will call me ‘my husband’ instead of ‘my master.’
verses.textEnNasb: "And it will come about on that day," declares the Lord, "That you will call Me my husband And no longer call Me my Baal.
verses.textEn: "In that day," declares the Lord , "you will call me ‘my husband’; you will no longer call me ‘my master. ’

verses.textZh: 我要把‘巴力’的名字从她口中除掉； 他们的名字没有人再提起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把‘巴力’的名字从她口中除掉； 他们的名字没有人再提起。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我必从我民的口中除掉诸巴力的名号，这名号不再提起。
verses.textEnNiv: I will remove the names of the Baals from her lips; no longer will their names be invoked.
verses.textEnEsv: For I will remove the names of the Baals from her mouth, and they shall be remembered by name no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will take from her mouth the names of the Baals, And they shall be remembered by their name no more.
verses.textEnNlt: O Israel, I will wipe the many names of Baal from your lips, and you will never mention them again.
verses.textEnNasb: "For I will remove the names of the Baals from her mouth, So that they will no longer be mentioned by their names.
verses.textEn: I will remove the names of the Baals from her lips; no longer will their names be invoked.

verses.textZh: 到那日，为了他们， 我必和田野的走兽、 空中的飞鸟、 地上爬行的动物立约； 我必从这地折断弓弩、刀剑和兵器 ； 使他们安然居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，为了他们， 我必和田野的走兽、 空中的飞鸟、 地上爬行的动物立约； 我必从这地折断弓弩、刀剑和兵器 ； 使他们安然居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，我必为我的民，与田野的走兽和空中的飞鸟，并地上的昆虫立约；又必在国中折断弓刀，止息争战，使他们安然躺卧。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, the birds in the sky and the creatures that move along the ground. Bow and sword and battle I will abolish from the land, so that all may lie down in safety.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make for them a covenant on that day with the beasts of the field, the birds of the heavens, and the creeping things of the ground. And I will abolish the bow, the sword, and war from the land, and I will make you lie down in safety.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day I will make a covenant for them With the beasts of the field, With the birds of the air, And with the creeping things of the ground. Bow and sword of battle I will shatter from the earth, To make them lie down safely.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day I will make a covenant with all the wild animals and the birds of the sky and the animals that scurry along the ground so they will not harm you. I will remove all weapons of war from the land, all swords and bows, so you can live unafraid in peace and safety.
verses.textEnNasb: "On that day I will also make a covenant for them With the animals of the field, The birds of the sky, And the crawling things of the ground. And I will eliminate the bow, the sword, and war from the land, And will let them lie down in safety.
verses.textEn: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, the birds in the sky and the creatures that move along the ground. Bow and sword and battle I will abolish from the land, so that all may lie down in safety.

verses.textZh: 我必聘你永远归我， 以公义、正直、 忠信和怜悯聘你归我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必聘你永远归我， 以公义、正直、 忠信和怜悯聘你归我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必聘你永远归我为妻，以仁义、公平、慈爱、怜悯聘你归我；
verses.textEnNiv: I will betroth you to me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in love and compassion.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will betroth you to me forever. I will betroth you to me in righteousness and in justice, in steadfast love and in mercy.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will betroth you to Me forever; Yes, I will betroth you to Me In righteousness and justice, In lovingkindness and mercy;
verses.textEnNlt: I will make you my wife forever, showing you righteousness and justice, unfailing love and compassion.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will betroth you to Me forever; Yes, I will betroth you to Me in righteousness and in justice, In favor and in compassion,
verses.textEn: I will betroth you to me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in love and compassion.

verses.textZh: 我必以信实聘你归我； 这样，你就必认识耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必以信实聘你归我； 这样，你就必认识耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 也以诚实聘你归我，你就必认识我－耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will acknowledge the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will betroth you to me in faithfulness. And you shall know the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will betroth you to Me in faithfulness, And you shall know the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will be faithful to you and make you mine, and you will finally know me as the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And I will betroth you to Me in faithfulness. Then you will know the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will acknowledge the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："到那日，我必应允， 我必应允天，天必应允地，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："到那日，我必应允， 我必应允天，天必应允地，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：那日我必应允， 我必应允天，天必应允地；
verses.textEnNiv: "In that day I will respond," declares the Lord — "I will respond to the skies, and they will respond to the earth;
verses.textEnEsv: "And in that day I will answer, declares the Lord , I will answer the heavens, and they shall answer the earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: "It shall come to pass in that day That I will answer," says the Lord; "I will answer the heavens, And they shall answer the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "In that day, I will answer," says the Lord . "I will answer the sky as it pleads for clouds. And the sky will answer the earth with rain.
verses.textEnNasb: "And it will come about on that day that I will respond," declares the Lord. "I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth,
verses.textEn: "In that day I will respond," declares the Lord — "I will respond to the skies, and they will respond to the earth;

verses.textZh: 地必应允五谷、新酒和油。 这些必应允耶斯列 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地必应允五谷、新酒和油。 这些必应允耶斯列 。
verses.textZhCuv: 地必应允五谷、新酒，和油， 这些必应允耶斯列民 。
verses.textEnNiv: and the earth will respond to the grain, the new wine and the olive oil, and they will respond to Jezreel.
verses.textEnEsv: and the earth shall answer the grain, the wine, and the oil, and they shall answer Jezreel,
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth shall answer With grain, With new wine, And with oil; They shall answer Jezreel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the earth will answer the thirsty cries of the grain, the grapevines, and the olive trees. And they in turn will answer, ‘Jezreel’—‘God plants!’
verses.textEnNasb: And the earth will respond to the grain, to the new wine, and to the oil, And they will respond to Jezreel.
verses.textEn: and the earth will respond to the grain, the new wine and the olive oil, and they will respond to Jezreel.

verses.textZh: 我必为了自己把她栽种在这地。 我必怜恤罗．路哈玛 。 我必对罗．阿米 说： ‘你是我的子民’， 他必说：‘你是我的神。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必为了自己把她栽种在这地。 我必怜恤罗．路哈玛 。 我必对罗．阿米 说： ‘你是我的子民’， 他必说：‘你是我的神。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将她种在这地。 素不蒙怜悯的，我必怜悯； 本非我民的，我必对他说： 你是我的民； 他必说：你是我的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will plant her for myself in the land; I will show my love to the one I called ‘Not my loved one. ’ I will say to those called ‘Not my people, ’ ‘You are my people’; and they will say, ‘You are my God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: and I will sow her for myself in the land. And I will have mercy on No Mercy, and I will say to Not My People, ‘You are my people’; and he shall say, ‘You are my God.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will sow her for Myself in the earth, And I will have mercy on herwhohad not obtained mercy; Then I will say to thosewhowere not My people, ‘You are My people!’ And they shall say, ‘You are my God!’ "
verses.textEnNlt: At that time I will plant a crop of Israelites and raise them for myself. I will show love to those I called ‘Not loved.’ And to those I called ‘Not my people,’ I will say, ‘Now you are my people.’ And they will reply, ‘You are our God!’"
verses.textEnNasb: "I will sow her for Myself in the land. I will also have compassion on her who had not obtained compassion, And I will say to those who were not My people, ‘You are My people!’ And they will say, ‘You are my God!’ "
verses.textEn: I will plant her for myself in the land; I will show my love to the one I called ‘Not my loved one. ’ I will say to those called ‘Not my people, ’ ‘You are my people’; and they will say, ‘You are my God.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说："你再去爱一个妇人，这妇人是为情人所爱，又是个淫妇，就像耶和华爱以色列人，虽然他们转去跟随别神，喜爱葡萄饼。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说："你再去爱一个妇人，这妇人是为情人所爱，又是个淫妇，就像耶和华爱以色列人，虽然他们转去跟随别神，喜爱葡萄饼。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：「你再去爱一个淫妇，就是她情人所爱的；好像以色列人，虽然偏向别神，喜爱葡萄饼，耶和华还是爱他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to me, "Go, show your love to your wife again, though she is loved by another man and is an adulteress. Love her as the Lord loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and love the sacred raisin cakes."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to me, "Go again, love a woman who is loved by another man and is an adulteress, even as the Lord loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods and love cakes of raisins."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to me, "Go again, love a woman whois loved by a lover and is committing adultery, just like the love of the Lord for the children of Israel, who look to other gods and love the raisin cakes ofthepagans."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, "Go and love your wife again, even though she commits adultery with another lover. This will illustrate that the Lord still loves Israel, even though the people have turned to other gods and love to worship them. "
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to me, "Go again, love a woman who is loved by her husband, yet is committing adultery, as the Lord loves the sons of Israel, though they turn to other gods and love raisin cakes."
verses.textEn: The Lord said to me, "Go, show your love to your wife again, though she is loved by another man and is an adulteress. Love her as the Lord loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and love the sacred raisin cakes."

verses.textZh: 于是，我用一百七十一克银子，一百五十公斤大麦，买她回来归我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，我用一百七十一克银子，一百五十公斤大麦，买她回来归我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我便用银子十五舍客勒，大麦一贺梅珥半，买她归我。
verses.textEnNiv: So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and about a homer and a lethek of barley.
verses.textEnEsv: So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and a homer and a lethech of barley.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I bought her for myself for fifteen shekels of silver, and one and one-half homers of barley.
verses.textEnNlt: So I bought her back for fifteen pieces of silver and five bushels of barley and a measure of wine.
verses.textEnNasb: So I purchased her for myself for fifteen shekels of silver, and a homer and a lethech of barley.
verses.textEn: So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and about a homer and a lethek of barley.

verses.textZh: 我对她说："你要给我独居多日，不要行淫，不要有别的男人，我也必不与你同房。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对她说："你要给我独居多日，不要行淫，不要有别的男人，我也必不与你同房。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我对她说：「你当多日为我独居，不可行淫，不可归别人为妻，我向你也必这样。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I told her, "You are to live with me many days; you must not be a prostitute or be intimate with any man, and I will behave the same way toward you."
verses.textEnEsv: And I said to her, "You must dwell as mine for many days. You shall not play the whore, or belong to another man; so will I also be to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said to her, "You shall stay with me many days; you shall not play the harlot, nor shall you have a man—so, too, will I be toward you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said to her, "You must live in my house for many days and stop your prostitution. During this time, you will not have sexual relations with anyone, not even with me. "
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said to her, "You shall live with me for many days. You shall not play the prostitute, nor shall you have another man; so I will also be toward you."
verses.textEn: Then I told her, "You are to live with me many days; you must not be a prostitute or be intimate with any man, and I will behave the same way toward you."

verses.textZh: 因为以色列人也要独居多日；没有君王，没有领袖，没有祭祀，没有柱像，没有以弗得，也没有家中的神像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为以色列人也要独居多日；没有君王，没有领袖，没有祭祀，没有柱像，没有以弗得，也没有家中的神像。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人也必多日独居，无君王，无首领，无祭祀，无柱像，无以弗得，无家中的神像。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Israelites will live many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred stones, without ephod or household gods.
verses.textEnEsv: For the children of Israel shall dwell many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or pillar, without ephod or household gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred pillar, without ephod or teraphim.
verses.textEnNlt: This shows that Israel will go a long time without a king or prince, and without sacrifices, sacred pillars, priests, or even idols!
verses.textEnNasb: For the sons of Israel will live for many days without a king or leader, without sacrifice or memorial stone, and without ephod or household idols.
verses.textEn: For the Israelites will live many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred stones, without ephod or household gods.

verses.textZh: 后来以色列人必归回，寻求耶和华他们的神，寻求大卫他们的王。在末后的日子，他们必战战兢兢来到耶和华那里，接受他的恩惠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来以色列人必归回，寻求耶和华他们的神，寻求大卫他们的王。在末后的日子，他们必战战兢兢来到耶和华那里，接受他的恩惠。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来以色列人必归回 ，寻求他们的神－耶和华和他们的王大卫。在末后的日子，必以敬畏的心归向耶和华，领受他的恩惠。
verses.textEnNiv: Afterward the Israelites will return and seek the Lord their God and David their king. They will come trembling to the Lord and to his blessings in the last days.
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the Lord their God, and David their king, and they shall come in fear to the Lord and to his goodness in the latter days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the Lord their God and David their king. They shall fear the Lord and His goodness in the latter days.
verses.textEnNlt: But afterward the people will return and devote themselves to the Lord their God and to David’s descendant, their king. In the last days, they will tremble in awe of the Lord and of his goodness.
verses.textEnNasb: Afterward the sons of Israel will return and seek the Lord their God and David their king; and they will come trembling to the Lord and to His goodness in the last days.
verses.textEn: Afterward the Israelites will return and seek the Lord their God and David their king. They will come trembling to the Lord and to his blessings in the last days.

verses.textZh: 以色列人哪！你们要听耶和华的话。 耶和华要与这地的居民争辩， 因为在这地上没有诚实，没有慈爱， 也没有认识神的知识；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人哪！你们要听耶和华的话。 耶和华要与这地的居民争辩， 因为在这地上没有诚实，没有慈爱， 也没有认识神的知识；
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人哪，你们当听耶和华的话。 耶和华与这地的居民争辩， 因这地上无诚实， 无良善，无人认识神。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear the word of the Lord , you Israelites, because the Lord has a charge to bring against you who live in the land: "There is no faithfulness, no love, no acknowledgment of God in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear the word of the Lord , O children of Israel, for the Lord has a controversy with the inhabitants of the land. There is no faithfulness or steadfast love, and no knowledge of God in the land;
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear the word of the Lord, You children of Israel, For the Lordbrings a charge against the inhabitants of the land: "There is no truth or mercy Or knowledge of God in the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Hear the word of the Lord , O people of Israel! The Lord has brought charges against you, saying: "There is no faithfulness, no kindness, no knowledge of God in your land.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen to the word of the Lord, you sons of Israel, Because the Lord has a case against the inhabitants of the land, For there is no faithfulness, nor loyalty, Nor knowledge of God in the land.
verses.textEn: Hear the word of the Lord , you Israelites, because the Lord has a charge to bring against you who live in the land: "There is no faithfulness, no love, no acknowledgment of God in the land.

verses.textZh: 只有起假誓、撒谎、残杀、偷盗、奸淫、行强暴，以至流人血事件相继而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有起假誓、撒谎、残杀、偷盗、奸淫、行强暴，以至流人血事件相继而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 但起假誓，不践前言， 杀害，偷盗，奸淫，行强暴， 杀人流血，接连不断。
verses.textEnNiv: There is only cursing, lying and murder, stealing and adultery; they break all bounds, and bloodshed follows bloodshed.
verses.textEnEsv: there is swearing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break all bounds, and bloodshed follows bloodshed.
verses.textEnNkjv: By swearing and lying, Killing and stealing and committing adultery, They break all restraint, With bloodshed upon bloodshed.
verses.textEnNlt: You make vows and break them; you kill and steal and commit adultery. There is violence everywhere— one murder after another.
verses.textEnNasb: There is oath-taking, denial, murder, stealing, and adultery. They employ violence, so that bloodshed follows bloodshed.
verses.textEn: There is only cursing, lying and murder, stealing and adultery; they break all bounds, and bloodshed follows bloodshed.

verses.textZh: 因此，这地必悲哀， 地上所有的居民、 田野的走兽、空中的飞鸟都必衰微、枯萎，连海里的鱼也要灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，这地必悲哀， 地上所有的居民、 田野的走兽、空中的飞鸟都必衰微、枯萎，连海里的鱼也要灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，这地悲哀， 其上的民、田野的兽、 空中的鸟必都衰微， 海中的鱼也必消灭。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of this the land dries up, and all who live in it waste away; the beasts of the field, the birds in the sky and the fish in the sea are swept away.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the land mourns, and all who dwell in it languish, and also the beasts of the field and the birds of the heavens, and even the fish of the sea are taken away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the land will mourn; And everyone who dwells there will waste away With the beasts of the field And the birds of the air; Even the fish of the sea will be taken away.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why your land is in mourning, and everyone is wasting away. Even the wild animals, the birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea are disappearing.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the land mourns, And everyone who lives in it languishes Along with the animals of the field and the birds of the sky, And even the fish of the sea disappear.
verses.textEn: Because of this the land dries up, and all who live in it waste away; the beasts of the field, the birds in the sky and the fish in the sea are swept away.

verses.textZh: 虽然这样，人人都不必争论，不要彼此指责。 你的民像争辩的祭司一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然这样，人人都不必争论，不要彼此指责。 你的民像争辩的祭司一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，人都不必争辩，也不必指责， 因为这民与抗拒祭司的人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "But let no one bring a charge, let no one accuse another, for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet let no one contend, and let none accuse, for with you is my contention, O priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now let no man contend, or rebuke another; For your people are like those who contend with the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t point your finger at someone else and try to pass the blame! My complaint, you priests, is with you.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet let no one find fault, and let no one rebuke; For your people are like those who contend with a priest.
verses.textEn: "But let no one bring a charge, let no one accuse another, for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.

verses.textZh: 白天你要跌倒， 晚上先知也必与你一同跌倒； 我要毁灭你的母亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 白天你要跌倒， 晚上先知也必与你一同跌倒； 我要毁灭你的母亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 你这祭司必日间跌倒； 先知也必夜间与你一同跌倒； 我必灭绝你的母亲。
verses.textEnNiv: You stumble day and night, and the prophets stumble with you. So I will destroy your mother—
verses.textEnEsv: You shall stumble by day; the prophet also shall stumble with you by night; and I will destroy your mother.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you shall stumble in the day; The prophet also shall stumble with you in the night; And I will destroy your mother.
verses.textEnNlt: So you will stumble in broad daylight, and your false prophets will fall with you in the night. And I will destroy Israel, your mother.
verses.textEnNasb: So you will stumble by day, And the prophet also will stumble with you by night; And I will destroy your mother.
verses.textEn: You stumble day and night, and the prophets stumble with you. So I will destroy your mother—

verses.textZh: 我的子民因无知识而灭亡； 因为你拒绝了知识， 我必拒绝你，不让你作我的祭司； 因为你忘掉了你神的律法， 我也必忘记你的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的子民因无知识而灭亡； 因为你拒绝了知识， 我必拒绝你，不让你作我的祭司； 因为你忘掉了你神的律法， 我也必忘记你的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的民因无知识而灭亡。 你弃掉知识， 我也必弃掉你， 使你不再给我作祭司。 你既忘了你神的律法， 我也必忘记你的儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: my people are destroyed from lack of knowledge. "Because you have rejected knowledge, I also reject you as my priests; because you have ignored the law of your God, I also will ignore your children.
verses.textEnEsv: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge; because you have rejected knowledge, I reject you from being a priest to me. And since you have forgotten the law of your God, I also will forget your children.
verses.textEnNkjv: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I also will reject you from being priest for Me; Because you have forgotten the law of your God, I also will forget your children.
verses.textEnNlt: My people are being destroyed because they don’t know me. Since you priests refuse to know me, I refuse to recognize you as my priests. Since you have forgotten the laws of your God, I will forget to bless your children.
verses.textEnNasb: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Since you have rejected knowledge, I also will reject you from being My priest. Since you have forgotten the Law of your God, I also will forget your children.
verses.textEn: my people are destroyed from lack of knowledge. "Because you have rejected knowledge, I also reject you as my priests; because you have ignored the law of your God, I also will ignore your children.

verses.textZh: 祭司越增多，就越发得罪我， 我必把他们的尊荣变为耻辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司越增多，就越发得罪我， 我必把他们的尊荣变为耻辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司越发增多，就越发得罪我； 我必使他们的荣耀变为羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: The more priests there were, the more they sinned against me; they exchanged their glorious God for something disgraceful.
verses.textEnEsv: The more they increased, the more they sinned against me; I will change their glory into shame.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The more they increased, The more they sinned against Me; I will change their glory into shame.
verses.textEnNlt: The more priests there are, the more they sin against me. They have exchanged the glory of God for the shame of idols.
verses.textEnNasb: The more they multiplied, the more they sinned against Me; I will change their glory into shame.
verses.textEn: The more priests there were, the more they sinned against me; they exchanged their glorious God for something disgraceful.

verses.textZh: 他们借着我的子民犯罪来养活自己， 渴望他们多有罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们借着我的子民犯罪来养活自己， 渴望他们多有罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们吃我民的赎罪祭， 满心愿意我民犯罪。
verses.textEnNiv: They feed on the sins of my people and relish their wickedness.
verses.textEnEsv: They feed on the sin of my people; they are greedy for their iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: They eat up the sin of My people; They set their heart on their iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: "When the people bring their sin offerings, the priests get fed. So the priests are glad when the people sin!
verses.textEnNasb: They feed on the sin of My people, And long for their wrongdoing.
verses.textEn: They feed on the sins of my people and relish their wickedness.

verses.textZh: 所以，祭司怎样，人民也怎样。 我必按他们的行为惩罚他们， 照他们的行为报应他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，祭司怎样，人民也怎样。 我必按他们的行为惩罚他们， 照他们的行为报应他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 将来民如何， 祭司也必如何； 我必因他们所行的惩罚他们， 照他们所做的报应他们。
verses.textEnNiv: And it will be: Like people, like priests. I will punish both of them for their ways and repay them for their deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall be like people, like priest; I will punish them for their ways and repay them for their deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be: like people, like priest. So I will punish them for their ways, And reward them for their deeds.
verses.textEnNlt: ‘And what the priests do, the people also do.’ So now I will punish both priests and people for their wicked deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will be, like people, like priest; So I will punish them for their ways And repay them for their deeds.
verses.textEn: And it will be: Like people, like priests. I will punish both of them for their ways and repay them for their deeds.

verses.textZh: 他们吃，却吃不饱； 行淫，人数却不会增多； 因为他们离弃了耶和华，不遵守他的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们吃，却吃不饱； 行淫，人数却不会增多； 因为他们离弃了耶和华，不遵守他的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们吃，却不得饱； 行淫，而不得立后； 因为他们离弃耶和华， 不遵他的命。
verses.textEnNiv: "They will eat but not have enough; they will engage in prostitution but not flourish, because they have deserted the Lord to give themselves
verses.textEnEsv: They shall eat, but not be satisfied; they shall play the whore, but not multiply, because they have forsaken the Lord to cherish
verses.textEnNkjv: For they shall eat, but not have enough; They shall commit harlotry, but not increase; Because they have ceased obeying the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: They will eat and still be hungry. They will play the prostitute and gain nothing from it, for they have deserted the Lord
verses.textEnNasb: They will eat, but not have enough; They will play the prostitute, but not increase, Because they gave up devoting themselves to the Lord.
verses.textEn: "They will eat but not have enough; they will engage in prostitution but not flourish, because they have deserted the Lord to give themselves

verses.textZh: 淫行、酒和新酒，把人的心夺走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 淫行、酒和新酒，把人的心夺走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 奸淫和酒，并新酒， 夺去人的心。
verses.textEnNiv: to prostitution; old wine and new wine take away their understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: whoredom, wine, and new wine, which take away the understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Harlotry, wine, and new wine enslave the heart.
verses.textEnNlt: to worship other gods. "Wine has robbed my people of their understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: Infidelity, wine, and new wine take away the understanding.
verses.textEn: to prostitution; old wine and new wine take away their understanding.

verses.textZh: 我的子民求问木头，由木杖引导他们， 因为淫荡的灵使他们走迷了路， 他们就行淫不顺从神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的子民求问木头，由木杖引导他们， 因为淫荡的灵使他们走迷了路， 他们就行淫不顺从神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的民求问木偶， 以为木杖能指示他们； 因为他们的淫心使他们失迷， 他们就行淫离弃神， 不守约束，
verses.textEnNiv: My people consult a wooden idol, and a diviner’s rod speaks to them. A spirit of prostitution leads them astray; they are unfaithful to their God.
verses.textEnEsv: My people inquire of a piece of wood, and their walking staff gives them oracles. For a spirit of whoredom has led them astray, and they have left their God to play the whore.
verses.textEnNkjv: My people ask counsel from their wooden idols, And their staff informs them. For the spirit of harlotry has caused them to stray, And they have played the harlot against their God.
verses.textEnNlt: They ask a piece of wood for advice! They think a stick can tell them the future! Longing after idols has made them foolish. They have played the prostitute, serving other gods and deserting their God.
verses.textEnNasb: My people consult their wooden idol, and their diviner’s wand informs them; For a spirit of infidelity has led them astray, And they have been unfaithful, departing from their God.
verses.textEn: My people consult a wooden idol, and a diviner’s rod speaks to them. A spirit of prostitution leads them astray; they are unfaithful to their God.

verses.textZh: 他们在山顶上献祭， 在冈陵上的橡树、杨树和栗树之下献祭烧香， 因为树荫美好。 所以你们的女儿行淫乱， 你们的儿媳犯奸淫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在山顶上献祭， 在冈陵上的橡树、杨树和栗树之下献祭烧香， 因为树荫美好。 所以你们的女儿行淫乱， 你们的儿媳犯奸淫。
verses.textZhCuv: 在各山顶，各高冈的橡树、 杨树、栗树之下，献祭烧香， 因为树影美好。 所以，你们的女儿淫乱， 你们的新妇 行淫。
verses.textEnNiv: They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn offerings on the hills, under oak, poplar and terebinth, where the shade is pleasant. Therefore your daughters turn to prostitution and your daughters-in-law to adultery.
verses.textEnEsv: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains and burn offerings on the hills, under oak, poplar, and terebinth, because their shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the whore, and your brides commit adultery.
verses.textEnNkjv: They offer sacrifices on the mountaintops, And burn incense on the hills, Under oaks, poplars, and terebinths, Because their shade is good. Therefore your daughters commit harlotry, And your brides commit adultery.
verses.textEnNlt: They offer sacrifices to idols on the mountaintops. They go up into the hills to burn incense in the pleasant shade of oaks, poplars, and terebinth trees. "That is why your daughters turn to prostitution, and your daughters-in-law commit adultery.
verses.textEnNasb: They offer sacrifices on the tops of the mountains And burn incense on the hills, Under oak, poplar, and terebinth, Because their shade is pleasant. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, And your brides commit adultery.
verses.textEn: They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn offerings on the hills, under oak, poplar and terebinth, where the shade is pleasant. Therefore your daughters turn to prostitution and your daughters-in-law to adultery.

verses.textZh: 我却不因你们的女儿行淫乱， 也不因你们的儿媳犯奸淫而惩罚她们， 因为你们男人自己离群与娼妓在一起， 又与庙妓一同献祭。 这无知的人民必遭毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我却不因你们的女儿行淫乱， 也不因你们的儿媳犯奸淫而惩罚她们， 因为你们男人自己离群与娼妓在一起， 又与庙妓一同献祭。 这无知的人民必遭毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的女儿淫乱， 你们的新妇行淫， 我却不惩罚她们； 因为你们自己离群与娼妓同居， 与妓女一同献祭。 这无知的民必致倾倒。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will not punish your daughters when they turn to prostitution, nor your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery, because the men themselves consort with harlots and sacrifice with shrine prostitutes— a people without understanding will come to ruin!
verses.textEnEsv: I will not punish your daughters when they play the whore, nor your brides when they commit adultery; for the men themselves go aside with prostitutes and sacrifice with cult prostitutes, and a people without understanding shall come to ruin.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will not punish your daughters when they commit harlotry, Nor your brides when they commit adultery; For themen themselves go apart with harlots, And offer sacrifices with a ritual harlot. Therefore people who do not understand will be trampled.
verses.textEnNlt: But why should I punish them for their prostitution and adultery? For your men are doing the same thing, sinning with whores and shrine prostitutes. O foolish people! You refuse to understand, so you will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, Or your brides when they commit adultery, Because the men themselves slip away with the prostitutes And offer sacrifices with temple prostitutes; So the people without understanding are ruined.
verses.textEn: "I will not punish your daughters when they turn to prostitution, nor your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery, because the men themselves consort with harlots and sacrifice with shrine prostitutes— a people without understanding will come to ruin!

verses.textZh: 以色列啊！你虽然行淫， 犹大却不可犯罪， 不要往吉甲去， 不要上到伯．亚文， 也不要指着永活的耶和华起誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列啊！你虽然行淫， 犹大却不可犯罪， 不要往吉甲去， 不要上到伯．亚文， 也不要指着永活的耶和华起誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列啊，你虽然行淫， 犹大却不可犯罪。 不要往吉甲去， 不要上到伯‧亚文， 也不要指着永生的耶和华起誓。
verses.textEnNiv: "Though you, Israel, commit adultery, do not let Judah become guilty. "Do not go to Gilgal; do not go up to Beth Aven. And do not swear, ‘As surely as the Lord lives!’
verses.textEnEsv: Though you play the whore, O Israel, let not Judah become guilty. Enter not into Gilgal, nor go up to Beth-aven, and swear not, "As the Lord lives."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Though you, Israel, play the harlot, Let not Judah offend. Do not come up to Gilgal, Nor go up to Beth Aven, Nor swear an oath, saying, ‘As the Lord lives’—
verses.textEnNlt: "Though you, Israel, are a prostitute, may Judah not be guilty of such things. Do not join the false worship at Gilgal or Beth-aven, and do not take oaths there in the Lord ’s name.
verses.textEnNasb: Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, Judah must not become guilty; Also you are not to go to Gilgal, Nor go up to Beth-aven And take the oath: "As the Lord lives!"
verses.textEn: "Though you, Israel, commit adultery, do not let Judah become guilty. "Do not go to Gilgal; do not go up to Beth Aven. And do not swear, ‘As surely as the Lord lives!’

verses.textZh: 以色列倔强， 好象倔强的母牛， 现在耶和华怎样牧放他们， 好象牧放宽阔草场上的羊羔呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列倔强， 好象倔强的母牛， 现在耶和华怎样牧放他们， 好象牧放宽阔草场上的羊羔呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列倔强， 犹如倔强的母牛； 现在耶和华要放他们， 如同放羊羔在宽阔之地。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites are stubborn, like a stubborn heifer. How then can the Lord pasture them like lambs in a meadow?
verses.textEnEsv: Like a stubborn heifer, Israel is stubborn; can the Lord now feed them like a lamb in a broad pasture?
verses.textEnNkjv: "For Israel is stubborn Like a stubborn calf; Now the Lord will let them forage Like a lamb in open country.
verses.textEnNlt: Israel is stubborn, like a stubborn heifer. So should the Lord feed her like a lamb in a lush pasture?
verses.textEnNasb: Since Israel is stubborn Like a stubborn cow, Will the Lord now pasture them Like a lamb in a large field?
verses.textEn: The Israelites are stubborn, like a stubborn heifer. How then can the Lord pasture them like lambs in a meadow?

verses.textZh: 以法莲和偶像连在一起， 任凭他吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲和偶像连在一起， 任凭他吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲亲近偶像， 任凭他吧！
verses.textEnNiv: Ephraim is joined to idols; leave him alone!
verses.textEnEsv: Ephraim is joined to idols; leave him alone.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Ephraim is joined to idols, Let him alone.
verses.textEnNlt: Leave Israel alone, because she is married to idolatry.
verses.textEnNasb: Ephraim is allied with idols; Leave him alone.
verses.textEn: Ephraim is joined to idols; leave him alone!

verses.textZh: 他们醉意全消以后， 就不断行淫； 他们的官长最喜爱耻辱的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们醉意全消以后， 就不断行淫； 他们的官长最喜爱耻辱的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们所喝的已经发酸， 他们时常行淫， 他们的官长最爱羞耻的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Even when their drinks are gone, they continue their prostitution; their rulers dearly love shameful ways.
verses.textEnEsv: When their drink is gone, they give themselves to whoring; their rulers dearly love shame.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their drink is rebellion, They commit harlotry continually. Her rulers dearly love dishonor.
verses.textEnNlt: When the rulers of Israel finish their drinking, off they go to find some prostitutes. They love shame more than honor.
verses.textEnNasb: Their liquor is gone, They prostitute themselves continually; Their rulers dearly love shame.
verses.textEn: Even when their drinks are gone, they continue their prostitution; their rulers dearly love shameful ways.

verses.textZh: 风要把他们裹在翅膀里卷去， 他们必因自己所献的祭祀而蒙受羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 风要把他们裹在翅膀里卷去， 他们必因自己所献的祭祀而蒙受羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 风把他们裹在翅膀里； 他们因所献的祭必致蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: A whirlwind will sweep them away, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.
verses.textEnEsv: A wind has wrapped them in its wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings, And they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
verses.textEnNlt: So a mighty wind will sweep them away. Their sacrifices to idols will bring them shame.
verses.textEnNasb: The wind wraps them in its wings, And they will be put to shame because of their sacrifices.
verses.textEn: A whirlwind will sweep them away, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.

verses.textZh: 祭司啊，你们要听这话！ 以色列家啊，你们要留心听！ 王的家啊，你们要侧耳而听！ 因为审判必临到你们， 因你们曾是米斯巴地的捕鸟机， 是他泊山上张开的网罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司啊，你们要听这话！ 以色列家啊，你们要留心听！ 王的家啊，你们要侧耳而听！ 因为审判必临到你们， 因你们曾是米斯巴地的捕鸟机， 是他泊山上张开的网罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 众祭司啊，要听我的话！ 以色列家啊，要留心听！ 王家啊，要侧耳而听！ 审判要临到你们， 因你们在米斯巴如网罗， 在他泊山如铺张的网。
verses.textEnNiv: "Hear this, you priests! Pay attention, you Israelites! Listen, royal house! This judgment is against you: You have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear this, O priests! Pay attention, O house of Israel! Give ear, O house of the king! For the judgment is for you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah and a net spread upon Tabor.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hear this, O priests! Take heed, O house of Israel! Give ear, O house of the king! For yours is the judgment, Because you have been a snare to Mizpah And a net spread on Tabor.
verses.textEnNlt: "Hear this, you priests. Pay attention, you leaders of Israel. Listen, you members of the royal family. Judgment has been handed down against you. For you have led the people into a snare by worshiping the idols at Mizpah and Tabor.
verses.textEnNasb: Hear this, you priests! Pay attention, house of Israel! Listen, you of the house of the king! For the judgment applies to you, Because you have been a trap at Mizpah, And a net spread out on Tabor.
verses.textEn: "Hear this, you priests! Pay attention, you Israelites! Listen, royal house! This judgment is against you: You have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.

verses.textZh: 他们在什亭掘深了陷阱， 但我要惩治他们所有的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在什亭掘深了陷阱， 但我要惩治他们所有的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些悖逆的人肆行杀戮， 罪孽极深； 我却斥责他们众人。
verses.textEnNiv: The rebels are knee-deep in slaughter. I will discipline all of them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the revolters have gone deep into slaughter, but I will discipline all of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The revolters are deeply involved in slaughter, Though I rebuke them all.
verses.textEnNlt: You have dug a deep pit to trap them at Acacia Grove. But I will settle with you for what you have done.
verses.textEnNasb: And the rebels have gone deep in depravity, But I will discipline all of them.
verses.textEn: The rebels are knee-deep in slaughter. I will discipline all of them.

verses.textZh: 我认识以法莲，以色列也瞒不住我； 以法莲啊！现在你竟行淫， 以色列竟玷污了自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我认识以法莲，以色列也瞒不住我； 以法莲啊！现在你竟行淫， 以色列竟玷污了自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲为我所知； 以色列不能向我隐藏。 以法莲哪，现在你行淫了， 以色列被玷污了。
verses.textEnNiv: I know all about Ephraim; Israel is not hidden from me. Ephraim, you have now turned to prostitution; Israel is corrupt.
verses.textEnEsv: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, O Ephraim, you have played the whore; Israel is defiled.
verses.textEnNkjv: I know Ephraim, And Israel is not hidden from Me; For now, O Ephraim, you commit harlotry; Israel is defiled.
verses.textEnNlt: I know what you are like, O Ephraim. You cannot hide yourself from me, O Israel. You have left me as a prostitute leaves her husband; you are utterly defiled.
verses.textEnNasb: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from Me; Because now, Ephraim, you have been unfaithful, Israel has defiled itself.
verses.textEn: I know all about Ephraim; Israel is not hidden from me. Ephraim, you have now turned to prostitution; Israel is corrupt.

verses.textZh: 他们所行的使他们不能回转， 归回自己的神； 因为在他们当中有淫乱的灵； 他们也不认识耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们所行的使他们不能回转， 归回自己的神； 因为在他们当中有淫乱的灵； 他们也不认识耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们所行的使他们不能归向神； 因有淫心在他们里面， 他们也不认识耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God. A spirit of prostitution is in their heart; they do not acknowledge the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God. For the spirit of whoredom is within them, and they know not the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "They do not direct their deeds Toward turning to their God, For the spirit of harlotry is in their midst, And they do not know the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Your deeds won’t let you return to your God. You are a prostitute through and through, and you do not know the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Their deeds will not allow them To return to their God. For a spirit of infidelity is within them, And they do not know the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God. A spirit of prostitution is in their heart; they do not acknowledge the Lord .

verses.textZh: 以色列的骄傲当面指证自己， 以色列和以法莲因自己的罪孽跌倒， 犹大也与他们一同跌倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的骄傲当面指证自己， 以色列和以法莲因自己的罪孽跌倒， 犹大也与他们一同跌倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的骄傲当面见证自己。 故此，以色列和以法莲必因自己的罪孽跌倒； 犹大也必与他们一同跌倒。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them; the Israelites, even Ephraim, stumble in their sin; Judah also stumbles with them.
verses.textEnEsv: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; Israel and Ephraim shall stumble in his guilt; Judah also shall stumble with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; Therefore Israel and Ephraim stumble in their iniquity; Judah also stumbles with them.
verses.textEnNlt: "The arrogance of Israel testifies against her; Israel and Ephraim will stumble under their load of guilt. Judah, too, will fall with them.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the pride of Israel testifies against him, And Israel and Ephraim stumble in their wrongdoing; Judah also has stumbled with them.
verses.textEn: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them; the Israelites, even Ephraim, stumble in their sin; Judah also stumbles with them.

verses.textZh: 虽然他们带着牛群羊群 去寻求耶和华，却寻不见； 他已经离开他们远去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然他们带着牛群羊群 去寻求耶和华，却寻不见； 他已经离开他们远去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必牵着牛羊去寻求耶和华，却寻不见； 他已经转去离开他们。
verses.textEnNiv: When they go with their flocks and herds to seek the Lord , they will not find him; he has withdrawn himself from them.
verses.textEnEsv: With their flocks and herds they shall go to seek the Lord , but they will not find him; he has withdrawn from them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "With their flocks and herds They shall go to seek the Lord, But they will not find Him; He has withdrawn Himself from them.
verses.textEnNlt: When they come with their flocks and herds to offer sacrifices to the Lord , they will not find him, because he has withdrawn from them.
verses.textEnNasb: They will go with their flocks and herds To seek the Lord, but they will not find Him; He has withdrawn from them.
verses.textEn: When they go with their flocks and herds to seek the Lord , they will not find him; he has withdrawn himself from them.

verses.textZh: 他们以诡诈待耶和华， 因为他们生了私生子。 现在新月要吞灭他们和他们的地业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们以诡诈待耶和华， 因为他们生了私生子。 现在新月要吞灭他们和他们的地业。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们向耶和华行事诡诈，生了私子。 到了月朔，他们与他们的地业必被吞灭。
verses.textEnNiv: They are unfaithful to the Lord ; they give birth to illegitimate children. When they celebrate their New Moon feasts, he will devour their fields.
verses.textEnEsv: They have dealt faithlessly with the Lord ; for they have borne alien children. Now the new moon shall devour them with their fields.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have dealt treacherously with the Lord, For they have begotten pagan children. Now a New Moon shall devour them and their heritage.
verses.textEnNlt: They have betrayed the honor of the Lord , bearing children that are not his. Now their false religion will devour them along with their wealth.
verses.textEnNasb: They have dealt treacherously with the Lord, For they have given birth to illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their land.
verses.textEn: They are unfaithful to the Lord ; they give birth to illegitimate children. When they celebrate their New Moon feasts, he will devour their fields.

verses.textZh: 你们要在基比亚吹角， 在拉玛吹号， 在伯．亚文大声吶喊： "便雅悯啊！敌人就在你背后。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要在基比亚吹角， 在拉玛吹号， 在伯．亚文大声吶喊： "便雅悯啊！敌人就在你背后。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当在基比亚吹角， 在拉玛吹号， 在伯‧亚文吹出大声，说： 便雅悯哪，有仇敌在你后头！
verses.textEnNiv: "Sound the trumpet in Gibeah, the horn in Ramah. Raise the battle cry in Beth Aven ; lead on, Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: Blow the horn in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah. Sound the alarm at Beth-aven; we follow you, O Benjamin!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Blow the ram’s horn in Gibeah, The trumpet in Ramah! Cry aloud at Beth Aven, ‘Look behind you, O Benjamin!’
verses.textEnNlt: "Sound the alarm in Gibeah! Blow the trumpet in Ramah! Raise the battle cry in Beth-aven ! Lead on into battle, O warriors of Benjamin!
verses.textEnNasb: Blow the horn in Gibeah, And the trumpet in Ramah. Sound an alarm at Beth-aven: "Behind you, Benjamin!"
verses.textEn: "Sound the trumpet in Gibeah, the horn in Ramah. Raise the battle cry in Beth Aven ; lead on, Benjamin.

verses.textZh: 在责罚的日子，以法莲必成为荒场。 我要在以色列各支派中宣告一定会发生的事情。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在责罚的日子，以法莲必成为荒场。 我要在以色列各支派中宣告一定会发生的事情。
verses.textZhCuv: 在责罚的日子，以法莲必变为荒场； 我在以色列支派中，指示将来必成的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of reckoning. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain.
verses.textEnEsv: Ephraim shall become a desolation in the day of punishment; among the tribes of Israel I make known what is sure.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke; Among the tribes of Israel I make known what is sure.
verses.textEnNlt: One thing is certain, Israel : On your day of punishment, you will become a heap of rubble.
verses.textEnNasb: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke; Among the tribes of Israel I make known what is trustworthy.
verses.textEn: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of reckoning. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain.

verses.textZh: "犹大的领袖，好象挪移地界的人， 我要把我的忿怒倾倒在他们身上，如同倒水一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: "犹大的领袖，好象挪移地界的人， 我要把我的忿怒倾倒在他们身上，如同倒水一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大的首领如同挪移地界的人， 我必将忿怒倒在他们身上，如水一般。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah’s leaders are like those who move boundary stones. I will pour out my wrath on them like a flood of water.
verses.textEnEsv: The princes of Judah have become like those who move the landmark; upon them I will pour out my wrath like water.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark; I will pour out My wrath on them like water.
verses.textEnNlt: "The leaders of Judah have become like thieves. So I will pour my anger on them like a waterfall.
verses.textEnNasb: The leaders of Judah have become like those who displace a boundary marker; On them I will pour out My anger like water.
verses.textEn: Judah’s leaders are like those who move boundary stones. I will pour out my wrath on them like a flood of water.

verses.textZh: 以法莲受欺压，被审判压碎； 因为他们乐意随从人的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲受欺压，被审判压碎； 因为他们乐意随从人的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲因乐从人的命令， 就受欺压，被审判压碎。
verses.textEnNiv: Ephraim is oppressed, trampled in judgment, intent on pursuing idols.
verses.textEnEsv: Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in judgment, because he was determined to go after filth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, Because he willingly walked by human precept.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel will be crushed and broken by my judgment because they are determined to worship idols.
verses.textEnNasb: Ephraim is oppressed, broken by judgment, Because he was determined to follow man’s command.
verses.textEn: Ephraim is oppressed, trampled in judgment, intent on pursuing idols.

verses.textZh: 因此我要成为以法莲的蛀虫， 成为犹大家的朽烂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我要成为以法莲的蛀虫， 成为犹大家的朽烂。
verses.textZhCuv: 我使以法莲如虫蛀之物， 使犹大家如朽烂之木。
verses.textEnNiv: I am like a moth to Ephraim, like rot to the people of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: But I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like dry rot to the house of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I willbe to Ephraim like a moth, And to the house of Judah like rottenness.
verses.textEnNlt: I will destroy Israel as a moth consumes wool. I will make Judah as weak as rotten wood.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I am like a moth to Ephraim, And like rottenness to the house of Judah.
verses.textEn: I am like a moth to Ephraim, like rot to the people of Judah.

verses.textZh: 以法莲看见自己的疾病， 犹大家看见自己的创伤， 以法莲就往亚述去， 派人去见亚述的大王。 可是他却不能医治你们， 也不能医好你们的创伤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲看见自己的疾病， 犹大家看见自己的创伤， 以法莲就往亚述去， 派人去见亚述的大王。 可是他却不能医治你们， 也不能医好你们的创伤。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲见自己有病， 犹大见自己有伤， 他们就打发人往亚述去见耶雷布王， 他却不能医治你们， 不能治好你们的伤。
verses.textEnNiv: "When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his sores, then Ephraim turned to Assyria, and sent to the great king for help. But he is not able to cure you, not able to heal your sores.
verses.textEnEsv: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to the great king. But he is not able to cure you or heal your wound.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When Ephraim saw his sickness, And Judah saw his wound, Then Ephraim went to Assyria And sent to King Jareb; Yet he cannot cure you, Nor heal you of your wound.
verses.textEnNlt: "When Israel and Judah saw how sick they were, Israel turned to Assyria— to the great king there— but he could neither help nor cure them.
verses.textEnNasb: When Ephraim saw his sickness, And Judah his sore, Ephraim then went to Assyria And sent word to King Jareb. But he is unable to heal you, Or to cure you of your sore.
