verses.textEn: "When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his sores, then Ephraim turned to Assyria, and sent to the great king for help. But he is not able to cure you, not able to heal your sores.

verses.textZh: 因为我对以法莲要像只猛狮， 对犹大家必像头少壮狮子。 我要亲自撕裂他们，然后离去； 我把他们带走，没有人能搭救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我对以法莲要像只猛狮， 对犹大家必像头少壮狮子。 我要亲自撕裂他们，然后离去； 我把他们带走，没有人能搭救。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必向以法莲如狮子， 向犹大家如少壮狮子。 我必撕裂而去， 我要夺去，无人搭救。
verses.textEnNiv: For I will be like a lion to Ephraim, like a great lion to Judah. I will tear them to pieces and go away; I will carry them off, with no one to rescue them.
verses.textEnEsv: For I will be like a lion to Ephraim, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, even I, will tear and go away; I will carry off, and no one shall rescue.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I willbe like a lion to Ephraim, And like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, even I, will tear them and go away; I will take them away, and no one shall rescue.
verses.textEnNlt: I will be like a lion to Israel, like a strong young lion to Judah. I will tear them to pieces! I will carry them off, and no one will be left to rescue them.
verses.textEnNasb: For I will be like a lion to Ephraim And like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, yes I, will tear to pieces and go away, I will carry away, and there will be no one to rescue.
verses.textEn: For I will be like a lion to Ephraim, like a great lion to Judah. I will tear them to pieces and go away; I will carry them off, with no one to rescue them.

verses.textZh: 我要回到自己的地方去； 直到他们承认自己的罪过， 寻求我的面。 在痛苦中必恳切寻求我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要回到自己的地方去； 直到他们承认自己的罪过， 寻求我的面。 在痛苦中必恳切寻求我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要回到原处， 等他们自觉有罪 ，寻求我面； 他们在急难的时候必切切寻求我。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I will return to my lair until they have borne their guilt and seek my face— in their misery they will earnestly seek me."
verses.textEnEsv: I will return again to my place, until they acknowledge their guilt and seek my face, and in their distress earnestly seek me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will return again to My place Till they acknowledge their offense. Then they will seek My face; In their affliction they will earnestly seek Me."
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will return to my place until they admit their guilt and turn to me. For as soon as trouble comes, they will earnestly search for me."
verses.textEnNasb: I will go away and return to My place Until they acknowledge their guilt and seek My face; In their distress they will search for Me.
verses.textEn: Then I will return to my lair until they have borne their guilt and seek my face— in their misery they will earnestly seek me."

verses.textZh: "来吧！让我们回转归向耶和华； 因为，他虽然撕裂了我们，但必定医治我们； 他虽然击伤了我们，却必替我们裹伤。
verses.textZhCnvs: "来吧！让我们回转归向耶和华； 因为，他虽然撕裂了我们，但必定医治我们； 他虽然击伤了我们，却必替我们裹伤。
verses.textZhCuv: 来吧，我们归向耶和华！ 他撕裂我们，也必医治； 他打伤我们，也必缠裹。
verses.textEnNiv: "Come, let us return to the Lord . He has torn us to pieces but he will heal us; he has injured us but he will bind up our wounds.
verses.textEnEsv: "Come, let us return to the Lord ; for he has torn us, that he may heal us; he has struck us down, and he will bind us up.
verses.textEnNkjv: Come, and let us return to the Lord; For He has torn, but He will heal us; He has stricken, but He will bind us up.
verses.textEnNlt: "Come, let us return to the Lord . He has torn us to pieces; now he will heal us. He has injured us; now he will bandage our wounds.
verses.textEnNasb: "Come, let’s return to the Lord. For He has torn us, but He will heal us; He has wounded us, but He will bandage us.
verses.textEn: "Come, let us return to the Lord . He has torn us to pieces but he will heal us; he has injured us but he will bind up our wounds.

verses.textZh: 两天以后，他要使我们复原； 第三天，他使我们起来， 我们就可以活在他的面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两天以后，他要使我们复原； 第三天，他使我们起来， 我们就可以活在他的面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 过两天他必使我们苏醒， 第三天他必使我们兴起， 我们就在他面前得以存活。
verses.textEnNiv: After two days he will revive us; on the third day he will restore us, that we may live in his presence.
verses.textEnEsv: After two days he will revive us; on the third day he will raise us up, that we may live before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: After two days He will revive us; On the third day He will raise us up, That we may live in His sight.
verses.textEnNlt: In just a short time he will restore us, so that we may live in his presence.
verses.textEnNasb: "He will revive us after two days; He will raise us up on the third day, That we may live before Him.
verses.textEn: After two days he will revive us; on the third day he will restore us, that we may live in his presence.

verses.textZh: 让我们认识，竭力追求认识耶和华。 他必定出现，像晨光一样， 他必临到我们，如雨水一般， 又像滋润大地的春雨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 让我们认识，竭力追求认识耶和华。 他必定出现，像晨光一样， 他必临到我们，如雨水一般， 又像滋润大地的春雨。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们务要认识耶和华， 竭力追求认识他。 他出现确如晨光； 他必临到我们像甘雨， 像滋润田地的春雨。
verses.textEnNiv: Let us acknowledge the Lord ; let us press on to acknowledge him. As surely as the sun rises, he will appear; he will come to us like the winter rains, like the spring rains that water the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: Let us know; let us press on to know the Lord ; his going out is sure as the dawn; he will come to us as the showers, as the spring rains that water the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: Let us know, Let us pursue the knowledge of the Lord. His going forth is established as the morning; He will come to us like the rain, Like the latter and former rain to the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, that we might know the Lord ! Let us press on to know him. He will respond to us as surely as the arrival of dawn or the coming of rains in early spring."
verses.textEnNasb: "So let’s learn, let’s press on to know the Lord. His appearance is as sure as the dawn; And He will come to us like the rain, As the spring rain waters the earth."
verses.textEn: Let us acknowledge the Lord ; let us press on to acknowledge him. As surely as the sun rises, he will appear; he will come to us like the winter rains, like the spring rains that water the earth."

verses.textZh: "以法莲啊！我要怎样待你呢？ 犹大啊，我要怎样待你呢？ 你们的爱心像早晨的云雾； 又像瞬即消逝的朝露。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以法莲啊！我要怎样待你呢？ 犹大啊，我要怎样待你呢？ 你们的爱心像早晨的云雾； 又像瞬即消逝的朝露。
verses.textZhCuv: 主说：以法莲哪，我可向你怎样行呢？ 犹大啊，我可向你怎样做呢？ 因为你们的良善如同早晨的云雾， 又如速散的甘露。
verses.textEnNiv: "What can I do with you, Ephraim? What can I do with you, Judah? Your love is like the morning mist, like the early dew that disappears.
verses.textEnEsv: What shall I do with you, O Ephraim? What shall I do with you, O Judah? Your love is like a morning cloud, like the dew that goes early away.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O Ephraim, what shall I do to you? O Judah, what shall I do to you? For your faithfulness is like a morning cloud, And like the early dew it goes away.
verses.textEnNlt: "O Israel and Judah, what should I do with you?" asks the Lord . "For your love vanishes like the morning mist and disappears like dew in the sunlight.
verses.textEnNasb: What shall I do with you, Ephraim? What shall I do with you, Judah? For your loyalty is like a morning cloud, And like the dew which goes away early.
verses.textEn: "What can I do with you, Ephraim? What can I do with you, Judah? Your love is like the morning mist, like the early dew that disappears.

verses.textZh: 因此，我藉众先知砍碎他们， 用我口中的话杀戮他们； 我的审判必如光一般发出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我藉众先知砍碎他们， 用我口中的话杀戮他们； 我的审判必如光一般发出。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我藉先知砍伐他们， 以我口中的话杀戮他们； 我施行的审判如光发出。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I cut you in pieces with my prophets, I killed you with the words of my mouth— then my judgments go forth like the sun.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I have hewn them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth, and my judgment goes forth as the light.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I have hewn them by the prophets, I have slain them by the words of My mouth; And your judgments arelike light that goes forth.
verses.textEnNlt: I sent my prophets to cut you to pieces— to slaughter you with my words, with judgments as inescapable as light.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I have cut them in pieces by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of My mouth; And the judgments on you are like the light that shines.
verses.textEn: Therefore I cut you in pieces with my prophets, I killed you with the words of my mouth— then my judgments go forth like the sun.

verses.textZh: 我喜爱怜恤，不喜爱祭祀； 我喜爱人认识神的知识，胜过人献的燔祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我喜爱怜恤，不喜爱祭祀； 我喜爱人认识神的知识，胜过人献的燔祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 我喜爱良善 ，不喜爱祭祀； 喜爱认识神，胜于燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and acknowledgment of God rather than burnt offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: For I desire steadfast love and not sacrifice, the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I desire mercy and not sacrifice, And the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
verses.textEnNlt: I want you to show love, not offer sacrifices. I want you to know me more than I want burnt offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: For I desire loyalty rather than sacrifice, And the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
verses.textEn: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and acknowledgment of God rather than burnt offerings.

verses.textZh: 可是他们却在亚当城背约， 在那里向我行诡诈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是他们却在亚当城背约， 在那里向我行诡诈。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却如亚当背约， 在境内向我行事诡诈。
verses.textEnNiv: As at Adam, they have broken the covenant; they were unfaithful to me there.
verses.textEnEsv: But like Adam they transgressed the covenant; there they dealt faithlessly with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But like men they transgressed the covenant; There they dealt treacherously with Me.
verses.textEnNlt: But like Adam, you broke my covenant and betrayed my trust.
verses.textEnNasb: But like Adam they have violated the covenant; There they have dealt treacherously with Me.
verses.textEn: As at Adam, they have broken the covenant; they were unfaithful to me there.

verses.textZh: 基列是作孽之人的城， 他们的脚踪染满了血渍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列是作孽之人的城， 他们的脚踪染满了血渍。
verses.textZhCuv: 基列是作孽之人的城， 被血沾染。
verses.textEnNiv: Gilead is a city of evildoers, stained with footprints of blood.
verses.textEnEsv: Gilead is a city of evildoers, tracked with blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Gilead is a city of evildoers And defiled with blood.
verses.textEnNlt: "Gilead is a city of sinners, tracked with footprints of blood.
verses.textEnNasb: Gilead is a city of wrongdoers, Tracked with bloody footprints.
verses.textEn: Gilead is a city of evildoers, stained with footprints of blood.

verses.textZh: 在往示剑的路上，祭司结党杀害人， 就像埋伏路旁的强盗； 他们行了邪恶的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在往示剑的路上，祭司结党杀害人， 就像埋伏路旁的强盗； 他们行了邪恶的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 强盗成群，怎样埋伏杀人， 祭司结党，也照样在示剑的路上杀戮， 行了邪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: As marauders lie in ambush for a victim, so do bands of priests; they murder on the road to Shechem, carrying out their wicked schemes.
verses.textEnEsv: As robbers lie in wait for a man, so the priests band together; they murder on the way to Shechem; they commit villainy.
verses.textEnNkjv: As bands of robbers lie in wait for a man, So the company of priests murder on the way to Shechem; Surely they commit lewdness.
verses.textEnNlt: Priests form bands of robbers, waiting in ambush for their victims. They murder travelers along the road to Shechem and practice every kind of sin.
verses.textEnNasb: And as a band of robbers lie in wait for a person, So a band of priests murder on the way to Shechem; Certainly they have committed an act of infamy.
verses.textEn: As marauders lie in ambush for a victim, so do bands of priests; they murder on the road to Shechem, carrying out their wicked schemes.

verses.textZh: 在以色列家！我看见了可怕的事； 那里有以法莲的淫行，以色列被玷污了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在以色列家！我看见了可怕的事； 那里有以法莲的淫行，以色列被玷污了。
verses.textZhCuv: 在以色列家，我见了可憎的事； 在以法莲那里有淫行， 以色列被玷污。
verses.textEnNiv: I have seen a horrible thing in Israel: There Ephraim is given to prostitution, Israel is defiled.
verses.textEnEsv: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing; Ephraim’s whoredom is there; Israel is defiled.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have seen a horrible thing in the house of Israel: There is the harlotry of Ephraim; Israel is defiled.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I have seen something horrible in Ephraim and Israel: My people are defiled by prostituting themselves with other gods!
verses.textEnNasb: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing; Ephraim’s infidelity is there, Israel has defiled itself.
verses.textEn: I have seen a horrible thing in Israel: There Ephraim is given to prostitution, Israel is defiled.

verses.textZh: 犹大啊！我使我的子民归回的时候， 必有为你定下的一个收割时期。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大啊！我使我的子民归回的时候， 必有为你定下的一个收割时期。"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大啊，我使被掳之民归回的时候， 必有为你所命定的收场。
verses.textEnNiv: "Also for you, Judah, a harvest is appointed. "Whenever I would restore the fortunes of my people,
verses.textEnEsv: For you also, O Judah, a harvest is appointed. When I restore the fortunes of my people,
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, O Judah, a harvest is appointed for you, When I return the captives of My people.
verses.textEnNlt: "O Judah, a harvest of punishment is also waiting for you, though I wanted to restore the fortunes of my people.
verses.textEnNasb: Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, When I restore the fortunes of My people.
verses.textEn: "Also for you, Judah, a harvest is appointed. "Whenever I would restore the fortunes of my people,

verses.textZh: "我医治以色列的时候，以法莲的罪孽， 和撒玛利亚的罪恶就显露出来； 因为他们行欺诈， 小偷入屋偷窃， 强盗在外抢劫。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我医治以色列的时候，以法莲的罪孽， 和撒玛利亚的罪恶就显露出来； 因为他们行欺诈， 小偷入屋偷窃， 强盗在外抢劫。
verses.textZhCuv: 我想医治以色列的时候， 以法莲的罪孽和撒马利亚的罪恶就显露出来。 他们行事虚谎， 内有贼人入室偷窃， 外有强盗成群骚扰。
verses.textEnNiv: whenever I would heal Israel, the sins of Ephraim are exposed and the crimes of Samaria revealed. They practice deceit, thieves break into houses, bandits rob in the streets;
verses.textEnEsv: when I would heal Israel, the iniquity of Ephraim is revealed, and the evil deeds of Samaria, for they deal falsely; the thief breaks in, and the bandits raid outside.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When I would have healed Israel, Then the iniquity of Ephraim was uncovered, And the wickedness of Samaria. For they have committed fraud; A thief comes in; A band of robbers takes spoil outside.
verses.textEnNlt: "I want to heal Israel, but its sins are too great. Samaria is filled with liars. Thieves are on the inside and bandits on the outside!
verses.textEnNasb: When I would heal Israel, The wrongdoing of Ephraim is uncovered, And the evil deeds of Samaria, For they practice deception; The thief enters, A band of robbers attack outside,
verses.textEn: whenever I would heal Israel, the sins of Ephraim are exposed and the crimes of Samaria revealed. They practice deceit, thieves break into houses, bandits rob in the streets;

verses.textZh: 他们心里并未想到， 我记得他们的一切罪恶。 他们所作的一切，现在都围绕他们， 都在我面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们心里并未想到， 我记得他们的一切罪恶。 他们所作的一切，现在都围绕他们， 都在我面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们心里并不思想我记念他们的一切恶； 他们所行的现在缠绕他们，都在我面前。
verses.textEnNiv: but they do not realize that I remember all their evil deeds. Their sins engulf them; they are always before me.
verses.textEnEsv: But they do not consider that I remember all their evil. Now their deeds surround them; they are before my face.
verses.textEnNkjv: They do not consider in their hearts That I remember all their wickedness; Now their own deeds have surrounded them; They are before My face.
verses.textEnNlt: Its people don’t realize that I am watching them. Their sinful deeds are all around them, and I see them all.
verses.textEnNasb: And they do not consider in their hearts That I remember all their wickedness. Now their deeds surround them; They are before My face.
verses.textEn: but they do not realize that I remember all their evil deeds. Their sins engulf them; they are always before me.

verses.textZh: 他们以自己的恶行讨王欢喜， 用自己的虚谎叫领袖快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们以自己的恶行讨王欢喜， 用自己的虚谎叫领袖快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们行恶使君王欢喜， 说谎使首领喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: "They delight the king with their wickedness, the princes with their lies.
verses.textEnEsv: By their evil they make the king glad, and the princes by their treachery.
verses.textEnNkjv: They make a king glad with their wickedness, And princes with their lies.
verses.textEnNlt: "The people entertain the king with their wickedness, and the princes laugh at their lies.
verses.textEnNasb: With their wickedness they make the king happy, And the officials with their lies.
verses.textEn: "They delight the king with their wickedness, the princes with their lies.

verses.textZh: 他们全是犯奸淫的， 像一个被烤饼的人烧热的火炉， 从抟面，直到全团发酵的时候， 烤饼的人暂停使火发旺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们全是犯奸淫的， 像一个被烤饼的人烧热的火炉， 从抟面，直到全团发酵的时候， 烤饼的人暂停使火发旺。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们都是行淫的， 像火炉被烤饼的烧热， 从抟面到发面的时候， 暂不使火着旺。
verses.textEnNiv: They are all adulterers, burning like an oven whose fire the baker need not stir from the kneading of the dough till it rises.
verses.textEnEsv: They are all adulterers; they are like a heated oven whose baker ceases to stir the fire, from the kneading of the dough until it is leavened.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They are all adulterers. Like an oven heated by a baker— He ceases stirring thefire after kneading the dough, Until it is leavened.
verses.textEnNlt: They are all adulterers, always aflame with lust. They are like an oven that is kept hot while the baker is kneading the dough.
verses.textEnNasb: They are all adulterers, Like an oven heated by the baker, Who stops stoking the fire From the time the dough is kneaded until it is leavened.
verses.textEn: They are all adulterers, burning like an oven whose fire the baker need not stir from the kneading of the dough till it rises.

verses.textZh: 在我们王喜庆的日子，领袖们因酒的烈性而生病， 王就与亵慢人联手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我们王喜庆的日子，领袖们因酒的烈性而生病， 王就与亵慢人联手。
verses.textZhCuv: 在我们王宴乐的日子， 首领因酒的烈性成病； 王与亵慢人拉手。
verses.textEnNiv: On the day of the festival of our king the princes become inflamed with wine, and he joins hands with the mockers.
verses.textEnEsv: On the day of our king, the princes became sick with the heat of wine; he stretched out his hand with mockers.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the day of our king Princes have made him sick, inflamed with wine; He stretched out his hand with scoffers.
verses.textEnNlt: On royal holidays, the princes get drunk with wine, carousing with those who mock them.
verses.textEnNasb: On the day of our king, the officials became sick with the heat of wine; He stretched out his hand with scoffers,
verses.textEn: On the day of the festival of our king the princes become inflamed with wine, and he joins hands with the mockers.

verses.textZh: 他们阴谋埋伏的时候， 心中烧得热如火炉。 他们整夜抑制怒气， 一到早晨，却像发出火焰的火燃烧起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们阴谋埋伏的时候， 心中烧得热如火炉。 他们整夜抑制怒气， 一到早晨，却像发出火焰的火燃烧起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 首领埋伏的时候，心中热如火炉， 就如烤饼的整夜睡卧， 到了早晨火气炎炎。
verses.textEnNiv: Their hearts are like an oven; they approach him with intrigue. Their passion smolders all night; in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.
verses.textEnEsv: For with hearts like an oven they approach their intrigue; all night their anger smolders; in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: They prepare their heart like an oven, While they lie in wait; Their baker sleeps all night; In the morning it burns like a flaming fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Their hearts are like an oven blazing with intrigue. Their plot smolders through the night, and in the morning it breaks out like a raging fire.
verses.textEnNasb: For their hearts are like an oven As they approach their plotting; Their anger smolders all night, In the morning it burns like flaming fire.
verses.textEn: Their hearts are like an oven; they approach him with intrigue. Their passion smolders all night; in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.

verses.textZh: 所有的人都热如火炉， 吞灭他们的官长。 他们所有的君王都倒毙了， 他们中间没有一人向我呼求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的人都热如火炉， 吞灭他们的官长。 他们所有的君王都倒毙了， 他们中间没有一人向我呼求。
verses.textZhCuv: 众民也热如火炉， 烧灭他们的官长。 他们的君王都仆倒而死； 他们中间无一人求告我。
verses.textEnNiv: All of them are hot as an oven; they devour their rulers. All their kings fall, and none of them calls on me.
verses.textEnEsv: All of them are hot as an oven, and they devour their rulers. All their kings have fallen, and none of them calls upon me.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are all hot, like an oven, And have devoured their judges; All their kings have fallen. None among them calls upon Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Burning like an oven, they consume their leaders. They kill their kings one after another, and no one cries to me for help.
verses.textEnNasb: All of them are hot like an oven, And they consume their rulers; All their kings have fallen. None of them calls on Me.
verses.textEn: All of them are hot as an oven; they devour their rulers. All their kings fall, and none of them calls on me.

verses.textZh: "以法莲与外族混杂， 以法莲是没有翻过的饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以法莲与外族混杂， 以法莲是没有翻过的饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲与列邦人搀杂； 以法莲是没有翻过的饼。
verses.textEnNiv: "Ephraim mixes with the nations; Ephraim is a flat loaf not turned over.
verses.textEnEsv: Ephraim mixes himself with the peoples; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Ephraim has mixed himself among the peoples; Ephraim is a cake unturned.
verses.textEnNlt: "The people of Israel mingle with godless foreigners, making themselves as worthless as a half-baked cake!
verses.textEnNasb: Ephraim is himself thrown about with the nations; Ephraim has become a round loaf not turned over.
verses.textEn: "Ephraim mixes with the nations; Ephraim is a flat loaf not turned over.

verses.textZh: 外族人吞吃了他的力量， 他却不知道； 他头上满是白发， 他也不晓得。
verses.textZhCnvs: 外族人吞吃了他的力量， 他却不知道； 他头上满是白发， 他也不晓得。
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦人吞吃他劳力得来的，他却不知道； 头发斑白，他也不觉得。
verses.textEnNiv: Foreigners sap his strength, but he does not realize it. His hair is sprinkled with gray, but he does not notice.
verses.textEnEsv: Strangers devour his strength, and he knows it not; gray hairs are sprinkled upon him, and he knows it not.
verses.textEnNkjv: Aliens have devoured his strength, But he does not know it; Yes, gray hairs are here and there on him, Yet he does not know it.
verses.textEnNlt: Worshiping foreign gods has sapped their strength, but they don’t even know it. Their hair is gray, but they don’t realize they’re old and weak.
verses.textEnNasb: Strangers devour his strength, Yet he does not know it; Gray hairs also are sprinkled on him, Yet he does not know it.
verses.textEn: Foreigners sap his strength, but he does not realize it. His hair is sprinkled with gray, but he does not notice.

verses.textZh: 虽然以色列的骄傲当面指证自己， 他们却不回转归向耶和华他们的神， 也不因此寻求他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然以色列的骄傲当面指证自己， 他们却不回转归向耶和华他们的神， 也不因此寻求他。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的骄傲当面见证自己， 虽遭遇这一切， 他们仍不归向耶和华－他们的神， 也不寻求他。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel’s arrogance testifies against him, but despite all this he does not return to the Lord his God or search for him.
verses.textEnEsv: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they do not return to the Lord their God, nor seek him, for all this.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the pride of Israel testifies to his face, But they do not return to the Lord their God, Nor seek Him for all this.
verses.textEnNlt: Their arrogance testifies against them, yet they don’t return to the Lord their God or even try to find him.
verses.textEnNasb: Though the pride of Israel testifies against him, Yet they have not returned to the Lord their God, Nor have they sought Him, despite all this.
verses.textEn: Israel’s arrogance testifies against him, but despite all this he does not return to the Lord his God or search for him.

verses.textZh: 以法莲好象一只愚蠢无知的鸽子。 他们向埃及求助，投奔亚述。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲好象一只愚蠢无知的鸽子。 他们向埃及求助，投奔亚述。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲好像鸽子愚蠢无知； 他们求告埃及，投奔亚述。
verses.textEnNiv: "Ephraim is like a dove, easily deceived and senseless— now calling to Egypt, now turning to Assyria.
verses.textEnEsv: Ephraim is like a dove, silly and without sense, calling to Egypt, going to Assyria.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Ephraim also is like a silly dove, without sense— They call to Egypt, They go to Assyria.
verses.textEnNlt: "The people of Israel have become like silly, witless doves, first calling to Egypt, then flying to Assyria for help.
verses.textEnNasb: So Ephraim has become like a gullible dove, without sense; They call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
verses.textEn: "Ephraim is like a dove, easily deceived and senseless— now calling to Egypt, now turning to Assyria.

verses.textZh: 但他们去的时候，我要把我的网撒在他们身上； 我要把他们如同空中的飞鸟打下来。 我要按着他们会众所听见的，惩罚他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们去的时候，我要把我的网撒在他们身上； 我要把他们如同空中的飞鸟打下来。 我要按着他们会众所听见的，惩罚他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们去的时候，我必将我的网撒在他们身上； 我要打下他们，如同空中的鸟。 我必按他们会众所听见的惩罚他们。
verses.textEnNiv: When they go, I will throw my net over them; I will pull them down like the birds in the sky. When I hear them flocking together, I will catch them.
verses.textEnEsv: As they go, I will spread over them my net; I will bring them down like birds of the heavens; I will discipline them according to the report made to their congregation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wherever they go, I will spread My net on them; I will bring them down like birds of the air; I will chastise them According to what their congregation has heard.
verses.textEnNlt: But as they fly about, I will throw my net over them and bring them down like a bird from the sky. I will punish them for all the evil they do.
verses.textEnNasb: When they go, I will spread My net over them; I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will discipline them in accordance with the proclamation to their assembly.
verses.textEn: When they go, I will throw my net over them; I will pull them down like the birds in the sky. When I hear them flocking together, I will catch them.

verses.textZh: 他们有祸了，因为他们离弃了我； 他们遭毁灭，因为他们背叛了我。 我虽然想救赎他们，他们却对我说谎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们有祸了，因为他们离弃了我； 他们遭毁灭，因为他们背叛了我。 我虽然想救赎他们，他们却对我说谎。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们因离弃我，必定有祸； 因违背我，必被毁灭。 我虽要救赎他们，他们却向我说谎。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to them, because they have strayed from me! Destruction to them, because they have rebelled against me! I long to redeem them but they speak about me falsely.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to them, for they have strayed from me! Destruction to them, for they have rebelled against me! I would redeem them, but they speak lies against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to them, for they have fled from Me! Destruction to them, Because they have transgressed against Me! Though I redeemed them, Yet they have spoken lies against Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits those who have deserted me! Let them die, for they have rebelled against me. I wanted to redeem them, but they have told lies about me.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to them, for they have strayed from Me! Destruction is theirs, for they have rebelled against Me! I would redeem them, but they have spoken lies against Me.
verses.textEn: Woe to them, because they have strayed from me! Destruction to them, because they have rebelled against me! I long to redeem them but they speak about me falsely.

verses.textZh: 他们并没有真心向我呼求， 只是在床上哀恸罢了。 他们为了五谷和新酒割伤 自己， 仍然悖逆我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们并没有真心向我呼求， 只是在床上哀恸罢了。 他们为了五谷和新酒割伤 自己， 仍然悖逆我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们并不诚心哀求我， 乃在床上呼号； 他们为求五谷新酒聚集， 仍然悖逆我。
verses.textEnNiv: They do not cry out to me from their hearts but wail on their beds. They slash themselves, appealing to their gods for grain and new wine, but they turn away from me.
verses.textEnEsv: They do not cry to me from the heart, but they wail upon their beds; for grain and wine they gash themselves; they rebel against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: They did not cry out to Me with their heart When they wailed upon their beds. "They assemble together for grain and new wine, They rebel against Me;
verses.textEnNlt: They do not cry out to me with sincere hearts. Instead, they sit on their couches and wail. They cut themselves, begging foreign gods for grain and new wine, and they turn away from me.
verses.textEnNasb: And they do not cry to Me from their heart When they wail on their beds; For the sake of grain and new wine they assemble themselves, They turn against Me.
verses.textEn: They do not cry out to me from their hearts but wail on their beds. They slash themselves, appealing to their gods for grain and new wine, but they turn away from me.

verses.textZh: 我虽然锻炼他们的手臂，使它们有力， 他们却图谋恶计攻击我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我虽然锻炼他们的手臂，使它们有力， 他们却图谋恶计攻击我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我虽教导他们，坚固他们的膀臂， 他们竟图谋抗拒我。
verses.textEnNiv: I trained them and strengthened their arms, but they plot evil against me.
verses.textEnEsv: Although I trained and strengthened their arms, yet they devise evil against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though I disciplined and strengthened their arms, Yet they devise evil against Me;
verses.textEnNlt: I trained them and made them strong, yet now they plot evil against me.
verses.textEnNasb: Although I trained and strengthened their arms, Yet they devise evil against Me.
verses.textEn: I trained them and strengthened their arms, but they plot evil against me.

verses.textZh: 他们转向巴力， 成了不可靠的弓。 他们的领袖因自己舌头上的狂傲倒在刀下， 这在埃及地必成为被人讥笑的对象。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们转向巴力， 成了不可靠的弓。 他们的领袖因自己舌头上的狂傲倒在刀下， 这在埃及地必成为被人讥笑的对象。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们归向，却不归向至上者； 他们如同翻背的弓。 他们的首领必因舌头的狂傲倒在刀下； 这在埃及地必作人的讥笑。
verses.textEnNiv: They do not turn to the Most High; they are like a faulty bow. Their leaders will fall by the sword because of their insolent words. For this they will be ridiculed in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: They return, but not upward; they are like a treacherous bow; their princes shall fall by the sword because of the insolence of their tongue. This shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: They return, but not to the Most High; They are like a treacherous bow. Their princes shall fall by the sword For the cursings of their tongue. This shallbe their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: They look everywhere except to the Most High. They are as useless as a crooked bow. Their leaders will be killed by their enemies because of their insolence toward me. Then the people of Egypt will laugh at them.
verses.textEnNasb: They turn, but not upward, They are like a loose bow; Their officials will fall by the sword Because of the insolence of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: They do not turn to the Most High; they are like a faulty bow. Their leaders will fall by the sword because of their insolent words. For this they will be ridiculed in the land of Egypt.

verses.textZh: "你要把号角放在你的嘴上， 敌人如鹰一般来攻击耶和华的家； 因为他们违背了我的约， 干犯了我的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要把号角放在你的嘴上， 敌人如鹰一般来攻击耶和华的家； 因为他们违背了我的约， 干犯了我的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 你用口吹角吧！ 敌人如鹰来攻打耶和华的家； 因为这民违背我的约， 干犯我的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: "Put the trumpet to your lips! An eagle is over the house of the Lord because the people have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law.
verses.textEnEsv: Set the trumpet to your lips! One like a vulture is over the house of the Lord , because they have transgressed my covenant and rebelled against my law.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Set the trumpet to your mouth! Heshallcome like an eagle against the house of the Lord, Because they have transgressed My covenant And rebelled against My law.
verses.textEnNlt: "Sound the alarm! The enemy descends like an eagle on the people of the Lord , for they have broken my covenant and revolted against my law.
verses.textEnNasb: Put the trumpet to your lips! Like an eagle the enemy comes against the house of the Lord, Because they have violated My covenant And rebelled against My Law.
verses.textEn: "Put the trumpet to your lips! An eagle is over the house of the Lord because the people have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law.

verses.textZh: 他们必向我哀求： ‘我的神啊！我们以色列认识你。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必向我哀求： ‘我的神啊！我们以色列认识你。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必呼叫我说： 我的神啊，我们以色列认识你了。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel cries out to me, ‘Our God, we acknowledge you!’
verses.textEnEsv: To me they cry, "My God, we—Israel—know you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Israel will cry to Me, ‘My God, we know You!’
verses.textEnNlt: Now Israel pleads with me, ‘Help us, for you are our God!’
verses.textEnNasb: They cry out to Me, "My God, we of Israel know You!"
verses.textEn: Israel cries out to me, ‘Our God, we acknowledge you!’

verses.textZh: 以色列弃绝了良善， 所以仇敌必追赶他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列弃绝了良善， 所以仇敌必追赶他。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列丢弃良善 ； 仇敌必追逼他。
verses.textEnNiv: But Israel has rejected what is good; an enemy will pursue him.
verses.textEnEsv: Israel has spurned the good; the enemy shall pursue him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Israel has rejected the good; The enemy will pursue him.
verses.textEnNlt: But it is too late. The people of Israel have rejected what is good, and now their enemies will chase after them.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel has rejected the good; The enemy will pursue him.
verses.textEn: But Israel has rejected what is good; an enemy will pursue him.

verses.textZh: "他们立了君王，却不是出于我； 他们立了首领，我却不知道。 他们用自己的金银为自己做了偶像， 以致他们被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他们立了君王，却不是出于我； 他们立了首领，我却不知道。 他们用自己的金银为自己做了偶像， 以致他们被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们立君王，却不由我； 他们立首领，我却不认。 他们用金银为自己制造偶像， 以致被剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: They set up kings without my consent; they choose princes without my approval. With their silver and gold they make idols for themselves to their own destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: They made kings, but not through me. They set up princes, but I knew it not. With their silver and gold they made idols for their own destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They set up kings, but not by Me; They made princes, but I did not acknowledge them. From their silver and gold They made idols for themselves— That they might be cut off.
verses.textEnNlt: The people have appointed kings without my consent, and princes without my approval. By making idols for themselves from their silver and gold, they have brought about their own destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: They have set up kings, but not by Me; They have appointed officials, but I did not know it. With their silver and gold they have made idols for themselves, So that they will be eliminated.
verses.textEn: They set up kings without my consent; they choose princes without my approval. With their silver and gold they make idols for themselves to their own destruction.

verses.textZh: 撒玛利亚啊！我要除掉你的牛犊， 我的怒气要向撒玛利亚人发作， 他们要到几时才能无罪免罚呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒玛利亚啊！我要除掉你的牛犊， 我的怒气要向撒玛利亚人发作， 他们要到几时才能无罪免罚呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 撒马利亚啊，耶和华已经丢弃你的牛犊； 我的怒气向拜牛犊的人发作。 他们到几时方能无罪呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Samaria, throw out your calf-idol! My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of purity?
verses.textEnEsv: I have spurned your calf, O Samaria. My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of innocence?
verses.textEnNkjv: Your calf is rejected, O Samaria! My anger is aroused against them— How long until they attain to innocence?
verses.textEnNlt: "O Samaria, I reject this calf— this idol you have made. My fury burns against you. How long will you be incapable of innocence?
verses.textEnNasb: He has rejected your calf, Samaria, saying, "My anger burns against them!" How long will they be incapable of innocence?
verses.textEn: Samaria, throw out your calf-idol! My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of purity?

verses.textZh: 这牛犊是出于以色列， 是匠人所做的，它并不是神， 撒玛利亚的牛犊必被粉碎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这牛犊是出于以色列， 是匠人所做的，它并不是神， 撒玛利亚的牛犊必被粉碎。
verses.textZhCuv: 这牛犊出于以色列， 是匠人所造的，并不是神。 撒马利亚的牛犊必被打碎。
verses.textEnNiv: They are from Israel! This calf—a metalworker has made it; it is not God. It will be broken in pieces, that calf of Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is from Israel; a craftsman made it; it is not God. The calf of Samaria shall be broken to pieces.
verses.textEnNkjv: For from Israel is even this: A workman made it, and it is not God; But the calf of Samaria shall be broken to pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: This calf you worship, O Israel, was crafted by your own hands! It is not God! Therefore, it must be smashed to bits.
verses.textEnNasb: For from Israel comes even this! A craftsman made it, so it is not God; Assuredly, the calf of Samaria will be broken to pieces.
verses.textEn: They are from Israel! This calf—a metalworker has made it; it is not God. It will be broken in pieces, that calf of Samaria.

verses.textZh: 他们播种的是风， 收成的是暴风。 生出来的苗没有麦穗， 不能做成面粉； 即或做成面粉，也必被别国的人吞吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们播种的是风， 收成的是暴风。 生出来的苗没有麦穗， 不能做成面粉； 即或做成面粉，也必被别国的人吞吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们所种的是风，所收的是暴风； 所种的不成禾稼，就是发苗也不结实； 即便结实，外邦人必吞吃。
verses.textEnNiv: "They sow the wind and reap the whirlwind. The stalk has no head; it will produce no flour. Were it to yield grain, foreigners would swallow it up.
verses.textEnEsv: For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind. The standing grain has no heads; it shall yield no flour; if it were to yield, strangers would devour it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They sow the wind, And reap the whirlwind. The stalk has no bud; It shall never produce meal. If it should produce, Aliens would swallow it up.
verses.textEnNlt: "They have planted the wind and will harvest the whirlwind. The stalks of grain wither and produce nothing to eat. And even if there is any grain, foreigners will eat it.
verses.textEnNasb: For they sow wind And they harvest a storm. The standing grain has no kernels; It yields no grain. If it were to yield, strangers would swallow it.
verses.textEn: "They sow the wind and reap the whirlwind. The stalk has no head; it will produce no flour. Were it to yield grain, foreigners would swallow it up.

verses.textZh: 以色列被吞吃， 如今在万国中， 好象没有人喜悦的器皿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列被吞吃， 如今在万国中， 好象没有人喜悦的器皿。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列被吞吃； 现今在列国中，好像人不喜悦的器皿。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel is swallowed up; now she is among the nations like something no one wants.
verses.textEnEsv: Israel is swallowed up; already they are among the nations as a useless vessel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Israel is swallowed up; Now they are among the Gentiles Like a vessel in which is no pleasure.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel have been swallowed up; they lie among the nations like an old discarded pot.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel has been swallowed up; They are now among the nations Like a vessel in which no one delights.
verses.textEn: Israel is swallowed up; now she is among the nations like something no one wants.

verses.textZh: 他们上去投奔亚述， 像一只独行的野驴， 以法莲贿买爱人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们上去投奔亚述， 像一只独行的野驴， 以法莲贿买爱人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们投奔亚述，如同独行的野驴； 以法莲贿买朋党。
verses.textEnNiv: For they have gone up to Assyria like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has sold herself to lovers.
verses.textEnEsv: For they have gone up to Assyria, a wild donkey wandering alone; Ephraim has hired lovers.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they have gone up to Assyria, Like a wild donkey alone by itself; Ephraim has hired lovers.
verses.textEnNlt: Like a wild donkey looking for a mate, they have gone up to Assyria. The people of Israel have sold themselves— sold themselves to many lovers.
verses.textEnNasb: For they have gone up to Assyria, Like a wild donkey all alone; Ephraim has paid fees for lovers.
verses.textEn: For they have gone up to Assyria like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has sold herself to lovers.

verses.textZh: 他们虽然在列国中贿买人， 我现在却要招聚他们。 他们因着君王和领袖所加的重担， 逐渐衰微。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们虽然在列国中贿买人， 我现在却要招聚他们。 他们因着君王和领袖所加的重担， 逐渐衰微。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们虽在列邦中贿买人， 现在我却要聚集惩罚他们； 他们因君王和首领所加的重担日渐衰微。
verses.textEnNiv: Although they have sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them together. They will begin to waste away under the oppression of the mighty king.
verses.textEnEsv: Though they hire allies among the nations, I will soon gather them up. And the king and princes shall soon writhe because of the tribute.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, though they have hired among the nations, Now I will gather them; And they shall sorrow a little, Because of the burden of the king of princes.
verses.textEnNlt: But though they have sold themselves to many allies, I will now gather them together for judgment. Then they will writhe under the burden of the great king.
verses.textEnNasb: Even though they pay for allies among the nations, I will gather them up now; And they will begin to diminish Because of the burden of the king of officials.
verses.textEn: Although they have sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them together. They will begin to waste away under the oppression of the mighty king.

verses.textZh: 以法莲增添好些祭坛去犯罪， 这些就成了他们犯罪的祭坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲增添好些祭坛去犯罪， 这些就成了他们犯罪的祭坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲增添祭坛取罪； 因此，祭坛使他犯罪。
verses.textEnNiv: "Though Ephraim built many altars for sin offerings, these have become altars for sinning.
verses.textEnEsv: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they have become to him altars for sinning.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because Ephraim has made many altars for sin, They have become for him altars for sinning.
verses.textEnNlt: "Israel has built many altars to take away sin, but these very altars became places for sinning!
verses.textEnNasb: Since Ephraim has multiplied altars for sin, They have become altars of sinning for him.
verses.textEn: "Though Ephraim built many altars for sin offerings, these have become altars for sinning.

verses.textZh: 我虽然为他们写了律法万条， 他们却看作是为外族人写的，与他们毫无关系一般。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我虽然为他们写了律法万条， 他们却看作是为外族人写的，与他们毫无关系一般。
verses.textZhCuv: 我为他写了律法万条， 他却以为与他毫无关涉。
verses.textEnNiv: I wrote for them the many things of my law, but they regarded them as something foreign.
verses.textEnEsv: Were I to write for him my laws by the ten thousands, they would be regarded as a strange thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have written for him the great things of My law, But they were considered a strange thing.
verses.textEnNlt: Even though I gave them all my laws, they act as if those laws don’t apply to them.
verses.textEnNasb: Though I wrote for him ten thousand precepts of My Law, They are regarded as a strange thing.
verses.textEn: I wrote for them the many things of my law, but they regarded them as something foreign.

verses.textZh: 他们喜爱献祭， 献肉为祭，又拿来吃； 耶和华却不喜悦他们。 他必记得他们的罪孽， 追讨他们的罪恶； 他们必回到埃及去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们喜爱献祭， 献肉为祭，又拿来吃； 耶和华却不喜悦他们。 他必记得他们的罪孽， 追讨他们的罪恶； 他们必回到埃及去。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于献给我的祭物， 他们自食其肉， 耶和华却不悦纳他们。 现在必记念他们的罪孽， 追讨他们的罪恶； 他们必归回埃及。
verses.textEnNiv: Though they offer sacrifices as gifts to me, and though they eat the meat, the Lord is not pleased with them. Now he will remember their wickedness and punish their sins: They will return to Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: As for my sacrificial offerings, they sacrifice meat and eat it, but the Lord does not accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity and punish their sins; they shall return to Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the sacrifices of My offerings they sacrifice flesh and eat it, But the Lord does not accept them. Now He will remember their iniquity and punish their sins. They shall return to Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: The people love to offer sacrifices to me, feasting on the meat, but I do not accept their sacrifices. I will hold my people accountable for their sins, and I will punish them. They will return to Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: As for My sacrificial gifts, They sacrifice the flesh and eat it, But the Lord has taken no delight in them. Now He will remember their guilt, And punish them for their sins; They will return to Egypt.
verses.textEn: Though they offer sacrifices as gifts to me, and though they eat the meat, the Lord is not pleased with them. Now he will remember their wickedness and punish their sins: They will return to Egypt.

verses.textZh: 以色列忘记了造他的主，建造了很多宫殿； 犹大也增添了很多坚固城。 我却要降火在他的众城中，吞灭他的堡垒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列忘记了造他的主，建造了很多宫殿； 犹大也增添了很多坚固城。 我却要降火在他的众城中，吞灭他的堡垒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列忘记造他的主，建造宫殿； 犹大多造坚固城， 我却要降火焚烧他的城邑， 烧灭其中的宫殿。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel has forgotten their Maker and built palaces; Judah has fortified many towns. But I will send fire on their cities that will consume their fortresses."
verses.textEnEsv: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces, and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; so I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour her strongholds.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For Israel has forgotten his Maker, And has built temples; Judah also has multiplied fortified cities; But I will send fire upon his cities, And it shall devour his palaces."
verses.textEnNlt: Israel has forgotten its Maker and built great palaces, and Judah has fortified its cities. Therefore, I will send down fire on their cities and will burn up their fortresses."
verses.textEnNasb: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; And Judah has multiplied fortified cities, But I will send a fire on its cities, and it will consume its palatial buildings.
verses.textEn: Israel has forgotten their Maker and built palaces; Judah has fortified many towns. But I will send fire on their cities that will consume their fortresses."

verses.textZh: 以色列啊！不要欢喜；不要像外族人一样快乐， 因为你行了邪淫，离开你的神， 在各打谷场上喜爱卖淫的赏赐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列啊！不要欢喜；不要像外族人一样快乐， 因为你行了邪淫，离开你的神， 在各打谷场上喜爱卖淫的赏赐。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列啊，不要像外邦人欢喜快乐； 因为你行邪淫离弃你的神， 在各谷场上如妓女喜爱赏赐。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not rejoice, Israel; do not be jubilant like the other nations. For you have been unfaithful to your God; you love the wages of a prostitute at every threshing floor.
verses.textEnEsv: Rejoice not, O Israel! Exult not like the peoples; for you have played the whore, forsaking your God. You have loved a prostitute’s wages on all threshing floors.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not rejoice, O Israel, with joy like other peoples, For you have played the harlot against your God. You have made love for hire on every threshing floor.
verses.textEnNlt: O people of Israel, do not rejoice as other nations do. For you have been unfaithful to your God, hiring yourselves out like prostitutes, worshiping other gods on every threshing floor.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not rejoice, Israel, with jubilation like the nations! For you have been unfaithful, abandoning your God. You have loved the earnings of unfaithfulness on every threshing floor.
verses.textEn: Do not rejoice, Israel; do not be jubilant like the other nations. For you have been unfaithful to your God; you love the wages of a prostitute at every threshing floor.

verses.textZh: 打谷场和榨酒池不能喂养他们， 新酒也必使他们失望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 打谷场和榨酒池不能喂养他们， 新酒也必使他们失望。
verses.textZhCuv: 谷场和酒榨都不够以色列人使用； 新酒也必缺乏。
verses.textEnNiv: Threshing floors and winepresses will not feed the people; the new wine will fail them.
verses.textEnEsv: Threshing floor and wine vat shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The threshing floor and the winepress Shall not feed them, And the new wine shall fail in her.
verses.textEnNlt: So now your harvests will be too small to feed you. There will be no grapes for making new wine.
verses.textEnNasb: Threshing floor and wine press will not feed them, And the new wine will fail them.
verses.textEn: Threshing floors and winepresses will not feed the people; the new wine will fail them.

verses.textZh: 他们必不得住在耶和华之地； 以法莲要回到埃及去， 要在亚述吃不洁之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必不得住在耶和华之地； 以法莲要回到埃及去， 要在亚述吃不洁之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必不得住耶和华的地； 以法莲却要归回埃及， 必在亚述吃不洁净的食物。
verses.textEnNiv: They will not remain in the Lord ’s land; Ephraim will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not remain in the land of the Lord , but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean food in Assyria.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall not dwell in the Lord’s land, But Ephraim shall return to Egypt, And shall eat unclean things in Assyria.
verses.textEnNlt: You may no longer stay here in the Lord ’s land. Instead, you will return to Egypt, and in Assyria you will eat food that is ceremonially unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: They will not remain in the Lord’s land, But Ephraim will return to Egypt, And in Assyria they will eat unclean food.
verses.textEn: They will not remain in the Lord ’s land; Ephraim will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria.

verses.textZh: 他们必不得向耶和华奠酒， 他们的祭物也不能使他喜悦。 他们的饼好象丧家的饼， 凡吃这饼的，都必被玷污； 因为他们的饼只可自己吃， 不可带进耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必不得向耶和华奠酒， 他们的祭物也不能使他喜悦。 他们的饼好象丧家的饼， 凡吃这饼的，都必被玷污； 因为他们的饼只可自己吃， 不可带进耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必不得向耶和华奠酒， 即便奠酒也不蒙悦纳。 他们的祭物必如居丧者的食物， 凡吃的必被玷污； 因他们的食物只为自己的口腹， 必不奉入耶和华的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: They will not pour out wine offerings to the Lord , nor will their sacrifices please him. Such sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat them will be unclean. This food will be for themselves; it will not come into the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not pour drink offerings of wine to the Lord , and their sacrifices shall not please him. It shall be like mourners’ bread to them; all who eat of it shall be defiled; for their bread shall be for their hunger only; it shall not come to the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall not offer wine offerings to the Lord, Nor shall their sacrifices be pleasing to Him. Itshallbe like bread of mourners to them; All who eat it shall be defiled. For their bread shallbe for their own life; It shall not come into the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: There you will make no offerings of wine to the Lord . None of your sacrifices there will please him. They will be unclean, like food touched by a person in mourning. All who present such sacrifices will be defiled. They may eat this food themselves, but they may not offer it to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: They will not pour out drink offerings of wine to the Lord, Nor will their sacrifices please Him. Their bread will be to them like mourners’ bread; All who eat it will be defiled, Because their bread will be for themselves alone; It will not enter the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: They will not pour out wine offerings to the Lord , nor will their sacrifices please him. Such sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat them will be unclean. This food will be for themselves; it will not come into the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 那么，在规定集会的日子 和耶和华节期的时候， 你们能作甚么？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，在规定集会的日子 和耶和华节期的时候， 你们能作甚么？
verses.textZhCuv: 在大会的日子， 到耶和华的节期，你们怎样行呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What will you do on the day of your appointed festivals, on the feast days of the Lord ?
verses.textEnEsv: What will you do on the day of the appointed festival, and on the day of the feast of the Lord ?
verses.textEnNkjv: What will you do in the appointed day, And in the day of the feast of the Lord?
verses.textEnNlt: What then will you do on festival days? How will you observe the Lord ’s festivals?
verses.textEnNasb: What will you do on the day of the appointed festival And on the day of the feast of the Lord?
verses.textEn: What will you do on the day of your appointed festivals, on the feast days of the Lord ?

verses.textZh: 看哪！即使他们从毁灭中逃去， 埃及要收殓他们，摩弗要埋葬他们。 他们珍贵的银器必为蒺藜所占有， 他们的帐棚必长满荆棘。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！即使他们从毁灭中逃去， 埃及要收殓他们，摩弗要埋葬他们。 他们珍贵的银器必为蒺藜所占有， 他们的帐棚必长满荆棘。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，他们逃避灾难； 埃及人必收殓他们的尸首， 摩弗人必葬埋他们的骸骨。 他们用银子做的美物上必长蒺藜； 他们的帐棚中必生荆棘。
verses.textEnNiv: Even if they escape from destruction, Egypt will gather them, and Memphis will bury them. Their treasures of silver will be taken over by briers, and thorns will overrun their tents.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, they are going away from destruction; but Egypt shall gather them; Memphis shall bury them. Nettles shall possess their precious things of silver; thorns shall be in their tents.
verses.textEnNkjv: For indeed they are gone because of destruction. Egypt shall gather them up; Memphis shall bury them. Nettles shall possess their valuables of silver; Thorns shallbe in their tents.
verses.textEnNlt: Even if you escape destruction from Assyria, Egypt will conquer you, and Memphis will bury you. Nettles will take over your treasures of silver; thistles will invade your ruined homes.
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, they will be gone because of destruction; Egypt will gather them together, Memphis will bury them. Weeds will take possession of their treasures of silver; Thorns will be in their tents.
verses.textEn: Even if they escape from destruction, Egypt will gather them, and Memphis will bury them. Their treasures of silver will be taken over by briers, and thorns will overrun their tents.

verses.textZh: 惩罚的日子临近， 报应的时候来到， 以色列必定知道， 因着你们众多的罪孽和深仇大恨， 先知被看为愚昧， 受灵感动的人被当作疯子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 惩罚的日子临近， 报应的时候来到， 以色列必定知道， 因着你们众多的罪孽和深仇大恨， 先知被看为愚昧， 受灵感动的人被当作疯子。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人必知道降罚的日子临近， 报应的时候来到。 民说：作先知的是愚昧； 受灵感的是狂妄， 皆因他们多多作孽，大怀怨恨。
verses.textEnNiv: The days of punishment are coming, the days of reckoning are at hand. Let Israel know this. Because your sins are so many and your hostility so great, the prophet is considered a fool, the inspired person a maniac.
verses.textEnEsv: The days of punishment have come; the days of recompense have come; Israel shall know it. The prophet is a fool; the man of the spirit is mad, because of your great iniquity and great hatred.
verses.textEnNkjv: The days of punishment have come; The days of recompense have come. Israel knows! The prophet is a fool, The spiritual man is insane, Because of the greatness of your iniquity and great enmity.
verses.textEnNlt: The time of Israel’s punishment has come; the day of payment is here. Soon Israel will know this all too well. Because of your great sin and hostility, you say, "The prophets are crazy and the inspired men are fools!"
verses.textEnNasb: The days of punishment have come, The days of retribution have come; Let Israel know this! The prophet is a fool, The inspired person is insane, Because of the grossness of your wrongdoing, And because your hostility is so great.
verses.textEn: The days of punishment are coming, the days of reckoning are at hand. Let Israel know this. Because your sins are so many and your hostility so great, the prophet is considered a fool, the inspired person a maniac.

verses.textZh: 先知与神一同 作以法莲的守望者， 在他所行的一切路上，都满有捕鸟人的网罗， 在他神的家中只有仇恨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 先知与神一同 作以法莲的守望者， 在他所行的一切路上，都满有捕鸟人的网罗， 在他神的家中只有仇恨。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲曾作我神守望的； 至于先知，在他一切的道上作为捕鸟人的网罗， 在他神的家中怀怨恨。
verses.textEnNiv: The prophet, along with my God, is the watchman over Ephraim, yet snares await him on all his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.
verses.textEnEsv: The prophet is the watchman of Ephraim with my God; yet a fowler’s snare is on all his ways, and hatred in the house of his God.
verses.textEnNkjv: The watchman of Ephraim is with my God; But the prophet is a fowler’s snare in all his ways— Enmity in the house of his God.
verses.textEnNlt: The prophet is a watchman over Israel for my God, yet traps are laid for him wherever he goes. He faces hostility even in the house of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Ephraim was a watchman with my God, a prophet; Yet the snare of a bird catcher is in all his ways, And there is only hostility in the house of his God.
verses.textEn: The prophet, along with my God, is the watchman over Ephraim, yet snares await him on all his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.

verses.textZh: 以法莲深深败坏， 如同在基比亚的日子一般。神必记得他们的罪孽， 惩罚他们的罪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲深深败坏， 如同在基比亚的日子一般。神必记得他们的罪孽， 惩罚他们的罪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲深深地败坏， 如在基比亚的日子一样。 耶和华必记念他们的罪孽， 追讨他们的罪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: They have sunk deep into corruption, as in the days of Gibeah. God will remember their wickedness and punish them for their sins.
verses.textEnEsv: They have deeply corrupted themselves as in the days of Gibeah: he will remember their iniquity; he will punish their sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are deeply corrupted, As in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity; He will punish their sins.
verses.textEnNlt: The things my people do are as depraved as what they did in Gibeah long ago. God will not forget. He will surely punish them for their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: They are deeply depraved As in the days of Gibeah; He will remember their guilt, He will punish their sins.
verses.textEn: They have sunk deep into corruption, as in the days of Gibeah. God will remember their wickedness and punish them for their sins.

verses.textZh: "我遇见以色列，好象在旷野里遇见葡萄。 我看见你们的列祖，像看见无花果树初熟的果子。 他们却来到巴力．毘珥，专作羞耻的事， 成为可憎恶的，像他们所爱的偶像一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我遇见以色列，好象在旷野里遇见葡萄。 我看见你们的列祖，像看见无花果树初熟的果子。 他们却来到巴力．毘珥，专作羞耻的事， 成为可憎恶的，像他们所爱的偶像一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 主说：我遇见以色列如葡萄在旷野； 我看见你们的列祖如无花果树上春季初熟的果子。 他们却来到巴力‧毗珥专拜那可羞耻的， 就成为可憎恶的， 与他们所爱的一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "When I found Israel, it was like finding grapes in the desert; when I saw your ancestors, it was like seeing the early fruit on the fig tree. But when they came to Baal Peor, they consecrated themselves to that shameful idol and became as vile as the thing they loved.
verses.textEnEsv: Like grapes in the wilderness, I found Israel. Like the first fruit on the fig tree in its first season, I saw your fathers. But they came to Baal-peor and consecrated themselves to the thing of shame, and became detestable like the thing they loved.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I found Israel Like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers As the firstfruits on the fig tree in its first season. But they went to Baal Peor, And separated themselves tothat shame; They became an abomination like the thing they loved.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord says, "O Israel, when I first found you, it was like finding fresh grapes in the desert. When I saw your ancestors, it was like seeing the first ripe figs of the season. But then they deserted me for Baal-peor, giving themselves to that shameful idol. Soon they became vile, as vile as the god they worshiped.
verses.textEnNasb: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your forefathers as the earliest fruit on the fig tree in its first season. But they came to Baal-peor and devoted themselves to shame, And they became as detestable as that which they loved.
verses.textEn: "When I found Israel, it was like finding grapes in the desert; when I saw your ancestors, it was like seeing the early fruit on the fig tree. But when they came to Baal Peor, they consecrated themselves to that shameful idol and became as vile as the thing they loved.

verses.textZh: 至于以法莲，他们的荣耀必如鸟儿飞逝； 没有生育，没有怀胎，没有成孕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于以法莲，他们的荣耀必如鸟儿飞逝； 没有生育，没有怀胎，没有成孕。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于以法莲人，他们的荣耀必如鸟飞去， 必不生产，不怀胎，不成孕。
verses.textEnNiv: Ephraim’s glory will fly away like a bird— no birth, no pregnancy, no conception.
verses.textEnEsv: Ephraim’s glory shall fly away like a bird— no birth, no pregnancy, no conception!
verses.textEnNkjv: Asfor Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird— No birth, no pregnancy, and no conception!
verses.textEnNlt: The glory of Israel will fly away like a bird, for your children will not be born or grow in the womb or even be conceived.
verses.textEnNasb: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird— No birth, no pregnancy, and no conception!
verses.textEn: Ephraim’s glory will fly away like a bird— no birth, no pregnancy, no conception.

verses.textZh: 即使他们把儿女养大， 我也必使他们丧子，一个不留。 我离弃他们的时候，他们就有祸了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使他们把儿女养大， 我也必使他们丧子，一个不留。 我离弃他们的时候，他们就有祸了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 纵然养大儿女， 我却必使他们丧子，甚至不留一个。 我离弃他们，他们就有祸了。
verses.textEnNiv: Even if they rear children, I will bereave them of every one. Woe to them when I turn away from them!
verses.textEnEsv: Even if they bring up children, I will bereave them till none is left. Woe to them when I depart from them!
verses.textEnNkjv: Though they bring up their children, Yet I will bereave them to the last man. Yes, woe to them when I depart from them!
verses.textEnNlt: Even if you do have children who grow up, I will take them from you. It will be a terrible day when I turn away and leave you alone.
verses.textEnNasb: Though they bring up their children, Yet I will bereave them of their children until not a person is left. Yes, woe to them indeed when I depart from them!
verses.textEn: Even if they rear children, I will bereave them of every one. Woe to them when I turn away from them!

verses.textZh: 在我看来， 以法莲的儿女注定被当作猎物； 以法莲要把自己的儿女带出来，交给施行杀戮的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我看来， 以法莲的儿女注定被当作猎物； 以法莲要把自己的儿女带出来，交给施行杀戮的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看以法莲如泰尔栽于美地。 以法莲却要将自己的儿女带出来， 交与行杀戮的人。
verses.textEnNiv: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place. But Ephraim will bring out their children to the slayer."
verses.textEnEsv: Ephraim, as I have seen, was like a young palm planted in a meadow; but Ephraim must lead his children out to slaughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Just as I saw Ephraim like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place, So Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer."
verses.textEnNlt: I have watched Israel become as beautiful as Tyre. But now Israel will bring out her children for slaughter."
verses.textEnNasb: Ephraim, as I have seen, Is planted in a pasture like Tyre; But Ephraim is going to bring out his children for slaughter.
verses.textEn: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place. But Ephraim will bring out their children to the slayer."

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，求你赐给他们；你要赐给他们甚么呢？ 求你使他们坠胎小产，乳房萎缩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，求你赐给他们；你要赐给他们甚么呢？ 求你使他们坠胎小产，乳房萎缩。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你加给他们－ 加什么呢？ 要使他们胎坠乳干。
verses.textEnNiv: Give them, Lord — what will you give them? Give them wombs that miscarry and breasts that are dry.
verses.textEnEsv: Give them, O Lord — what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give them, O Lord— What will You give? Give them a miscarrying womb And dry breasts!
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , what should I request for your people? I will ask for wombs that don’t give birth and breasts that give no milk.
verses.textEnNasb: Give to them, Lord—what will You give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dried-up breasts.
verses.textEn: Give them, Lord — what will you give them? Give them wombs that miscarry and breasts that are dry.

verses.textZh: "他们的一切罪恶都在吉甲， 我在那里憎恨他们， 因他们的恶行， 我要把他们从我的家里赶出来； 我不再爱他们， 他们的领袖都是叛徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他们的一切罪恶都在吉甲， 我在那里憎恨他们， 因他们的恶行， 我要把他们从我的家里赶出来； 我不再爱他们， 他们的领袖都是叛徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：他们一切的恶事都在吉甲； 我在那里憎恶他们。 因他们所行的恶， 我必从我地上赶出他们去， 不再怜爱他们； 他们的首领都是悖逆的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Because of all their wickedness in Gilgal, I hated them there. Because of their sinful deeds, I will drive them out of my house. I will no longer love them; all their leaders are rebellious.
verses.textEnEsv: Every evil of theirs is in Gilgal; there I began to hate them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds I will drive them out of my house. I will love them no more; all their princes are rebels.
verses.textEnNkjv: "All their wickedness is in Gilgal, For there I hated them. Because of the evil of their deeds I will drive them from My house; I will love them no more. All their princes are rebellious.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord says, "All their wickedness began at Gilgal; there I began to hate them. I will drive them from my land because of their evil actions. I will love them no more because all their leaders are rebels.
verses.textEnNasb: All their evil is at Gilgal; Indeed, I came to hate them there! Because of the wickedness of their deeds I will drive them out of My house! I will no longer love them; All their leaders are rebels.
verses.textEn: "Because of all their wickedness in Gilgal, I hated them there. Because of their sinful deeds, I will drive them out of my house. I will no longer love them; all their leaders are rebellious.

verses.textZh: 以法莲被击打，他们的根枯干了， 必不能再结果子。 即使他们生产， 我必杀死他们所生的爱子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲被击打，他们的根枯干了， 必不能再结果子。 即使他们生产， 我必杀死他们所生的爱子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲受责罚， 根本枯干，必不能结果， 即或生产， 我必杀他们所生的爱子。
verses.textEnNiv: Ephraim is blighted, their root is withered, they yield no fruit. Even if they bear children, I will slay their cherished offspring."
verses.textEnEsv: Ephraim is stricken; their root is dried up; they shall bear no fruit. Even though they give birth, I will put their beloved children to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ephraim is stricken, Their root is dried up; They shall bear no fruit. Yes, were they to bear children, I would kill the darlings of their womb."
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel are struck down. Their roots are dried up, and they will bear no more fruit. And if they give birth, I will slaughter their beloved children."
verses.textEnNasb: Ephraim is stricken, their root is dried up, They will produce no fruit. Even though they give birth to children, I will put to death the precious ones of their womb.
verses.textEn: Ephraim is blighted, their root is withered, they yield no fruit. Even if they bear children, I will slay their cherished offspring."

verses.textZh: 我的神必弃绝他们， 因为他们不听从他； 他们必在列国中飘流。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神必弃绝他们， 因为他们不听从他； 他们必在列国中飘流。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神必弃绝他们， 因为他们不听从他； 他们也必飘流在列国中。
verses.textEnNiv: My God will reject them because they have not obeyed him; they will be wanderers among the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: My God will reject them because they have not listened to him; they shall be wanderers among the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: My God will cast them away, Because they did not obey Him; And they shall be wanderers among the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: My God will reject the people of Israel because they will not listen or obey. They will be wanderers, homeless among the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: My God will reject them Because they have not listened to Him; And they will be wanderers among the nations.
verses.textEn: My God will reject them because they have not obeyed him; they will be wanderers among the nations.

verses.textZh: 以色列最茂盛的葡萄树， 自己能结果子。 他的果子越多， 他就越增添祭坛； 他的土地越肥美， 他就使柱像越美丽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列最茂盛的葡萄树， 自己能结果子。 他的果子越多， 他就越增添祭坛； 他的土地越肥美， 他就使柱像越美丽。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列是茂盛的葡萄树，结果繁多。 果子越多，就越增添祭坛； 地土越肥美，就越造美丽的柱像。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel was a spreading vine; he brought forth fruit for himself. As his fruit increased, he built more altars; as his land prospered, he adorned his sacred stones.
verses.textEnEsv: Israel is a luxuriant vine that yields its fruit. The more his fruit increased, the more altars he built; as his country improved, he improved his pillars.
verses.textEnNkjv: Israel empties his vine; He brings forth fruit for himself. According to the multitude of his fruit He has increased the altars; According to the bounty of his land They have embellished hissacred pillars.
verses.textEnNlt: How prosperous Israel is— a luxuriant vine loaded with fruit. But the richer the people get, the more pagan altars they build. The more bountiful their harvests, the more beautiful their sacred pillars.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel is a luxuriant vine; He produces fruit for himself. The more his fruit, The more altars he made; The richer his land, The better he made the memorial stones.
verses.textEn: Israel was a spreading vine; he brought forth fruit for himself. As his fruit increased, he built more altars; as his land prospered, he adorned his sacred stones.

verses.textZh: 他们心怀诡诈， 现在要承担这罪的惩罚。 耶和华必拆毁他们的祭坛， 毁坏他们的柱像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们心怀诡诈， 现在要承担这罪的惩罚。 耶和华必拆毁他们的祭坛， 毁坏他们的柱像。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们心怀二意， 现今要定为有罪。 耶和华必拆毁他们的祭坛， 毁坏他们的柱像。
verses.textEnNiv: Their heart is deceitful, and now they must bear their guilt. The Lord will demolish their altars and destroy their sacred stones.
verses.textEnEsv: Their heart is false; now they must bear their guilt. The Lord will break down their altars and destroy their pillars.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their heart is divided; Now they are held guilty. He will break down their altars; He will ruin their sacred pillars.
verses.textEnNlt: The hearts of the people are fickle; they are guilty and must be punished. The Lord will break down their altars and smash their sacred pillars.
verses.textEnNasb: Their heart is deceitful; Now they must suffer for their guilt. The Lord will break down their altars And destroy their memorial stones.
verses.textEn: Their heart is deceitful, and now they must bear their guilt. The Lord will demolish their altars and destroy their sacred stones.

verses.textZh: 那时他们必说："我们没有君王，因为我们不敬畏耶和华。 至于君王，他能为我们作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时他们必说："我们没有君王，因为我们不敬畏耶和华。 至于君王，他能为我们作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必说：我们没有王， 因为我们不敬畏耶和华。 王能为我们做什么呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Then they will say, "We have no king because we did not revere the Lord . But even if we had a king, what could he do for us?"
verses.textEnEsv: For now they will say: "We have no king, for we do not fear the Lord ; and a king—what could he do for us?"
verses.textEnNkjv: For now they say, "We have no king, Because we did not fear the Lord. And as for a king, what would he do for us?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then they will say, "We have no king because we didn’t fear the Lord . But even if we had a king, what could he do for us anyway?"
verses.textEnNasb: Certainly now they will say, "We have no king, For we do not revere the Lord. As for the king, what can he do for us?"
verses.textEn: Then they will say, "We have no king because we did not revere the Lord . But even if we had a king, what could he do for us?"

verses.textZh: 他们说很多话， 起假誓，又立盟约； 所以审判像毒草一般在田间的犁沟中生长起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说很多话， 起假誓，又立盟约； 所以审判像毒草一般在田间的犁沟中生长起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们为立约说谎言，起假誓； 因此，灾罚如苦菜滋生在田间的犁沟中。
verses.textEnNiv: They make many promises, take false oaths and make agreements; therefore lawsuits spring up like poisonous weeds in a plowed field.
verses.textEnEsv: They utter mere words; with empty oaths they make covenants; so judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have spoken words, Swearing falsely in making a covenant. Thus judgment springs up like hemlock in the furrows of the field.
verses.textEnNlt: They spout empty words and make covenants they don’t intend to keep. So injustice springs up among them like poisonous weeds in a farmer’s field.
verses.textEnNasb: They speak mere words, With worthless oaths they make covenants; And judgment sprouts like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.
verses.textEn: They make many promises, take false oaths and make agreements; therefore lawsuits spring up like poisonous weeds in a plowed field.

verses.textZh: 撒玛利亚的居民 必因伯．亚文的牛犊而惧怕； 拜牛犊的人民必为它哀恸。 拜牛犊的祭司必为它哀号， 都因它的荣耀离开它而被掳去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒玛利亚的居民 必因伯．亚文的牛犊而惧怕； 拜牛犊的人民必为它哀恸。 拜牛犊的祭司必为它哀号， 都因它的荣耀离开它而被掳去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒马利亚的居民必因伯‧亚文的牛犊惊恐； 崇拜牛犊的民和喜爱牛犊的祭司 都必因荣耀离开它，为它悲哀。
verses.textEnNiv: The people who live in Samaria fear for the calf-idol of Beth Aven. Its people will mourn over it, and so will its idolatrous priests, those who had rejoiced over its splendor, because it is taken from them into exile.
verses.textEnEsv: The inhabitants of Samaria tremble for the calf of Beth-aven. Its people mourn for it, and so do its idolatrous priests— those who rejoiced over it and over its glory— for it has departed from them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The inhabitants of Samaria fear Because of the calf of Beth Aven. For its people mourn for it, And its priests shriek for it— Because its glory has departed from it.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Samaria tremble in fear for their calf idol at Beth-aven, and they mourn for it. Though its priests rejoice over it, its glory will be stripped away.
verses.textEnNasb: The inhabitants of Samaria will fear For the calf of Beth-aven. Indeed, its people will mourn for it, And its idolatrous priests will cry out over it, Over its glory, since it has left it.
verses.textEn: The people who live in Samaria fear for the calf-idol of Beth Aven. Its people will mourn over it, and so will its idolatrous priests, those who had rejoiced over its splendor, because it is taken from them into exile.

verses.textZh: 人要把它带到亚述去， 作贡物献给那里的大王。 以法莲必受羞辱， 以色列必因自己的计谋蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人要把它带到亚述去， 作贡物献给那里的大王。 以法莲必受羞辱， 以色列必因自己的计谋蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 人必将牛犊带到亚述当作礼物， 献给耶雷布王。 以法莲必蒙羞； 以色列必因自己的计谋惭愧。
verses.textEnNiv: It will be carried to Assyria as tribute for the great king. Ephraim will be disgraced; Israel will be ashamed of its foreign alliances.
verses.textEnEsv: The thing itself shall be carried to Assyria as tribute to the great king. Ephraim shall be put to shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his idol.
verses.textEnNkjv: Theidol also shall be carried to Assyria As a present for King Jareb. Ephraim shall receive shame, And Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.textEnNlt: This idol will be carted away to Assyria, a gift to the great king there. Ephraim will be ridiculed and Israel will be shamed, because its people have trusted in this idol.
verses.textEnNasb: The thing itself will be brought to Assyria As a gift of tribute to King Jareb; Ephraim will be seized with shame, And Israel will be ashamed of its own plan.
verses.textEn: It will be carried to Assyria as tribute for the great king. Ephraim will be disgraced; Israel will be ashamed of its foreign alliances.

verses.textZh: 至于撒玛利亚，她与她的君王必被剪除； 好象浮在水面的枯枝一般。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于撒玛利亚，她与她的君王必被剪除； 好象浮在水面的枯枝一般。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于撒马利亚，她的王必灭没， 如水面的沫子一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Samaria’s king will be destroyed, swept away like a twig on the surface of the waters.
verses.textEnEsv: Samaria’s king shall perish like a twig on the face of the waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asfor Samaria, her king is cut off Like a twig on the water.
verses.textEnNlt: Samaria and its king will be cut off; they will float away like driftwood on an ocean wave.
verses.textEnNasb: Samaria will be destroyed with her king, Like a twig on the surface of the water.
verses.textEn: Samaria’s king will be destroyed, swept away like a twig on the surface of the waters.

verses.textZh: 伯．亚文的邱坛，就是以色列的罪恶，都要被拆毁； 荆棘和蒺藜必在他们的祭坛上面长起来。 那时人要对大山说： "遮盖我们！"对小山说："倒在我们身上！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 伯．亚文的邱坛，就是以色列的罪恶，都要被拆毁； 荆棘和蒺藜必在他们的祭坛上面长起来。 那时人要对大山说： "遮盖我们！"对小山说："倒在我们身上！"
verses.textZhCuv: 伯‧亚文的邱坛－ 就是以色列取罪的地方必被毁灭； 荆棘和蒺藜必长在他们的祭坛上。 他们必对大山说：遮盖我们！ 对小山说：倒在我们身上！
verses.textEnNiv: The high places of wickedness will be destroyed— it is the sin of Israel. Thorns and thistles will grow up and cover their altars. Then they will say to the mountains, "Cover us!" and to the hills, "Fall on us!"
verses.textEnEsv: The high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed. Thorn and thistle shall grow up on their altars, and they shall say to the mountains, "Cover us," and to the hills, "Fall on us."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, Shall be destroyed. The thorn and thistle shall grow on their altars; They shall say to the mountains, "Cover us!" And to the hills, "Fall on us!"
verses.textEnNlt: And the pagan shrines of Aven, the place of Israel’s sin, will crumble. Thorns and thistles will grow up around their altars. They will beg the mountains, "Bury us!" and plead with the hills, "Fall on us!"
verses.textEnNasb: Also the high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed; Thorns and thistles will grow on their altars; Then they will say to the mountains, "Cover us!" And to the hills, "Fall on us!"
verses.textEn: The high places of wickedness will be destroyed— it is the sin of Israel. Thorns and thistles will grow up and cover their altars. Then they will say to the mountains, "Cover us!" and to the hills, "Fall on us!"

verses.textZh: 以色列啊！从基比亚的日子以来， 你就犯罪， 他们仍然留在那里， 难道攻击恶人的战祸不能在基比亚赶上他们吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列啊！从基比亚的日子以来， 你就犯罪， 他们仍然留在那里， 难道攻击恶人的战祸不能在基比亚赶上他们吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列啊， 你从基比亚的日子以来时常犯罪。 你们的先人曾站在那里， 现今住基比亚的人 以为攻击罪孽之辈的战事临不到自己。
verses.textEnNiv: "Since the days of Gibeah, you have sinned, Israel, and there you have remained. Will not war again overtake the evildoers in Gibeah?
verses.textEnEsv: From the days of Gibeah, you have sinned, O Israel; there they have continued. Shall not the war against the unjust overtake them in Gibeah?
verses.textEnNkjv: "O Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah; There they stood. The battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity Did not overtake them.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord says, "O Israel, ever since Gibeah, there has been only sin and more sin! You have made no progress whatsoever. Was it not right that the wicked men of Gibeah were attacked?
verses.textEnNasb: Since the days of Gibeah you have sinned, Israel; There they stand! Will the battle against the sons of injustice not overtake them in Gibeah?
verses.textEn: "Since the days of Gibeah, you have sinned, Israel, and there you have remained. Will not war again overtake the evildoers in Gibeah?

verses.textZh: 我必来惩罚他们； 他们被自己那双重的罪孽捆绑的时候， 列国就集结起来攻击他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必来惩罚他们； 他们被自己那双重的罪孽捆绑的时候， 列国就集结起来攻击他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必随意惩罚他们。 他们为两样的罪所缠； 列邦的民必聚集攻击他们。
verses.textEnNiv: When I please, I will punish them; nations will be gathered against them to put them in bonds for their double sin.
verses.textEnEsv: When I please, I will discipline them, and nations shall be gathered against them when they are bound up for their double iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: When itis My desire, I will chasten them. Peoples shall be gathered against them When I bind them for their two transgressions.
verses.textEnNlt: Now whenever it fits my plan, I will attack you, too. I will call out the armies of the nations to punish you for your multiplied sins.
verses.textEnNasb: When it is My desire, I will discipline them; And the peoples will be gathered against them When they are bound for their double guilt.
verses.textEn: When I please, I will punish them; nations will be gathered against them to put them in bonds for their double sin.

verses.textZh: 以法莲是一头驯服的母牛犊，喜爱踹谷； 我却要把轭扣在牠肥美的颈项上， 我要使以法莲拖犁； 犹大要耕田，雅各必为自己耙地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲是一头驯服的母牛犊，喜爱踹谷； 我却要把轭扣在牠肥美的颈项上， 我要使以法莲拖犁； 犹大要耕田，雅各必为自己耙地。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲是驯良的母牛犊，喜爱踹谷， 我却将轭加在它肥美的颈项上， 我要使以法莲拉套 。 犹大必耕田； 雅各必耙地。
verses.textEnNiv: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh; so I will put a yoke on her fair neck. I will drive Ephraim, Judah must plow, and Jacob must break up the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: Ephraim was a trained calf that loved to thresh, and I spared her fair neck; but I will put Ephraim to the yoke; Judah must plow; Jacob must harrow for himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ephraim is a trained heifer That loves to thresh grain; But I harnessed her fair neck, I will make Ephraim pull aplow. Judah shall plow; Jacob shall break his clods."
verses.textEnNlt: "Israel is like a trained heifer treading out the grain— an easy job she loves. But I will put a heavy yoke on her tender neck. I will force Judah to pull the plow and Israel to break up the hard ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh, And I passed over her lovely neck; I will harness Ephraim, Judah will plow, Jacob will harrow for himself.
verses.textEn: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh; so I will put a yoke on her fair neck. I will drive Ephraim, Judah must plow, and Jacob must break up the ground.

verses.textZh: 你们要为自己撒种公义， 就能收割慈爱的果子， 你们要翻松荒地。 现在是寻求耶和华的时候， 直等到他来，降下公义的雨在你们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要为自己撒种公义， 就能收割慈爱的果子， 你们要翻松荒地。 现在是寻求耶和华的时候， 直等到他来，降下公义的雨在你们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要为自己栽种公义， 就能收割慈爱。 现今正是寻求耶和华的时候； 你们要开垦荒地，等他临到， 使公义如雨降在你们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: Sow righteousness for yourselves, reap the fruit of unfailing love, and break up your unplowed ground; for it is time to seek the Lord , until he comes and showers his righteousness on you.
verses.textEnEsv: Sow for yourselves righteousness; reap steadfast love; break up your fallow ground, for it is the time to seek the Lord , that he may come and rain righteousness upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sow for yourselves righteousness; Reap in mercy; Break up your fallow ground, For itis time to seek the Lord, Till He comes and rains righteousness on you.
verses.textEnNlt: I said, ‘Plant the good seeds of righteousness, and you will harvest a crop of love. Plow up the hard ground of your hearts, for now is the time to seek the Lord , that he may come and shower righteousness upon you.’
verses.textEnNasb: Sow for yourselves, with a view to righteousness; Harvest in accordance with kindness. Break up your uncultivated ground, For it is time to seek the Lord Until He comes and rains righteousness on you.
verses.textEn: Sow righteousness for yourselves, reap the fruit of unfailing love, and break up your unplowed ground; for it is time to seek the Lord , until he comes and showers his righteousness on you.

verses.textZh: 你们耕种奸恶，收割不义， 自吃谎言的果子； 因为你倚靠自己的能力和众多的勇士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们耕种奸恶，收割不义， 自吃谎言的果子； 因为你倚靠自己的能力和众多的勇士。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们耕种的是奸恶， 收割的是罪孽， 吃的是谎话的果子。 因你倚靠自己的行为， 仰赖勇士众多，
verses.textEnNiv: But you have planted wickedness, you have reaped evil, you have eaten the fruit of deception. Because you have depended on your own strength and on your many warriors,
verses.textEnEsv: You have plowed iniquity; you have reaped injustice; you have eaten the fruit of lies. Because you have trusted in your own way and in the multitude of your warriors,
verses.textEnNkjv: You have plowed wickedness; You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, Because you trusted in your own way, In the multitude of your mighty men.
