verses.textEnNlt: "But you have cultivated wickedness and harvested a thriving crop of sins. You have eaten the fruit of lies— trusting in your military might, believing that great armies could make your nation safe.
verses.textEnNasb: You have plowed wickedness, you have harvested injustice, You have eaten the fruit of lies. Because you have trusted in your way, in your many warriors,
verses.textEn: But you have planted wickedness, you have reaped evil, you have eaten the fruit of deception. Because you have depended on your own strength and on your many warriors,

verses.textZh: 所以必有哄嚷之声攻击你的众民， 你的一切城堡都必被毁坏， 正如沙勒幔在争战的日子毁坏伯．亚比勒一般， 有母亲与儿女一同在那里被摔死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以必有哄嚷之声攻击你的众民， 你的一切城堡都必被毁坏， 正如沙勒幔在争战的日子毁坏伯．亚比勒一般， 有母亲与儿女一同在那里被摔死。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以在这民中必有哄嚷之声， 你一切的保障必被拆毁， 就如沙勒幔在争战的日子拆毁伯‧亚比勒， 将其中的母子一同摔死。
verses.textEnNiv: the roar of battle will rise against your people, so that all your fortresses will be devastated— as Shalman devastated Beth Arbel on the day of battle, when mothers were dashed to the ground with their children.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore the tumult of war shall arise among your people, and all your fortresses shall be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth-arbel on the day of battle; mothers were dashed in pieces with their children.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore tumult shall arise among your people, And all your fortresses shall be plundered As Shalman plundered Beth Arbel in the day of battle— A mother dashed in pieces upon her children.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the terrors of war will rise among your people. All your fortifications will fall, just as when Shalman destroyed Beth-arbel. Even mothers and children were dashed to death there.
verses.textEnNasb: An uproar will arise among your people, And all your fortresses will be destroyed, As Shalman destroyed Beth-arbel on the day of battle, When mothers were slaughtered with their children.
verses.textEn: the roar of battle will rise against your people, so that all your fortresses will be devastated— as Shalman devastated Beth Arbel on the day of battle, when mothers were dashed to the ground with their children.

verses.textZh: 伯特利啊，因你们的罪大恶极， 我必这样待你们。 在风暴中，以色列的王必全然被除灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 伯特利啊，因你们的罪大恶极， 我必这样待你们。 在风暴中，以色列的王必全然被除灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他们的大恶， 伯特利必使你们遭遇如此。 到了黎明，以色列的王必全然灭绝。
verses.textEnNiv: So will it happen to you, Bethel, because your wickedness is great. When that day dawns, the king of Israel will be completely destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus it shall be done to you, O Bethel, because of your great evil. At dawn the king of Israel shall be utterly cut off.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus it shall be done to you, O Bethel, Because of your great wickedness. At dawn the king of Israel Shall be cut off utterly.
verses.textEnNlt: You will share that fate, Bethel, because of your great wickedness. When the day of judgment dawns, the king of Israel will be completely destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: So it will be done to you at Bethel because of your great wickedness. At dawn the king of Israel will be completely destroyed.
verses.textEn: So will it happen to you, Bethel, because your wickedness is great. When that day dawns, the king of Israel will be completely destroyed.

verses.textZh: "以色列年幼的时候，我就爱他。 我从埃及召我的儿子出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列年幼的时候，我就爱他。 我从埃及召我的儿子出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列年幼的时候，我爱他， 就从埃及召出我的儿子来。
verses.textEnNiv: "When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.
verses.textEnEsv: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When Israel was a child, I loved him, And out of Egypt I called My son.
verses.textEnNlt: "When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: When Israel was a youth I loved him, And out of Egypt I called My son.
verses.textEn: "When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.

verses.textZh: 可是我越发呼唤他们， 他们越发走开； 他们给巴力献祭， 向偶像烧香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是我越发呼唤他们， 他们越发走开； 他们给巴力献祭， 向偶像烧香。
verses.textZhCuv: 先知越发招呼他们， 他们越发走开， 向诸巴力献祭， 给雕刻的偶像烧香。
verses.textEnNiv: But the more they were called, the more they went away from me. They sacrificed to the Baals and they burned incense to images.
verses.textEnEsv: The more they were called, the more they went away; they kept sacrificing to the Baals and burning offerings to idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: As they called them, So they went from them; They sacrificed to the Baals, And burned incense to carved images.
verses.textEnNlt: But the more I called to him, the farther he moved from me, offering sacrifices to the images of Baal and burning incense to idols.
verses.textEnNasb: The more they called them, The more they went away from them; They kept sacrificing to the Baals And burning incense to idols.
verses.textEn: But the more they were called, the more they went away from me. They sacrificed to the Baals and they burned incense to images.

verses.textZh: 然而是我教导以法莲走路的； 我用双臂抱他们， 他们却不知道是我医治了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而是我教导以法莲走路的； 我用双臂抱他们， 他们却不知道是我医治了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我原教导以法莲行走， 用膀臂抱着他们， 他们却不知道是我医治他们。
verses.textEnNiv: It was I who taught Ephraim to walk, taking them by the arms; but they did not realize it was I who healed them.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet it was I who taught Ephraim to walk; I took them up by their arms, but they did not know that I healed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I taught Ephraim to walk, Taking them by their arms; But they did not know that I healed them.
verses.textEnNlt: I myself taught Israel how to walk, leading him along by the hand. But he doesn’t know or even care that it was I who took care of him.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet it is I who taught Ephraim to walk, I took them in My arms; But they did not know that I healed them.
verses.textEn: It was I who taught Ephraim to walk, taking them by the arms; but they did not realize it was I who healed them.

verses.textZh: 我用慈绳爱索 牵引他们， 我待他们像人拉高牛的轭在两颚之上， 又向他们俯身，喂养他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我用慈绳爱索 牵引他们， 我待他们像人拉高牛的轭在两颚之上， 又向他们俯身，喂养他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我用慈绳 爱索牵引他们； 我待他们如人放松牛的两腮夹板， 把粮食放在他们面前。
verses.textEnNiv: I led them with cords of human kindness, with ties of love. To them I was like one who lifts a little child to the cheek, and I bent down to feed them.
verses.textEnEsv: I led them with cords of kindness, with the bands of love, and I became to them as one who eases the yoke on their jaws, and I bent down to them and fed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: I drew them with gentle cords, With bands of love, And I was to them as those who take the yoke from their neck. I stooped and fed them.
verses.textEnNlt: I led Israel along with my ropes of kindness and love. I lifted the yoke from his neck, and I myself stooped to feed him.
verses.textEnNasb: I pulled them along with cords of a man, with ropes of love, And I became to them as one who lifts the yoke from their jaws; And I bent down and fed them.
verses.textEn: I led them with cords of human kindness, with ties of love. To them I was like one who lifts a little child to the cheek, and I bent down to feed them.

verses.textZh: "他们必返回埃及地 ， 亚述要作他们的王； 因为他们不肯回来归我。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他们必返回埃及地 ， 亚述要作他们的王； 因为他们不肯回来归我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必不归回埃及地， 亚述人却要作他们的王， 因他们不肯归向我。
verses.textEnNiv: "Will they not return to Egypt and will not Assyria rule over them because they refuse to repent?
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not return to the land of Egypt, but Assyria shall be their king, because they have refused to return to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "He shall not return to the land of Egypt; But the Assyrian shall be his king, Because they refused to repent.
verses.textEnNlt: "But since my people refuse to return to me, they will return to Egypt and will be forced to serve Assyria.
verses.textEnNasb: They will not return to the land of Egypt; But Assyria—he will be their king Because they refused to return to Me.
verses.textEn: "Will they not return to Egypt and will not Assyria rule over them because they refuse to repent?

verses.textZh: 刀剑必在他们的城中飞舞， 毁坏他们的门闩， 因着他们自己的计谋，吞灭他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 刀剑必在他们的城中飞舞， 毁坏他们的门闩， 因着他们自己的计谋，吞灭他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 刀剑必临到他们的城邑， 毁坏门闩，把人吞灭， 都因他们随从自己的计谋。
verses.textEnNiv: A sword will flash in their cities; it will devour their false prophets and put an end to their plans.
verses.textEnEsv: The sword shall rage against their cities, consume the bars of their gates, and devour them because of their own counsels.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sword shall slash in his cities, Devour his districts, And consume them, Because of their own counsels.
verses.textEnNlt: War will swirl through their cities; their enemies will crash through their gates. They will destroy them, trapping them in their own evil plans.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sword will whirl against their cities, And will destroy their oracle priests And consume them, because of their counsels.
verses.textEn: A sword will flash in their cities; it will devour their false prophets and put an end to their plans.

verses.textZh: 我的子民决要背道离开我， 他们因着所负的轭而呼求， 却没有人给他们卸下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的子民决要背道离开我， 他们因着所负的轭而呼求， 却没有人给他们卸下。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的民偏要背道离开我； 众先知虽然招呼他们归向至上的主， 却无人尊崇主。
verses.textEnNiv: My people are determined to turn from me. Even though they call me God Most High, I will by no means exalt them.
verses.textEnEsv: My people are bent on turning away from me, and though they call out to the Most High, he shall not raise them up at all.
verses.textEnNkjv: My people are bent on backsliding from Me. Though they call to the Most High, None at all exalt Him.
verses.textEnNlt: For my people are determined to desert me. They call me the Most High, but they don’t truly honor me.
verses.textEnNasb: So My people are determined to turn from Me. Though they call them to the One on high, None at all exalts Him.
verses.textEn: My people are determined to turn from me. Even though they call me God Most High, I will by no means exalt them.

verses.textZh: "以法莲啊，我怎能舍弃你！ 以色列啊，我怎能把你交出来！ 我怎能对你如同押玛， 待你好象洗扁呢！ 我的心肠翻转， 我的怜悯发动。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以法莲啊，我怎能舍弃你！ 以色列啊，我怎能把你交出来！ 我怎能对你如同押玛， 待你好象洗扁呢！ 我的心肠翻转， 我的怜悯发动。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲哪，我怎能舍弃你？ 以色列啊，我怎能弃绝你？ 我怎能使你如押玛？ 怎能使你如洗扁？ 我回心转意， 我的怜爱大大发动。
verses.textEnNiv: "How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I treat you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboyim? My heart is changed within me; all my compassion is aroused.
verses.textEnEsv: How can I give you up, O Ephraim? How can I hand you over, O Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I treat you like Zeboiim? My heart recoils within me; my compassion grows warm and tender.
verses.textEnNkjv: "How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I set you like Zeboiim? My heart churns within Me; My sympathy is stirred.
verses.textEnNlt: "Oh, how can I give you up, Israel? How can I let you go? How can I destroy you like Admah or demolish you like Zeboiim? My heart is torn within me, and my compassion overflows.
verses.textEnNasb: How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I surrender you, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I treat you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned over within Me, All My compassions are kindled.
verses.textEn: "How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I treat you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboyim? My heart is changed within me; all my compassion is aroused.

verses.textZh: 我必不让我的烈怒发作， 必不再毁灭以法莲； 因为我是神，不是世人；我是你们中间的圣者， 必不会含怒而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必不让我的烈怒发作， 必不再毁灭以法莲； 因为我是神，不是世人；我是你们中间的圣者， 必不会含怒而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必不发猛烈的怒气， 也不再毁灭以法莲。 因我是神，并非世人， 是你们中间的圣者； 我必不在怒中临到你们。
verses.textEnNiv: I will not carry out my fierce anger, nor will I devastate Ephraim again. For I am God, and not a man— the Holy One among you. I will not come against their cities.
verses.textEnEsv: I will not execute my burning anger; I will not again destroy Ephraim; for I am God and not a man, the Holy One in your midst, and I will not come in wrath.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will not execute the fierceness of My anger; I will not again destroy Ephraim. For I am God, and not man, The Holy One in your midst; And I will not come with terror.
verses.textEnNlt: No, I will not unleash my fierce anger. I will not completely destroy Israel, for I am God and not a mere mortal. I am the Holy One living among you, and I will not come to destroy.
verses.textEnNasb: I will not carry out My fierce anger; I will not destroy Ephraim again. For I am God and not a man, the Holy One in your midst, And I will not come in wrath.
verses.textEn: I will not carry out my fierce anger, nor will I devastate Ephraim again. For I am God, and not a man— the Holy One among you. I will not come against their cities.

verses.textZh: 他们必跟随耶和华； 耶和华要像狮子吼叫； 他一吼叫， 他们就从西方战战兢兢而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必跟随耶和华； 耶和华要像狮子吼叫； 他一吼叫， 他们就从西方战战兢兢而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必如狮子吼叫， 子民必跟随他。 他一吼叫， 他们就从西方急速而来。
verses.textEnNiv: They will follow the Lord ; he will roar like a lion. When he roars, his children will come trembling from the west.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall go after the Lord ; he will roar like a lion; when he roars, his children shall come trembling from the west;
verses.textEnNkjv: "They shall walk after the Lord. He will roar like a lion. When He roars, Then His sons shall come trembling from the west;
verses.textEnNlt: For someday the people will follow me. I, the Lord , will roar like a lion. And when I roar, my people will return trembling from the west.
verses.textEnNasb: They will walk after the Lord, He will roar like a lion; Indeed He will roar, And His sons will come trembling from the west.
verses.textEn: They will follow the Lord ; he will roar like a lion. When he roars, his children will come trembling from the west.

verses.textZh: 他们必战战兢兢而来，像从埃及赶来的飞鸟， 如从亚述地赶来的鸽子， 我要使他们住在自己的房子里。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必战战兢兢而来，像从埃及赶来的飞鸟， 如从亚述地赶来的鸽子， 我要使他们住在自己的房子里。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必如雀鸟从埃及急速而来， 又如鸽子从亚述地来到。 我必使他们住自己的房屋。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: They will come from Egypt, trembling like sparrows, from Assyria, fluttering like doves. I will settle them in their homes," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: they shall come trembling like birds from Egypt, and like doves from the land of Assyria, and I will return them to their homes, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall come trembling like a bird from Egypt, Like a dove from the land of Assyria. And I will let them dwell in their houses," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Like a flock of birds, they will come from Egypt. Trembling like doves, they will return from Assyria. And I will bring them home again," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: They will come trembling like birds from Egypt, And like doves from the land of Assyria; And I will settle them in their houses, declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: They will come from Egypt, trembling like sparrows, from Assyria, fluttering like doves. I will settle them in their homes," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 以法莲用虚谎， 以色列家用诡诈包围着我； 犹大还是与神对抗， 就是对抗那可信可靠的至圣者。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲用虚谎， 以色列家用诡诈包围着我； 犹大还是与神对抗， 就是对抗那可信可靠的至圣者。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲用谎话， 以色列家用诡计围绕我； 犹大却靠神掌权， 向圣者有忠心 。
verses.textEnNiv: Ephraim has surrounded me with lies, Israel with deceit. And Judah is unruly against God, even against the faithful Holy One.
verses.textEnEsv: Ephraim has surrounded me with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit, but Judah still walks with God and is faithful to the Holy One.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Ephraim has encircled Me with lies, And the house of Israel with deceit; But Judah still walks with God, Even with the Holy One whois faithful.
verses.textEnNlt: Israel surrounds me with lies and deceit, but Judah still obeys God and is faithful to the Holy One.
verses.textEnNasb: Ephraim surrounds Me with lies And the house of Israel with deceit; Judah is still unruly against God, Even against the Holy One who is faithful.
verses.textEn: Ephraim has surrounded me with lies, Israel with deceit. And Judah is unruly against God, even against the faithful Holy One.

verses.textZh: "以法莲吃风， 整天追赶东风， 增添虚谎和强暴。 他们与亚述结盟， 又给埃及送油。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "以法莲吃风， 整天追赶东风， 增添虚谎和强暴。 他们与亚述结盟， 又给埃及送油。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲吃风，且追赶东风， 时常增添虚谎和强暴， 与亚述立约，把油送到埃及。
verses.textEnNiv: Ephraim feeds on the wind; he pursues the east wind all day and multiplies lies and violence. He makes a treaty with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Ephraim feeds on the wind and pursues the east wind all day long; they multiply falsehood and violence; they make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried to Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Ephraim feeds on the wind, And pursues the east wind; He daily increases lies and desolation. Also they make a covenant with the Assyrians, And oil is carried to Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel feed on the wind; they chase after the east wind all day long. They pile up lies and violence; they are making an alliance with Assyria while sending olive oil to buy support from Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Ephraim feeds on wind, And pursues the east wind continually; He multiplies lies and violence. Moreover, he makes a covenant with Assyria, And oil is brought to Egypt.
verses.textEn: Ephraim feeds on the wind; he pursues the east wind all day and multiplies lies and violence. He makes a treaty with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt.

verses.textZh: 耶和华与犹大争辩； 他必照雅各所行的惩罚他， 按他所作的报应他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华与犹大争辩； 他必照雅各所行的惩罚他， 按他所作的报应他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华与犹大争辩， 必照雅各所行的惩罚他， 按他所做的报应他。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has a charge to bring against Judah; he will punish Jacob according to his ways and repay him according to his deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has an indictment against Judah and will punish Jacob according to his ways; he will repay him according to his deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord also brings a charge against Judah, And will punish Jacob according to his ways; According to his deeds He will recompense him.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Lord is bringing charges against Judah. He is about to punish Jacob for all his deceitful ways, and pay him back for all he has done.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord also has a case against Judah, And will punish Jacob according to his ways; He will repay him according to his deeds.
verses.textEn: The Lord has a charge to bring against Judah; he will punish Jacob according to his ways and repay him according to his deeds.

verses.textZh: 他在母腹中抓住他哥哥的脚跟， 壮年的时候又与神角力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在母腹中抓住他哥哥的脚跟， 壮年的时候又与神角力。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在腹中抓住哥哥的脚跟， 壮年的时候与神较力，
verses.textEnNiv: In the womb he grasped his brother’s heel; as a man he struggled with God.
verses.textEnEsv: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he strove with God.
verses.textEnNkjv: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, And in his strength he struggled with God.
verses.textEnNlt: Even in the womb, Jacob struggled with his brother; when he became a man, he even fought with God.
verses.textEnNasb: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, And in his mature strength he contended with God.
verses.textEn: In the womb he grasped his brother’s heel; as a man he struggled with God.

verses.textZh: 他与天使角力，并且得胜； 他哀哭，向他求恩。 他在伯特利遇见神，神在那里对他说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他与天使角力，并且得胜； 他哀哭，向他求恩。 他在伯特利遇见神，神在那里对他说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 哭泣恳求， 在伯特利遇见耶和华。 耶和华－万军之神在那里晓谕我们以色列人； 耶和华是他可记念的名。
verses.textEnNiv: He struggled with the angel and overcame him; he wept and begged for his favor. He found him at Bethel and talked with him there—
verses.textEnEsv: He strove with the angel and prevailed; he wept and sought his favor. He met God at Bethel, and there God spoke with us—
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, he struggled with the Angel and prevailed; He wept, and sought favor from Him. He found Him in Bethel, And there He spoke to us—
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, he wrestled with the angel and won. He wept and pleaded for a blessing from him. There at Bethel he met God face to face, and God spoke to him —
verses.textEnNasb: Yes, he wrestled with the angel and prevailed; He wept and implored His favor. He found Him at Bethel, And there He spoke with us,
verses.textEn: He struggled with the angel and overcame him; he wept and begged for his favor. He found him at Bethel and talked with him there—

verses.textZh: 耶和华是万军的神， 耶和华是他的名号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是万军的神， 耶和华是他的名号。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你当归向你的神， 谨守仁爱、公平，常常等候你的神。
verses.textEnNiv: the Lord God Almighty, the Lord is his name!
verses.textEnEsv: the Lord , the God of hosts, the Lord is his memorial name:
verses.textEnNkjv: That is, the Lord God of hosts. The Lordis His memorable name.
verses.textEnNlt: the Lord God of Heaven’s Armies, the Lord is his name!
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord, the God of armies, The Lord is His name.
verses.textEn: the Lord God Almighty, the Lord is his name!

verses.textZh: 所以你要靠着你的神归回， 谨守忠信和公平， 常常等候你的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你要靠着你的神归回， 谨守忠信和公平， 常常等候你的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲是商人， 手里有诡诈的天平，爱行欺骗。
verses.textEnNiv: But you must return to your God; maintain love and justice, and wait for your God always.
verses.textEnEsv: "So you, by the help of your God, return, hold fast to love and justice, and wait continually for your God."
verses.textEnNkjv: So you, by thehelpof your God, return; Observe mercy and justice, And wait on your God continually.
verses.textEnNlt: So now, come back to your God. Act with love and justice, and always depend on him.
verses.textEnNasb: So as for you, return to your God, Maintain kindness and justice, And wait for your God continually.
verses.textEn: But you must return to your God; maintain love and justice, and wait for your God always.

verses.textZh: 以色列是个商人，手里拿着诡诈的天平，喜爱欺压别人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列是个商人，手里拿着诡诈的天平，喜爱欺压别人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲说： 我果然成了富足，得了财宝； 我所劳碌得来的， 人必不见有什么不义，可算为罪的。
verses.textEnNiv: The merchant uses dishonest scales and loves to defraud.
verses.textEnEsv: A merchant, in whose hands are false balances, he loves to oppress.
verses.textEnNkjv: "A cunning Canaanite! Deceitful scales are in his hand; He loves to oppress.
verses.textEnNlt: But no, the people are like crafty merchants selling from dishonest scales— they love to cheat.
verses.textEnNasb: A merchant, in whose hands are fraudulent balances, Loves to exploit.
verses.textEn: The merchant uses dishonest scales and loves to defraud.

verses.textZh: 以法莲说："我成了富翁， 我为自己发了财； 在我所有的收益中， 人不能找出我有甚么罪孽，可算为罪恶的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲说："我成了富翁， 我为自己发了财； 在我所有的收益中， 人不能找出我有甚么罪孽，可算为罪恶的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 自从你出埃及地以来， 我就是耶和华－你的神； 我必使你再住帐棚，如在大会的日子一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Ephraim boasts, "I am very rich; I have become wealthy. With all my wealth they will not find in me any iniquity or sin."
verses.textEnEsv: Ephraim has said, "Ah, but I am rich; I have found wealth for myself; in all my labors they cannot find in me iniquity or sin."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ephraim said, ‘Surely I have become rich, I have found wealth for myself; In all my labors They shall find in me no iniquity that is sin.’
verses.textEnNlt: Israel boasts, "I am rich! I’ve made a fortune all by myself! No one has caught me cheating! My record is spotless!"
verses.textEnNasb: And Ephraim said, "I have certainly become rich, I have found wealth for myself; In all my labors they will find in me No wrongdoing, which would be sin."
verses.textEn: Ephraim boasts, "I am very rich; I have become wealthy. With all my wealth they will not find in me any iniquity or sin."

verses.textZh: "自从你出埃及地以来， 我就是耶和华你的神； 我必使你再住在帐棚里， 像在节日的日子一样，
verses.textZhCnvs: "自从你出埃及地以来， 我就是耶和华你的神； 我必使你再住在帐棚里， 像在节日的日子一样，
verses.textZhCuv: 我已晓谕众先知， 并且加增默示， 藉先知设立比喻。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have been the Lord your God ever since you came out of Egypt; I will make you live in tents again, as in the days of your appointed festivals.
verses.textEnEsv: I am the Lord your God from the land of Egypt; I will again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the appointed feast.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But I am the Lord your God, Ever since the land of Egypt; I will again make you dwell in tents, As in the days of the appointed feast.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I am the Lord your God, who rescued you from slavery in Egypt. And I will make you live in tents again, as you do each year at the Festival of Shelters.
verses.textEnNasb: But I have been the Lord your God since the land of Egypt; I will make you live in tents again, As in the days of the appointed festival.
verses.textEn: "I have been the Lord your God ever since you came out of Egypt; I will make you live in tents again, as in the days of your appointed festivals.

verses.textZh: 我曾对先知说话， 加添许多异象； 又藉先知说比喻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾对先知说话， 加添许多异象； 又藉先知说比喻。
verses.textZhCuv: 基列人没有罪孽吗？ 他们全然是虚假的。 人在吉甲献牛犊为祭， 他们的祭坛好像田间犁沟中的乱堆。
verses.textEnNiv: I spoke to the prophets, gave them many visions and told parables through them."
verses.textEnEsv: I spoke to the prophets; it was I who multiplied visions, and through the prophets gave parables.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have also spoken by the prophets, And have multiplied visions; I have given symbols through the witness of the prophets."
verses.textEnNlt: I sent my prophets to warn you with many visions and parables."
verses.textEnNasb: I have also spoken to the prophets, And I provided many visions, And through the prophets I spoke in parables.
verses.textEn: I spoke to the prophets, gave them many visions and told parables through them."

verses.textZh: 在基列仍有罪孽， 他们实在是没有价值的。 他们在吉甲献牛犊为祭， 他们的祭坛好象田间犁沟中的石堆。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在基列仍有罪孽， 他们实在是没有价值的。 他们在吉甲献牛犊为祭， 他们的祭坛好象田间犁沟中的石堆。"
verses.textZhCuv: 从前雅各逃到亚兰地， 以色列为得妻服事人， 为得妻与人放羊。
verses.textEnNiv: Is Gilead wicked? Its people are worthless! Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal? Their altars will be like piles of stones on a plowed field.
verses.textEnEsv: If there is iniquity in Gilead, they shall surely come to nothing: in Gilgal they sacrifice bulls; their altars also are like stone heaps on the furrows of the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though Gilead has idols— Surely they are vanity— Though they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal, Indeed their altars shallbe heaps in the furrows of the field.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people of Gilead are worthless because of their idol worship. And in Gilgal, too, they sacrifice bulls; their altars are lined up like the heaps of stone along the edges of a plowed field.
verses.textEnNasb: Is there injustice in Gilead? Certainly they are worthless. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls, Yes, their altars are like stone heaps Beside the furrows of a field.
verses.textEn: Is Gilead wicked? Its people are worthless! Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal? Their altars will be like piles of stones on a plowed field.

verses.textZh: 从前雅各逃到亚兰地， 以色列为得妻子而作工， 为得妻子而替人放羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前雅各逃到亚兰地， 以色列为得妻子而作工， 为得妻子而替人放羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华藉先知领以色列从埃及上来； 以色列也藉先知而得保存。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob fled to the country of Aram ; Israel served to get a wife, and to pay for her he tended sheep.
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob fled to the land of Aram; there Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he guarded sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jacob fled to the country of Syria; Israel served for a spouse, And for a wife he tended sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob fled to the land of Aram, and there he earned a wife by tending sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jacob fled to the land of Aram, And Israel worked for a wife, And for a wife he kept sheep.
verses.textEn: Jacob fled to the country of Aram ; Israel served to get a wife, and to pay for her he tended sheep.

verses.textZh: 后来，耶和华借着一位先知把以色列从埃及领上来， 也借着一位先知，以色列得蒙看顾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，耶和华借着一位先知把以色列从埃及领上来， 也借着一位先知，以色列得蒙看顾。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲大大惹动主怒， 所以他流血的罪必归在他身上。 主必将那因以法莲所受的羞辱归还他。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord used a prophet to bring Israel up from Egypt, by a prophet he cared for him.
verses.textEnEsv: By a prophet the Lord brought Israel up from Egypt, and by a prophet he was guarded.
verses.textEnNkjv: By a prophet the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt, And by a prophet he was preserved.
verses.textEnNlt: Then by a prophet the Lord brought Jacob’s descendants out of Egypt; and by that prophet they were protected.
verses.textEnNasb: But by a prophet the Lord brought Israel up from Egypt, And by a prophet he was protected.
verses.textEn: The Lord used a prophet to bring Israel up from Egypt, by a prophet he cared for him.

verses.textZh: 以法莲大大地惹了主的烈怒， 所以，他的主把他流人血的罪归到他身上，把他当受的羞辱归给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲大大地惹了主的烈怒， 所以，他的主把他流人血的罪归到他身上，把他当受的羞辱归给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲大大地惹了主的烈怒， 所以，他的主把他流人血的罪归到他身上，把他当受的羞辱归给他。
verses.textEnNiv: But Ephraim has aroused his bitter anger; his Lord will leave on him the guilt of his bloodshed and will repay him for his contempt.
verses.textEnEsv: Ephraim has given bitter provocation; so his Lord will leave his bloodguilt on him and will repay him for his disgraceful deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ephraim provoked Him to anger most bitterly; Therefore his Lord will leave the guilt of his bloodshed upon him, And return his reproach upon him.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people of Israel have bitterly provoked the Lord , so their Lord will now sentence them to death in payment for their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Ephraim has provoked God to bitter anger; So his Lord will leave his guilt for bloodshed on him And bring his disgrace back to him.
verses.textEn: But Ephraim has aroused his bitter anger; his Lord will leave on him the guilt of his bloodshed and will repay him for his contempt.

verses.textZh: 从前以法莲一说话，人都战兢。 他原在以色列中居高位， 但后来因事奉巴力犯了罪，就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前以法莲一说话，人都战兢。 他原在以色列中居高位， 但后来因事奉巴力犯了罪，就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前以法莲说话，人都战兢， 他在以色列中居处高位； 但他在事奉巴力的事上犯罪就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: When Ephraim spoke, people trembled; he was exalted in Israel. But he became guilty of Baal worship and died.
verses.textEnEsv: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling; he was exalted in Israel, but he incurred guilt through Baal and died.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Ephraim spoke, trembling, He exalted himself in Israel; But when he offended through Baal worship, he died.
verses.textEnNlt: When the tribe of Ephraim spoke, the people shook with fear, for that tribe was important in Israel. But the people of Ephraim sinned by worshiping Baal and thus sealed their destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, But through Baal he incurred guilt and died.
verses.textEn: When Ephraim spoke, people trembled; he was exalted in Israel. But he became guilty of Baal worship and died.

verses.textZh: 现在他们犯罪越来越多， 为自己做铸像， 按着自己的技巧，用自己的银子做偶像； 这些都是匠人的手工。 他们论到这些说："向偶像献祭的人，可以亲吻牛犊。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在他们犯罪越来越多， 为自己做铸像， 按着自己的技巧，用自己的银子做偶像； 这些都是匠人的手工。 他们论到这些说："向偶像献祭的人，可以亲吻牛犊。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现今他们罪上加罪， 用银子为自己铸造偶像， 就是照自己的聪明制造， 都是匠人的工作。 有人论说， 献祭的人可以向牛犊亲嘴。
verses.textEnNiv: Now they sin more and more; they make idols for themselves from their silver, cleverly fashioned images, all of them the work of craftsmen. It is said of these people, "They offer human sacrifices! They kiss calf-idols!"
verses.textEnEsv: And now they sin more and more, and make for themselves metal images, idols skillfully made of their silver, all of them the work of craftsmen. It is said of them, "Those who offer human sacrifice kiss calves!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now they sin more and more, And have made for themselves molded images, Idols of their silver, according to their skill; All of it is the work of craftsmen. They say of them, "Let the men who sacrifice kiss the calves!"
verses.textEnNlt: Now they continue to sin by making silver idols, images shaped skillfully with human hands. "Sacrifice to these," they cry, "and kiss the calf idols!"
verses.textEnNasb: And now they sin more and more, And make for themselves cast metal images, Idols skillfully made from their silver, All of them the work of craftsmen. They say of them, "Let the people who sacrifice kiss the calves!"
verses.textEn: Now they sin more and more; they make idols for themselves from their silver, cleverly fashioned images, all of them the work of craftsmen. It is said of these people, "They offer human sacrifices! They kiss calf-idols!"

verses.textZh: 因此，他们必像早晨的云雾， 又如易逝的朝露， 又像打谷场上的糠秕被旋风吹去， 又像烟气从烟囱上腾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，他们必像早晨的云雾， 又如易逝的朝露， 又像打谷场上的糠秕被旋风吹去， 又像烟气从烟囱上腾。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，他们必如早晨的云雾， 又如速散的甘露， 像场上的糠秕被狂风吹去， 又像烟气腾于窗外。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that disappears, like chaff swirling from a threshing floor, like smoke escaping through a window.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore they shall be like the morning mist or like the dew that goes early away, like the chaff that swirls from the threshing floor or like smoke from a window.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they shall be like the morning cloud And like the early dew that passes away, Like chaff blown off from a threshing floor And like smoke from a chimney.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, they will disappear like the morning mist, like dew in the morning sun, like chaff blown by the wind, like smoke from a chimney.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore they will be like the morning cloud And like dew which soon disappears, Like chaff which is blown away from the threshing floor, And like smoke from a chimney.
verses.textEn: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that disappears, like chaff swirling from a threshing floor, like smoke escaping through a window.

verses.textZh: "自从你出埃及地以来， 我就是耶和华你的神。 除我以外，你不可承认别的神； 除我以外，再没有拯救者。
verses.textZhCnvs: "自从你出埃及地以来， 我就是耶和华你的神。 除我以外，你不可承认别的神； 除我以外，再没有拯救者。
verses.textZhCuv: 自从你出埃及地以来， 我就是耶和华－你的神。 在我以外，你不可认识别神； 除我以外并没有救主。
verses.textEnNiv: "But I have been the Lord your God ever since you came out of Egypt. You shall acknowledge no God but me, no Savior except me.
verses.textEnEsv: But I am the Lord your God from the land of Egypt; you know no God but me, and besides me there is no savior.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Yet I am the Lord your God Ever since the land of Egypt, And you shall know no God but Me; For thereis no savior besides Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have been the Lord your God ever since I brought you out of Egypt. You must acknowledge no God but me, for there is no other savior.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet I have been the Lord your God Since the land of Egypt; And you were not to know any god except Me, For there is no savior besides Me.
verses.textEn: "But I have been the Lord your God ever since you came out of Egypt. You shall acknowledge no God but me, no Savior except me.

verses.textZh: 我曾在旷野， 在干旱之地，认识你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾在旷野， 在干旱之地，认识你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾在旷野干旱之地认识你。
verses.textEnNiv: I cared for you in the wilderness, in the land of burning heat.
verses.textEnEsv: It was I who knew you in the wilderness, in the land of drought;
verses.textEnNkjv: I knew you in the wilderness, In the land of great drought.
verses.textEnNlt: I took care of you in the wilderness, in that dry and thirsty land.
verses.textEnNasb: I cared for you in the wilderness, In the land of drought.
verses.textEn: I cared for you in the wilderness, in the land of burning heat.

verses.textZh: 但他们得了喂养而饱足， 饱足以后，就心高气傲， 因此忘记了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们得了喂养而饱足， 饱足以后，就心高气傲， 因此忘记了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些民照我所赐的食物得了饱足； 既得饱足，心就高傲， 忘记了我。
verses.textEnNiv: When I fed them, they were satisfied; when they were satisfied, they became proud; then they forgot me.
verses.textEnEsv: but when they had grazed, they became full, they were filled, and their heart was lifted up; therefore they forgot me.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they had pasture, they were filled; They were filled and their heart was exalted; Therefore they forgot Me.
verses.textEnNlt: But when you had eaten and were satisfied, you became proud and forgot me.
verses.textEnNasb: As they had their pasture, they became satisfied, And as they became satisfied, their heart became proud; Therefore they forgot Me.
verses.textEn: When I fed them, they were satisfied; when they were satisfied, they became proud; then they forgot me.

verses.textZh: 所以我要像狮子临到他们， 像豹子埋伏在路旁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我要像狮子临到他们， 像豹子埋伏在路旁。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我向他们如狮子， 又如豹伏在道旁。
verses.textEnNiv: So I will be like a lion to them, like a leopard I will lurk by the path.
verses.textEnEsv: So I am to them like a lion; like a leopard I will lurk beside the way.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So I will be to them like a lion; Like a leopard by the road I will lurk;
verses.textEnNlt: So now I will attack you like a lion, like a leopard that lurks along the road.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will be like a lion to them; Like a leopard I will lie in wait by the wayside.
verses.textEn: So I will be like a lion to them, like a leopard I will lurk by the path.

verses.textZh: 我要袭击他们，像一只失掉幼熊的母熊， 撕裂他们的胸膛； 在那里我必像一只母狮吞吃他们； 野兽必撕裂他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要袭击他们，像一只失掉幼熊的母熊， 撕裂他们的胸膛； 在那里我必像一只母狮吞吃他们； 野兽必撕裂他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我遇见他们必像丢崽子的母熊， 撕裂他们的胸膛 。 在那里，我必像母狮吞吃他们； 野兽必撕裂他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a bear robbed of her cubs, I will attack them and rip them open; like a lion I will devour them— a wild animal will tear them apart.
verses.textEnEsv: I will fall upon them like a bear robbed of her cubs; I will tear open their breast, and there I will devour them like a lion, as a wild beast would rip them open.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will meet them like a bear deprived ofhercubs; I will tear open their rib cage, And there I will devour them like a lion. The wild beast shall tear them.
verses.textEnNlt: Like a bear whose cubs have been taken away, I will tear out your heart. I will devour you like a hungry lioness and mangle you like a wild animal.
verses.textEnNasb: I will confront them like a bear deprived of her cubs, And I will tear open their chests; I will also devour them there like a lioness, As a wild animal would tear them to pieces.
verses.textEn: Like a bear robbed of her cubs, I will attack them and rip them open; like a lion I will devour them— a wild animal will tear them apart.

verses.textZh: "以色列啊，我要毁灭你， 谁能帮助你呢 ？
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列啊，我要毁灭你， 谁能帮助你呢 ？
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列啊，你与我反对， 就是反对帮助你的，自取败坏。
verses.textEnNiv: "You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your helper.
verses.textEnEsv: He destroys you, O Israel, for you are against me, against your helper.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O Israel, you are destroyed, But your help is from Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "You are about to be destroyed, O Israel— yes, by me, your only helper.
verses.textEnNasb: It is to your own destruction, Israel, That you are against Me, against your help.
verses.textEn: "You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your helper.

verses.textZh: 现在你的王在哪里？ 让他拯救你吧！ 你所有的领袖在哪里？让他们治理你吧！ 因为论到他们你曾请求：‘把王和领袖赐给我。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你的王在哪里？ 让他拯救你吧！ 你所有的领袖在哪里？让他们治理你吧！ 因为论到他们你曾请求：‘把王和领袖赐给我。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾求我说： 给我立王和首领。 现在你的王在哪里呢？ 治理你的在哪里呢？ 让他在你所有的城中拯救你吧！
verses.textEnNiv: Where is your king, that he may save you? Where are your rulers in all your towns, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes’?
verses.textEnEsv: Where now is your king, to save you in all your cities? Where are all your rulers— those of whom you said, "Give me a king and princes"?
verses.textEnNkjv: I will be your King; Where isanyother, That he may save you in all your cities? And your judges to whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes’?
verses.textEnNlt: Now where is your king? Let him save you! Where are all the leaders of the land, the king and the officials you demanded of me?
verses.textEnNasb: Where then is your king, That he might save you in all your cities; And your judges, to whom you said, "Give me a king and princes"?
verses.textEn: Where is your king, that he may save you? Where are your rulers in all your towns, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes’?

verses.textZh: 我在忿怒中把王赐给你， 又在烈怒中把他废去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在忿怒中把王赐给你， 又在烈怒中把他废去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在怒气中将王赐你， 又在烈怒中将王废去。
verses.textEnNiv: So in my anger I gave you a king, and in my wrath I took him away.
verses.textEnEsv: I gave you a king in my anger, and I took him away in my wrath.
verses.textEnNkjv: I gave you a king in My anger, And took him away in My wrath.
verses.textEnNlt: In my anger I gave you kings, and in my fury I took them away.
verses.textEnNasb: I gave you a king in My anger, And took him away in My wrath.
verses.textEn: So in my anger I gave you a king, and in my wrath I took him away.

verses.textZh: 以法莲的罪孽是封着的， 他的罪恶贮藏起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲的罪孽是封着的， 他的罪恶贮藏起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲的罪孽包裹； 他的罪恶收藏。
verses.textEnNiv: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up, his sins are kept on record.
verses.textEnEsv: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is kept in store.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; His sin is stored up.
verses.textEnNlt: "Ephraim’s guilt has been collected, and his sin has been stored up for punishment.
verses.textEnNasb: The guilt of Ephraim is wrapped up; His sin is stored up.
verses.textEn: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up, his sins are kept on record.

verses.textZh: 生产的疼痛要临到他身上， 他却是没有智慧的人， 因为产期到了，他还迟延不破胎而出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 生产的疼痛要临到他身上， 他却是没有智慧的人， 因为产期到了，他还迟延不破胎而出。
verses.textZhCuv: 产妇的疼痛必临到他身上； 他是无智慧之子， 到了产期不当迟延。
verses.textEnNiv: Pains as of a woman in childbirth come to him, but he is a child without wisdom; when the time arrives, he doesn’t have the sense to come out of the womb.
verses.textEnEsv: The pangs of childbirth come for him, but he is an unwise son, for at the right time he does not present himself at the opening of the womb.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sorrows of a woman in childbirth shall come upon him. He is an unwise son, For he should not stay long where children are born.
verses.textEnNlt: Pain has come to the people like the pain of childbirth, but they are like a child who resists being born. The moment of birth has arrived, but they stay in the womb!
verses.textEnNasb: The pains of childbirth come on him; He is not a wise son, For it is not the time that he should delay at the opening of the womb.
verses.textEn: Pains as of a woman in childbirth come to him, but he is a child without wisdom; when the time arrives, he doesn’t have the sense to come out of the womb.

verses.textZh: 我要救赎他们脱离阴间的权势吗？ 救赎他们脱离死亡吗？ 死亡啊，你的灾害在哪里？ 阴间啊，你的毁灭在哪里？ 怜悯必从我眼前隐藏起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要救赎他们脱离阴间的权势吗？ 救赎他们脱离死亡吗？ 死亡啊，你的灾害在哪里？ 阴间啊，你的毁灭在哪里？ 怜悯必从我眼前隐藏起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必救赎他们脱离阴间， 救赎他们脱离死亡。 死亡啊，你的灾害在哪里呢？ 阴间哪，你的毁灭在哪里呢？ 在我眼前绝无后悔之事。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will deliver this people from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death. Where, O death, are your plagues? Where, O grave, is your destruction? "I will have no compassion,
verses.textEnEsv: I shall ransom them from the power of Sheol; I shall redeem them from Death. O Death, where are your plagues? O Sheol, where is your sting? Compassion is hidden from my eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death. O Death, I will be your plagues! O Grave, I will be your destruction! Pity is hidden from My eyes."
verses.textEnNlt: "Should I ransom them from the grave ? Should I redeem them from death? O death, bring on your terrors! O grave, bring on your plagues! For I will not take pity on them.
verses.textEnNasb: Shall I ransom them from the power of Sheol? Shall I redeem them from death? Death, where are your thorns? Sheol, where is your sting? Compassion will be hidden from My sight.
verses.textEn: "I will deliver this people from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death. Where, O death, are your plagues? Where, O grave, is your destruction? "I will have no compassion,

verses.textZh: 他虽然在芦苇中长得茂盛， 但东风必要来到， 耶和华的风要从旷野上来， 他的水泉就干涸， 他的泉源就枯竭。 他所贮藏的一切珍贵器皿，都被掠夺去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他虽然在芦苇中长得茂盛， 但东风必要来到， 耶和华的风要从旷野上来， 他的水泉就干涸， 他的泉源就枯竭。 他所贮藏的一切珍贵器皿，都被掠夺去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在弟兄中虽然茂盛， 必有东风刮来， 就是耶和华的风从旷野上来。 他的泉源必干； 他的源头必竭； 仇敌必掳掠他所积蓄的一切宝器。
verses.textEnNiv: even though he thrives among his brothers. An east wind from the Lord will come, blowing in from the desert; his spring will fail and his well dry up. His storehouse will be plundered of all its treasures.
verses.textEnEsv: Though he may flourish among his brothers, the east wind, the wind of the Lord , shall come, rising from the wilderness, and his fountain shall dry up; his spring shall be parched; it shall strip his treasury of every precious thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though he is fruitful among his brethren, An east wind shall come; The wind of the Lord shall come up from the wilderness. Then his spring shall become dry, And his fountain shall be dried up. He shall plunder the treasury of every desirable prize.
verses.textEnNlt: Ephraim was the most fruitful of all his brothers, but the east wind—a blast from the Lord — will arise in the desert. All their flowing springs will run dry, and all their wells will disappear. Every precious thing they own will be plundered and carried away.
verses.textEnNasb: Though he flourishes among the reeds, An east wind will come, The wind of the Lord coming up from the wilderness; And his fountain will become dry And his spring will dry up; It will plunder his treasury of every precious article.
verses.textEn: even though he thrives among his brothers. An east wind from the Lord will come, blowing in from the desert; his spring will fail and his well dry up. His storehouse will be plundered of all its treasures.

verses.textZh: 撒玛利亚必承担自己罪的刑罚， 因为他背叛了他的神。 他们必倒在刀下。 他们的婴孩被摔死， 他们的孕妇必被剖开肚腹。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒玛利亚必承担自己罪的刑罚， 因为他背叛了他的神。 他们必倒在刀下。 他们的婴孩被摔死， 他们的孕妇必被剖开肚腹。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒马利亚必担当自己的罪， 因为悖逆她的神。 她必倒在刀下； 婴孩必被摔死； 孕妇必被剖开。
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Samaria must bear their guilt, because they have rebelled against their God. They will fall by the sword; their little ones will be dashed to the ground, their pregnant women ripped open."
verses.textEnEsv: Samaria shall bear her guilt, because she has rebelled against her God; they shall fall by the sword; their little ones shall be dashed in pieces, and their pregnant women ripped open.
verses.textEnNkjv: Samaria is held guilty, For she has rebelled against her God. They shall fall by the sword, Their infants shall be dashed in pieces, And their women with child ripped open.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Samaria must bear the consequences of their guilt because they rebelled against their God. They will be killed by an invading army, their little ones dashed to death against the ground, their pregnant women ripped open by swords."
verses.textEnNasb: Samaria will pay the penalty for her guilt, Because she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword, Their children will be slaughtered, And their pregnant women will be ripped open.
verses.textEn: The people of Samaria must bear their guilt, because they have rebelled against their God. They will fall by the sword; their little ones will be dashed to the ground, their pregnant women ripped open."

verses.textZh: 以色列啊，回转吧！回到耶和华你的神那里， 因为你是因自己的罪孽跌倒的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列啊，回转吧！回到耶和华你的神那里， 因为你是因自己的罪孽跌倒的。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列啊，你要归向耶和华－你的神； 你是因自己的罪孽跌倒了。
verses.textEnNiv: Return, Israel, to the Lord your God. Your sins have been your downfall!
verses.textEnEsv: Return, O Israel, to the Lord your God, for you have stumbled because of your iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Israel, return to the Lord your God, For you have stumbled because of your iniquity;
verses.textEnNlt: Return, O Israel, to the Lord your God, for your sins have brought you down.
verses.textEnNasb: Return, Israel, to the Lord your God, For you have stumbled because of your wrongdoing.
verses.textEn: Return, Israel, to the Lord your God. Your sins have been your downfall!

verses.textZh: 你们预备好要说的话，归向耶和华， 对他说："除去我们一切罪孽， 悦纳我们的祷告。 这样我们就把嘴唇的果子献上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们预备好要说的话，归向耶和华， 对他说："除去我们一切罪孽， 悦纳我们的祷告。 这样我们就把嘴唇的果子献上。
verses.textZhCuv: 当归向耶和华， 用言语祷告他说： 求你除净罪孽，悦纳善行； 这样，我们就把嘴唇的祭代替牛犊献上。
verses.textEnNiv: Take words with you and return to the Lord . Say to him: "Forgive all our sins and receive us graciously, that we may offer the fruit of our lips.
verses.textEnEsv: Take with you words and return to the Lord ; say to him, "Take away all iniquity; accept what is good, and we will pay with bulls the vows of our lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take words with you, And return to the Lord. Say to Him, "Take away all iniquity; Receive us graciously, For we will offer the sacrifices of our lips.
verses.textEnNlt: Bring your confessions, and return to the Lord . Say to him, "Forgive all our sins and graciously receive us, so that we may offer you our praises.
verses.textEnNasb: Take words with you and return to the Lord. Say to Him, "Take away all guilt And receive us graciously, So that we may present the fruit of our lips.
verses.textEn: Take words with you and return to the Lord . Say to him: "Forgive all our sins and receive us graciously, that we may offer the fruit of our lips.

verses.textZh: 亚述不能救我们， 我们必不再骑马； 我们亲手所做的， 我们必不再称为‘我们的神’； 因为在你那里，孤儿才得着怜悯。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述不能救我们， 我们必不再骑马； 我们亲手所做的， 我们必不再称为‘我们的神’； 因为在你那里，孤儿才得着怜悯。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们不向亚述求救， 不骑埃及的马， 也不再对我们手所造的说： 你是我们的神。 因为孤儿在你－耶和华那里得蒙怜悯。
verses.textEnNiv: Assyria cannot save us; we will not mount warhorses. We will never again say ‘Our gods’ to what our own hands have made, for in you the fatherless find compassion."
verses.textEnEsv: Assyria shall not save us; we will not ride on horses; and we will say no more, ‘Our God,’ to the work of our hands. In you the orphan finds mercy."
verses.textEnNkjv: Assyria shall not save us, We will not ride on horses, Nor will we say anymore to the work of our hands, ‘Youare our gods.’ For in You the fatherless finds mercy."
verses.textEnNlt: Assyria cannot save us, nor can our warhorses. Never again will we say to the idols we have made, ‘You are our gods.’ No, in you alone do the orphans find mercy."
verses.textEnNasb: "Assyria will not save us, We will not ride on horses; Nor will we say again, ‘Our god’ To the work of our hands; For in You the orphan finds mercy."
verses.textEn: Assyria cannot save us; we will not mount warhorses. We will never again say ‘Our gods’ to what our own hands have made, for in you the fatherless find compassion."

verses.textZh: "我必医治他们背道的病， 甘心乐意爱他们， 因为我的怒气已经远离他们了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我必医治他们背道的病， 甘心乐意爱他们， 因为我的怒气已经远离他们了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必医治他们背道的病， 甘心爱他们； 因为我的怒气向他们转消。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will heal their waywardness and love them freely, for my anger has turned away from them.
verses.textEnEsv: I will heal their apostasy; I will love them freely, for my anger has turned from them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely, For My anger has turned away from him.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord says, "Then I will heal you of your faithlessness; my love will know no bounds, for my anger will be gone forever.
verses.textEnNasb: I will heal their apostasy, I will love them freely, Because My anger has turned away from them.
verses.textEn: "I will heal their waywardness and love them freely, for my anger has turned away from them.

verses.textZh: 我对以色列要像甘露， 他必像百合花开放； 他要扎根，如黎巴嫩的香柏树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对以色列要像甘露， 他必像百合花开放； 他要扎根，如黎巴嫩的香柏树。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必向以色列如甘露； 他必如百合花开放， 如黎巴嫩的树木扎根。
verses.textEnNiv: I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like a lily. Like a cedar of Lebanon he will send down his roots;
verses.textEnEsv: I will be like the dew to Israel; he shall blossom like the lily; he shall take root like the trees of Lebanon;
verses.textEnNkjv: I will be like the dew to Israel; He shall grow like the lily, And lengthen his roots like Lebanon.
verses.textEnNlt: I will be to Israel like a refreshing dew from heaven. Israel will blossom like the lily; it will send roots deep into the soil like the cedars in Lebanon.
verses.textEnNasb: I will be like the dew to Israel; He will blossom like the lily, And he will take root like the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.textEn: I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like a lily. Like a cedar of Lebanon he will send down his roots;

verses.textZh: 他的幼枝必伸展， 他的荣美要像橄榄树， 他的香气必如黎巴嫩的香柏树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的幼枝必伸展， 他的荣美要像橄榄树， 他的香气必如黎巴嫩的香柏树。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的枝条必延长； 他的荣华如橄榄树； 他的香气如黎巴嫩的香柏树。
verses.textEnNiv: his young shoots will grow. His splendor will be like an olive tree, his fragrance like a cedar of Lebanon.
verses.textEnEsv: his shoots shall spread out; his beauty shall be like the olive, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
verses.textEnNkjv: His branches shall spread; His beauty shall be like an olive tree, And his fragrance like Lebanon.
verses.textEnNlt: Its branches will spread out like beautiful olive trees, as fragrant as the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNasb: His shoots will sprout, His majesty will be like the olive tree, And his fragrance like the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.textEn: his young shoots will grow. His splendor will be like an olive tree, his fragrance like a cedar of Lebanon.

verses.textZh: 他们必再住在他的荫下， 使五谷生长。 他们必发旺像葡萄树， 他们的名声要像黎巴嫩的酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必再住在他的荫下， 使五谷生长。 他们必发旺像葡萄树， 他们的名声要像黎巴嫩的酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 曾住在他荫下的必归回， 发旺如五谷，开花如葡萄树。 他的香气如黎巴嫩的酒。
verses.textEnNiv: People will dwell again in his shade; they will flourish like the grain, they will blossom like the vine— Israel’s fame will be like the wine of Lebanon.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall return and dwell beneath my shadow; they shall flourish like the grain; they shall blossom like the vine; their fame shall be like the wine of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who dwell under his shadow shall return; They shall be revived like grain, And grow like a vine. Their scent shallbe like the wine of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNlt: My people will again live under my shade. They will flourish like grain and blossom like grapevines. They will be as fragrant as the wines of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who live in his shadow Will again raise grain, And they will blossom like the vine. His fame will be like the wine of Lebanon.
verses.textEn: People will dwell again in his shade; they will flourish like the grain, they will blossom like the vine— Israel’s fame will be like the wine of Lebanon.

verses.textZh: 以法莲与偶像还有甚么关系呢？ 答允他的是我，看顾他的也是我。 我像一棵青翠的松树， 你的果子是从我而得。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲与偶像还有甚么关系呢？ 答允他的是我，看顾他的也是我。 我像一棵青翠的松树， 你的果子是从我而得。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲必说： 我与偶像还有什么关涉呢？ 我－耶和华回答他，也必顾念他。 我如青翠的松树； 你的果子从我而得。
verses.textEnNiv: Ephraim, what more have I to do with idols? I will answer him and care for him. I am like a flourishing juniper; your fruitfulness comes from me."
verses.textEnEsv: O Ephraim, what have I to do with idols? It is I who answer and look after you. I am like an evergreen cypress; from me comes your fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Ephraim shallsay, ‘What have I to do anymore with idols?’ I have heard and observed him. I am like a green cypress tree; Your fruit is found in Me."
verses.textEnNlt: "O Israel, stay away from idols! I am the one who answers your prayers and cares for you. I am like a tree that is always green; all your fruit comes from me."
verses.textEnNasb: Ephraim, what more have I to do with idols? It is I who answer and look after you. I am like a luxuriant juniper; From Me comes your fruit.
verses.textEn: Ephraim, what more have I to do with idols? I will answer him and care for him. I am like a flourishing juniper; your fruitfulness comes from me."

verses.textZh: 谁是智慧人，让他明白这些事吧！ 谁是有见识的人，让他领会这一切吧！ 因为耶和华的道路是正直的， 义人要行在其中， 恶人却必在其上绊倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁是智慧人，让他明白这些事吧！ 谁是有见识的人，让他领会这一切吧！ 因为耶和华的道路是正直的， 义人要行在其中， 恶人却必在其上绊倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁是智慧人？可以明白这些事； 谁是通达人？可以知道这一切。 因为，耶和华的道是正直的； 义人必在其中行走， 罪人却在其上跌倒。
verses.textEnNiv: Who is wise? Let them realize these things. Who is discerning? Let them understand. The ways of the Lord are right; the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; whoever is discerning, let him know them; for the ways of the Lord are right, and the upright walk in them, but transgressors stumble in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is wise? Let him understand these things. Whois prudent? Let him know them. For the ways of the Lordare right; The righteous walk in them, But transgressors stumble in them.
verses.textEnNlt: Let those who are wise understand these things. Let those with discernment listen carefully. The paths of the Lord are true and right, and righteous people live by walking in them. But in those paths sinners stumble and fall.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; Whoever is discerning, let him know them. For the ways of the Lord are right, And the righteous will walk in them, But wrongdoers will stumble in them.
verses.textEn: Who is wise? Let them realize these things. Who is discerning? Let them understand. The ways of the Lord are right; the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.
